title: CEO - Doit Lithuania
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As CEO of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
descriptionHtml:
📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite

Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques.

Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer.

Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse, vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites.

Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique.

Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance.

Vos missions

Votre rôle

Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite.

Vous êtes à la fois :

  • un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ;

  • un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ;

  • un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents.

Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre.

Vos principales missions

1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques

Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels.

Votre périmètre couvre notamment :

  • les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ;

  • les systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • les UPS / onduleurs ;

  • les groupes électrogènes ;

  • les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ;

  • les systèmes de refroidissement ;

  • la protection et la sécurité incendie ;

  • les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées.

Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations, et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques.

2 - Sécuriser les opérations

L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques.

À ce titre, vous :

  • challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ;

  • identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ;

  • sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ;

  • challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ;

  • pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ;

  • accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ;

  • contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification.

Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation, avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service.

3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques

L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites.

Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels.

Vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

  • structurer les processus d'exploitation ;

  • définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ;

  • rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ;

  • mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ;

  • contrôler leur bonne application ;

  • identifier les écarts entre les sites ;

  • proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ;

  • partager les bonnes pratiques ;

  • réaliser des REX multisites ;

  • accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards.

La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique.

4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques

En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations.

Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à :

  • analyser techniquement l'incident ;

  • identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ;

  • apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ;

  • challenger les analyses proposées ;

  • accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ;

  • contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ;

  • participer à la résolution de l'incident ;

  • organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites.

Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle.

5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle

Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation.

Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à :

  • former et accompagner les équipes ;

  • expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ;

  • faire progresser les pratiques ;

  • fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ;

  • accompagner la conduite du changement ;

  • favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites.

Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct.

6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs

Vous serez capable de :

  • représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ;

  • expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ;

  • présenter les actions mises en œuvre ;

  • répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ;

  • apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures.

Une organisation en construction

Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré, regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets.

L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec :

  • les responsables de site ;

  • les équipes Facility et Operations ;

  • les équipes projets ;

  • les experts techniques ;

  • les prestataires et partenaires externes ;

  • les fonctions transverses ;

  • les clients majeurs.

Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes.

Vos compétences

Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement Data Center ou infrastructure critique fortement structurée.

Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées.

Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée.

Votre expertise technique

Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment :

  • électricité HT/BT ;

  • systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • UPS / groupes électrogènes ;

  • CVC / HVAC ;

  • refroidissement ;

  • protection incendie ;

  • contrôle-commande ;

  • maintenance des infrastructures critiques.

Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes, et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial.

Vous savez également analyser une problématique technique complexe, identifier les risques et challenger les solutions proposées.

Votre expérience opérationnelle

Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement où les procédures et les standards opérationnels occupent une place importante.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec :

  • les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • la gestion des changements ;

  • l'analyse de risques ;

  • la maintenance préventive et corrective ;

  • la gestion d'incidents critiques ;

  • les audits et contrôles opérationnels ;

  • les REX ;

  • la standardisation des pratiques ;

  • la gestion de prestataires techniques.

Vous avez surtout envie de faire progresser une organisation, de structurer les pratiques et d'améliorer durablement les opérations.

Vos qualités

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, nous recherchons une personne :

  • dotée d'une forte expertise technique ;

  • structurée et rigoureuse ;

  • capable d'analyse et de prise de recul ;

  • pédagogue et capable de transmettre son expertise ;

  • à l'aise pour challenger ses interlocuteurs ;

  • capable de prendre des décisions et de défendre une position technique ;

  • dotée d'une forte intelligence relationnelle ;

  • capable de s'adapter à différents profils et différents niveaux de maturité ;

  • fédératrice et à l'aise dans un rôle transverse ;

  • capable d'accompagner la conduite du changement.

Votre capacité à adapter votre communication à votre interlocuteur tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence technique sera déterminante.

Avantages

  • Bonus : 2 mois de salaire

  • Déplacements : indemnité de véhicule forfaitaire sur 12 mois de 1 500 €

  • De la participation équivalent à 1-1.5 mois de salaire

  • Astreinte : Poste soumis à l'astreinte (à validation période d'essai)

You’ll own clinical hiring across Bolt Pharmacy in the UK and our new pharmacy in the Netherlands. That means our UK Superintendent Pharmacist, 2 clinical team leads, at least 11 UK clinical hires, and the full Netherlands clinical team in Q1.

You don’t wait for seats to open. You build pipelines of pharmacists, technicians and clinical leaders ahead of demand, so new sites launch on time and backfills come from people you already know.

You run every search end to end: sourcing, screening, registration checks, and closing. You also run our clinical recruiting agencies and hold them to our bar. Sloppy screening puts patients and our pharmacies at risk, so your standards are relentless.

Great performance in this role means our pharmacies scale across Europe without staffing ever being the bottleneck.

This is a full-time, fully remote role based in the UK or EU, and you’ll work mostly async — as long as you’re available during UK/EU working hours for candidate and site calls, with some overlap into US Central mornings as needed. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is an individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to our People Lead, Europe (Zoe Wheeler). We’re intense, so you’ll also be intense.

You’ll also work closely with our Head of People (Cierra Olson), our UK Clinical Ops Lead ([Name TBD]), and our Netherlands site leaders ([Name TBD]).

Key responsibilities

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2030 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.


Role Description

Our new product is a business loan for established UK SMEs, with fixed monthly repayments over 3 to 6 years. Most of the businesses we will be speaking to already know us, so the job is to reach the right people, understand what they need and take good applications from first conversation through to a funded loan.

You will be the person who owns that journey day to day: calling and emailing existing customers, running outreach campaigns, collecting the information we need to underwrite, and keeping the pipeline accurate so the team can see what is working. You will work closely with Risk, Legal and Data, and report progress to senior leadership each week.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Make outbound calls to existing and previous customers, hold clear discovery conversations about what they need the funding for, and record every outcome in HubSpot

  • Maintain a consistent follow up routine

  • Collect bank statements or Open Banking connections and any other documents needed, and pass complete applications to Underwriting with the context they need

  • Explain loan terms, pricing, arrangement fees and personal guarantees clearly and accurately, and know when to hand a question to Risk or Compliance rather than answer it yourself

  • Support customers through offer, KYC refresh, legal documents and direct debit set up until the loan is funded

  • Treat declines and customers who are not interested with care, and refer customers elsewhere only with their consent

  • Run outreach campaigns across email, statement emails, SMS, Whatsapp and LinkedIn, working with the Data team on audiences and reviewing the results

  • Keep the CRM up to date, tidy and consistent, including the reason for every rejection or decision not to proceed

  • Provide weekly reports on calls made, conversations held, applications, offers and funded loans, and flag what is and isn't working

  • Work closely with Risk, Legal and Data to keep applications moving and customers well served

  • Comply with all mandatory policies and adhere to operational procedures to maintain internal controls

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • 1-3 years of experience in a commercial business development or relationship role, ideally in lending, finance or fintech

  • Confident and credible on the phone with small business owners and directors, and comfortable making a high volume of calls

  • Clear, accurate written communication, and the discipline to follow up and keep records up to date

  • Strong numerical ability, with the confidence to work with loan amounts, interest rates, terms, repayments and fees

  • Honest and careful about what can and cannot be promised to a customer, in a regulated environment

  • Knowledge of SME lending, including unsecured loans, personal guarantees or government-backed schemes

  • Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot, and with email or SMS campaign tools

  • Familiarity with Open Banking, KYC and credit underwriting processes

title: Commercial Lead, DACH
descriptionHtml:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We’re looking for an experienced seller with an entrepreneurial mindset to help build Heidi’s next stage of growth across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

There’s already momentum: clinicians using the product, customers recommending us and healthcare organisations coming to us with interest. You’ll build on that foundation by closing strategically important deals, creating new pipeline and turning individual adoption into broader organisational relationships.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a broad commercial remit. You’ll personally own opportunities from first conversation to signed agreement, while helping us develop partnerships, strengthen our market presence and figure out where to focus next.

You might spend one day building a business case with a hospital group, the next prospecting into a priority account, and another working with a potential partner or helping shape a local event. You’ll bring the judgement to choose what matters and the follow-through to make it happen.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own strategically important deals: Lead opportunities with practice groups, MVZs, clinics and hospital groups from discovery and demos through business case development, negotiation and close. Build relationships with clinical champions, operational leaders and executive decision-makers.

  • Build your own pipeline: Identify the accounts and segments worth pursuing, develop a clear approach and do the outreach yourself. Use targeted prospecting, introductions, local networks and creative approaches to open conversations.

  • Convert the demand coming to us: Respond quickly to inbound interest and use product adoption signals to uncover larger opportunities. Recognise when an enthusiastic clinician could become the starting point for a practice-wide or group-wide rollout.

  • Help buyers reach a decision: Understand their workflows, priorities and buying process. Bring the right stakeholders together, coordinate internal support on technical, security and procurement questions, and give pilots clear success criteria and a route to rollout.

  • Help build the wider market: Develop relationships with software providers, professional associations, clinical advocates and other potential partners. Work with colleagues on conferences, webinars, customer stories and commercial initiatives that create trust and qualified demand.

  • Improve how we sell: Turn what you learn into better messaging, account prioritisation and sales processes. Use AI and commercial tools to improve your effectiveness, keep the CRM accurate and maintain a realistic view of your pipeline and forecast.

  • Bring the market back into Heidi: Share clear evidence about why customers buy, what slows adoption and where product improvements or localisation could unlock growth. Work closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success and the wider DACH team.

 

What you'll need

  • A proven record of selling and closing: You’ve personally owned a revenue target and can explain the deals you originated, how you won them and the results you delivered. Experience in B2B software or a similarly complex commercial environment is particularly relevant.

  • Strong sales craft: You know how to run discovery, build a compelling business case, develop champions and navigate opportunities involving several stakeholders. You can earn credibility with both a clinician and a CFO.

  • The ability to create opportunities: You’ve built pipeline through your own efforts and know how to turn an account list or a promising introduction into meaningful commercial progress.

  • A generalist’s range and judgement: You enjoy work beyond the immediate deal: testing a channel, developing a partnership, organising a customer session or solving a problem that is holding growth back. You can balance that breadth with delivering your number.

  • Independence and pace: You create structure when the playbook is still being written, make sensible decisions with incomplete information and follow through without being chased.

  • Fluent German and strong English: You can lead nuanced commercial conversations in German and work effectively with a global team.

  • Curiosity about healthcare and AI: You’ll learn the product properly, take clinicians’ concerns seriously and use AI thoughtfully in your own work. You’re open to feedback and willing to change your approach when the evidence changes.

Particularly useful experience

  • Being an early AE or helping grow a new territory at a scaling company.

  • Selling into DACH healthcare or another complex, regulated market.

  • Building partnerships or turning individual product usage into larger organisational deals.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

title: Compliance Manager - Credit
descriptionHtml:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

Pillar Labs Ltd is LemFi's regulated credit entity, and this is its core compliance hire. You'll sit inside a small, growing second-line function, reporting directly to the Compliance Lead and MLRO (SMF16/SMF17). The role spans the full width of a consumer credit business: day-to-day conduct oversight, financial crime, Consumer Duty, financial promotions, FCA returns and deputy MLRO cover. It's broad by design, because the function is lean and the business is building.


This is a hands-on role with real visibility. You'll give practical regulatory advice to Customer Support, Collections and Complaints, review and approve customer-facing content before it goes live, carry out first review of financial crime escalations and internal SARs, and prepare the MI that lands in front of the Board and ExCo. You'll also work directly with the SMF16/17 on new product launches, regulatory change and FCA engagement. If you want to own a wide brief in a business you can actually see growing, this is it.

What you'll build and own

  • Deliver day-to-day second-line oversight across complaints handling (DISP), collections and arrears (CONC 7) and customer support, reporting findings and themes to the SMF16/17

  • Review and approve all customer-facing content before it goes live: marketing, app journeys, servicing emails, arrears communications and partner promotions, assessed against the financial promotions rules, Consumer Duty and the CAP Code

  • Act as deputy MLRO: carry out first review of financial crime alerts, escalations and internal SARs, prepare them for MLRO decision, and cover MLRO duties when needed

  • Run Consumer Duty outcomes monitoring and testing, including vulnerable customer identification and support, and prepare the Board and ExCo MI pack

  • Prepare scheduled FCA returns and ad hoc data requests ready for sign-off, and maintain the compliance breach log, issues log and actions tracker

  • Carry out day-to-day oversight of third parties, including vendor due diligence and ongoing monitoring (IARs)

  • Support the SMF16/17 on new product and product change reviews, regulatory change projects and the firm's financial crime framework, using AI tooling to move faster on drafting, analysis and QA

Your experience

  • 3 or more years in a compliance role at an FCA-regulated firm, with direct exposure to consumer credit products

  • Hands-on financial crime experience: reviewing alerts and escalations, drafting or reviewing internal SARs, and solid working knowledge of POCA and the Money Laundering Regulations

  • Practical experience reviewing and approving financial promotions and customer-facing communications against the FCA rules

  • Working knowledge of Consumer Duty and DISP complaints handling, with experience running second-line oversight or QA of complaints, collections or customer support

  • Comfortable preparing written reports and MI for senior stakeholders, and giving clear, practical regulatory advice to first-line teams under time pressure

  • At ease working in a lean team where you pick up the brief early, work through ambiguity and get things done without a large support structure around you

Nice to have

  • Experience acting as deputy MLRO or nominated officer cover, and familiarity with vulnerable customer frameworks and Consumer Duty outcomes testing

  • Experience of FCA regulatory returns, outsourcing oversight (IARs) and CONC in a fintech or fast-growing credit business

  • A relevant qualification such as the ICA Certificate or Diploma in Compliance or Anti Money Laundering


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. title: Comptable sénior H/F
descriptionHtml:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.

Comment on fait ? On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.




Pourquoi ce poste ?

Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e comptable senior capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.
Tes missions
Gross margin et comptabilité énergie
  • Piloter la comptabilisation mensuelle des flux de marge brute (achats d’énergie, acheminement, ventes facturées et non facturées) et en produire une analyse critique : variations, écarts, leviers
  • Fiabiliser le cut-off et les estimations de fin de mois (factures à établir, énergie livrée non facturée, provisions), en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles et facturation
  • Justifier et documenter les comptes de ton périmètre, et traiter les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution définitive
    • Fiscalité énergie et TVA
  • Établir, contrôler et déposer les déclarations de TVA (CA3) ainsi que les accises sur l’électricité et le gaz naturel et la CTA
  • Établir les déclarations d’échanges de biens (EMEBI) sur les flux intra-UE
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur les questions fiscales du périmètre : analyser les cas nouveaux (offres commerciales, programmes de fidélité, nouveaux produits), formaliser une position et la challenger avec nos conseils externes
  • Contribuer à la mise en conformité avec la réforme de la facturation électronique et du e-reporting
    • Supervision et contrôle
  • Superviser et contrôler les opérations de la comptabilité fournisseurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de la chaîne d’automatisation (NetSuite, Rossum)
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice des commissaires aux comptes et des auditeurs sur ton périmètre : préparation des justificatifs, réponses aux demandes, suivi des recommandations
    • Structuration et amélioration continue
  • Identifier les points de friction dans les clôtures et les process, proposer des solutions et les mettre en œuvre
  • Raccourcir et fiabiliser les clôtures mensuelles post-migration NetSuite
  • Rédiger et maintenir la documentation des process et des contrôles
  • Être moteur·trice dans le déploiement de l’IA et de l’automatisation au sein de la Finance

    • Ce que l'on attend de toi
    De ton arrivée à 3 mois :
  • Prendre en main NetSuite, Rossum et comprendre les flux entre l’ERP et les systèmes de facturation et de back-office
  • Comprendre les mécanismes du marché de l’énergie et la construction de la gross margin
  • Réaliser tes premières clôtures et déclarations en binôme, et livrer un premier diagnostic des fragilités de ton périmètre
    • De 4 à 6 mois :
  • Être pleinement autonome sur les clôtures, l’analyse de marge et l’ensemble des déclarations fiscales
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur la fiscalité énergie, en interne comme vis-à-vis des CAC et conseils
  • Avoir porté au moins une amélioration concrète et mesurable (process, contrôle, automatisation)
    • Au-delà de 6 mois :
  • Être force de proposition sur la feuille de route Finance et accompagner la montée en compétences de l’équipe sur ton périmètre

    • Ce poste est fait pour toi si
  • Tu es diplômé·e d’un DSCG, DCG, d’un master CCA ou équivalent, avec 4 à 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité et fiscalité, idéalement avec un passage en cabinet d’audit ou d’expertise suivi d’une expérience en entreprise
  • Tu as une solide maîtrise de la TVA et, idéalement, des accises énergétiques ; une expérience dans l’énergie, les utilities ou un secteur à fort volume de facturation est un vrai plus
  • Tu es habitué·e aux clôtures mensuelles exigeantes et aux échanges avec les commissaires aux comptes
  • Tu es très à l’aise avec la donnée : Excel avancé (TCD, XLOOKUP, Power Query), analyse de gros volumes ; une appétence pour l’automatisation et les outils d’IA est appréciée
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance des ERP (NetSuite apprécié) et l'expérience d’un projet de migration ou de refonte de process souhaitée
  • Tu maitrises le Français et l'Anglais professionnel (niveau B2-C1): tu échangeras régulièrement avec les équipes du groupe au Royaume-Uni
    • Ce qui fera la différence :
  • Tu es un·e vrai problem solver : face à un écart inexpliqué, tu ne te contentes pas de le corriger, tu remontes à la cause et tu fais en sorte qu’il ne se reproduise pas
  • Tu es à l’aise dans un environnement en construction, où tout n’est pas encore documenté, et tu aimes structurer
  • Tu es autonome, rigoureux·se et capable de prioriser dans un contexte qui bouge vite
  • Tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques et travailler avec des interlocuteurs non financiers (opérations, facturation, IT)

    • Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ?

    Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

title: Consultant KI & Einkauf (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du setzt KI praktisch ein, erklärst verständlich und gehst gerne auf Menschen zu? Bei ProcuVia befähigst du Einkaufsteams, KI sinnvoll im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen. Du leitest Workshops und erkennst im Gespräch, wo wir unsere Kunden darüber hinaus unterstützen können.

ProcuVia ist eine spezialisierte Einkaufsberatung. Wir verbinden Einkaufsexpertise mit Datenanalyse und KI und begleiten unsere Kunden bei der praktischen Umsetzung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest KI-Workshops von der Bedarfsklärung über Vorbereitung und Durchführung bis zur Nachbereitung und trittst dabei für ProcuVia beim Kunden auf.
  • Du entwickelst verständliche Demonstrationen und Übungen für typische Einkaufsaufgaben und verbesserst unsere Workshop-Unterlagen kontinuierlich.
  • Du bereitest dich auf die jeweilige KI-Umgebung vor, auch auf kundenspezifische Lösungen, und passt die Inhalte an die Teilnehmer an.
  • Du stellst passende ProcuVia-Leistungen vor, erkennst weiterführenden Beratungsbedarf und vereinbarst den nächsten Schritt mit dem zuständigen Kollegen.
  • Du testest neue KI-Anwendungen, bildest dich laufend weiter und entwickelst unser Workshop-Angebot zwischen den Kundeneinsätzen mit.

Das bringst du mit

  • Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einer relevanten KI-Umgebung, etwa Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude oder Perplexity. Weitere Plattformen erschließt du dir eigenständig.
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Freude am Erklären und einen sicheren, zugewandten Umgang mit neuen Menschen und kritischen Fragen.
  • Verständnis für beratenden Verkauf: Du hörst zu, stellst gute Fragen und erkennst, welche Unterstützung einem Kunden tatsächlich weiterhilft.
  • Eigeninitiative, Integrität und Teamorientierung. Du prüfst KI-Ergebnisse kritisch, benennst Grenzen offen und hältst Kundenkontakte und nächste Schritte transparent fest.
  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßiger Weiterbildung und Kundenreisen innerhalb Deutschlands.

Langjährige Trainererfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung. Einkaufswissen und Workshop-Routine kannst du bei uns aufbauen. Erfahrene Kandidaten sind ebenso willkommen wie KI-Praktiker mit Entwicklungspotenzial. Programmierkenntnisse und eigenständige Vertriebsabschlüsse werden nicht vorausgesetzt.

Das erwartet dich

Eine Rolle mit direktem Kundenkontakt und Gestaltungsspielraum für unser KI-Workshop-Angebot. Du arbeitest hybrid und übernimmst nach Hospitation und gemeinsamer Moderation schrittweise eigene Workshops. Dabei begleiten dich fachliche Ansprechpartner aus dem ProcuVia-Team.

title: Consumer PR - Business Director
descriptionHtml:
About Ogilvy  

Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Consumer PR - Business Director

Department: Consumer PR & Influence
Location: London
Contract Type: Fixed-Term 12-Months
Full Time/Part time: Full Time
Reporting into: Managing Partner 

The Role: 

As Business Director you will lead client partnership, strategic counsel and integrated delivery across the portfolio, designed to provide the client with fully focused, senior leadership on some of the world’s most iconic FMCG brands. 

The role sits at the intersection of earned-first thinking, culture-led marketing, and integrated agency delivery, ensuring that PR, social, influence and advertising work together to create impact at scale across diverse markets. 
 
This pivotal role places you at the heart of our operations for large FMCG portfolio, one of the world's most iconic and dynamic brands.  

Your remit will span from the initial spark of ideation – identifying trends and innovative opportunities that drive cultural relevance – through the meticulous development of cutting-edge strategies tailored to diverse market nuances and brand objectives. You will lead the charge on defining compelling creative narratives and content frameworks, ensuring brand consistency and breakthrough engagement. Subsequently, you will oversee flawless execution, transforming strategy into impactful activations across various platforms and geographies.  

This role demands a holistic leader capable of driving innovation, navigating complex client relationships, and delivering measurable results within a dynamic, multi-market agency environment. 
 

Key Responsibilities: 

Client leadership & stakeholder management 

  • Act as the senior day-to-day client lead for European and Global teams, building trusted, long-term partnerships
  • Provide strategic counsel across brand, reputation, partnerships and cultural activation
  • Lead complex, multi-market stakeholder management across global, regional and local teams
  • Ensure the FMCG Brand has consistent, senior-level leadership fully embedded in the brand business 

Global & European strategy development 

  • Lead the creation of global and European communications toolkits, frameworks and playbooks that balance global brand consistency with local market nuance
  • Embed earned-first thinking into all toolkits
  • Partner closely with creative and strategy leads to shape culturally relevant, insight-led ideas 

Market management & intelligence 

  • Oversee market engagement across Europe and priority global territories, acting as a central connector between the brands global teams and local markets
  • Ensure clients are consistently informed on market trends, cultural shifts, competitor activity and emerging opportunities
  • Champion local market insight, ensuring work is adaptable, relevant and executable across diverse regions 

Global events & partnerships 

  • Lead the communications strategy and delivery for global brand moments and events, ensuring alignment across markets
  • Play a central role in developing and activating brand partnerships, embedding them seamlessly into toolkits and campaign narratives
  • Work with market and agency leads to bring partnerships to life in locally relevant, culturally resonant ways 

Team leadership & integration 

  • Directly manage a London-based team, working alongside creative and strategy leadership
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance team culture grounded in integration and shared ownership 

What makes this role different: 

  • 100% dedicated to the FMCG portfolio, allowing for deep brand immersion and long-term strategic thinking
  • Operates at true global scale, balancing global brand stewardship with local market realities
  • Deeply partnership-led, with collaborations embedded into brand strategy
  • Strong emphasis on earned-first, culture-first marketing, influencing how integrated campaigns are built from the ground up
  • Sits within a fully integrated agency model, requiring constant collaboration across discipline 

Key Leadership Competencies: 

  • Proven experience in global and/or European leadership roles, ideally within FMCG or large-scale consumer brands 
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills — this role is heavily relationship-driven and requires confidence navigating complexity 
  • Strong understanding of how global brands operate across markets, with sensitivity to cultural and market nuance 
  • Demonstrated experience working in integrated agency environments across PR, advertising, social and influence 
  • A passion for culture-led, earned-first marketing and its role in driving brand relevance and business impact 
  • Commercially astute, strategically minded and comfortable operating at senior client level 
  • A genuine interest in — and affinity for — the drinks brands and the wider FMCG landscape 
  • Communication & Collaboration: Defines and communicates the overarching vision for the Influence practice. Develops communication strategies that align the department with agency leadership and fosters a culture of open dialogue and mentorship for senior leaders. 
  • Organisation & Resource Management: Architects the department's operational structure to support profitability and growth. Oversees P&L, leads resource forecasting, and ensures the practice is structured to handle complex, large-scale business needs. 
  • Responsibility & Accountability: Holds ultimate accountability for the entire department's commercial and creative performance. Empowers directors to lead their teams while maintaining transparent, high-level communication with executive leadership on business progress and challenges. 
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making: Acts as the final point of authority on the most critical business issues. Makes high-stakes decisions that protect the agency's commercial interests and mentors directors in strategic problem-solving. 
  • Growth & Development: Champions and funds a departmental learning culture. Defines the long-term talent strategy, creates career pathways for all levels, and builds a best-in-class team through senior hiring and mentorship. 
  • Ogilvy Values & Behaviours: Acts as the ultimate custodian of the agency's values within the department. Embeds these values into the practice's core processes, from recruitment and client management to performance recognition. 
      

Skills for Your Growth to Client Partner: 
To support your progression, you will be expected to develop capabilities in the following areas: 

  • C-Suite Partnership & Business Acumen: Transition from a practice leader to a C-suite strategic advisor. Develop a deep, holistic understanding of the client's entire business model, competitive landscape, and financial drivers to become an indispensable partner to their most senior leaders. 
  • Integrated Solution Leadership: Evolve from leading a single capability to orchestrating the agency's full suite of services. Master the art of integrating diverse crafts—from brand advertising and PR to consulting and data—to solve the client's most complex business problems. 
  • Enterprise Commercial Strategy: Shift focus from departmental P&L management to owning the entire client commercial relationship. Drive enterprise-level growth by identifying strategic opportunities across the client's organization and negotiating large-scale, multi-year partnerships. 
  • Relationship as the Core Product: Move from a role where the craft is the primary product to one where the strategic client relationship itself is the core deliverable. Your success will be measured by your ability to build unwavering trust and long-term loyalty at the highest levels. 
     

Personal Qualities: 

  • Extensive and proven experience in a senior leadership role (e.g., Senior Account Director or Business Director) within a top-tier agency.
  • Strategic yet pragmatic
  • Culturally curious and globally minded
  • Confident, collaborative and calm under pressure
  • Energised by complexity, scale and partnership-driven work
  • Demonstrated track record of P&L ownership and delivering significant, year-on-year business growth.
  • Proven success in leading and winning multi-million-pound new business pitches.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with experience in shaping departmental culture and developing senior talent.
  • Strategic visionary with the ability to anticipate market trends and define a clear, forward-looking path for the business.
  • Outstanding commercial acumen and sophisticated negotiation skills. 

How we help you Thrive: 

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day 
  • Bupa Healthcare 
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave 
  • Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm 
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure 
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests. 
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme 
  • Life Assurance 
  • Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.   

At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. 

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. 

Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.

Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

descriptionHtml:

Wer wir sind

Skinbro macht Körperpflegeprodukte für Männer, die keine Lust mehr auf 3-in-1-Duschgel aus dem Drogerieregal haben. Angefangen hat alles mit der festen Duschseife aus Kokosöl, Aktivkohle und Olivenöl, Made in Germany, ohne Silikone, Parabene und Mikroplastik. Inzwischen vertrauen uns über 100.000 Kunden, 97 % der Bewertungen haben 4 oder 5 Sterne, und das Sortiment wächst mit Deo und Parfüm weiter.

Wir verkaufen ausschließlich direkt an unsere Kunden und wachsen über Direct Response auf Meta, E-Mail und eine Community, die wir ernst nehmen. Unser kleines Team rund um die Gründer arbeitet mit externen Editoren und modernen KI-Tools. Wir sitzen mit eigenem Office direkt in der Hamburger Innenstadt.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Den wöchentlichen Creative-Output für Meta planen und steuern: Was wird gedreht, geschnitten, getestet
  • Aus Gewinner-Ads gezielt Iterationen ableiten: neuer Hook, neues Format, neuer Angle
  • Skripte für Gründer-Content, UGC und statische Ads schreiben und unsere Editoren so briefen, dass niemand nachfragen muss
  • Drehs mit den Gründern planen und begleiten, vom Sofa-Podcast bis zum Whiteboard-Erklärformat
  • Hook Rate, Hold Rate, Outbound-CTR und CPA pro Creative auswerten und im Team teilen, was funktioniert
  • Mit Creators und Editoren zusammenarbeiten und die Produktion schnell halten
  • KI für Hook-Varianten, Bild- und Videoproduktion einsetzen

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung mit Meta-Ads aus Agentur, D2C-Brand oder Content-Team, idealerweise im E-Commerce
  • Beispiele von Ads, die du konzipiert oder produziert hast, gern mit Zahlen
  • Du schreibst Skripte, die gesprochen natürlich klingen, und hast ein Auge für Schnitt und Tempo
  • Grundverständnis von Direct Response: Problem, Lösung, Beweis, Call to Action
  • Du arbeitest schnell, strukturiert und hältst viele Tests gleichzeitig im Blick
  • Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau

Benefits

Deine Benefits

  • Festgehalt plus Bonus, gekoppelt an deine Creative-Ergebnisse
  • Jede Woche neue Creatives live und sofortiges Feedback aus echten Zahlen
  • Voller Datenzugriff vom Ad-Account bis zum Deckungsbeitrag
  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern, Entscheidungen in Stunden statt Wochen
  • Lerne von den Besten: Trainings und modernste KI-Lösungen
  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit Office in Hamburg, flexible Arbeitszeiten, moderne KI-Tools, Skinbro-Produkte für dich und dein Umfeld

Haben wir dich überzeugt?

Dann bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil und zwei bis drei Ads, an denen du gearbeitet hast. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

title: Creative Strategist Italien 100% (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du siehst eine Ad und weißt sofort, warum sie funktioniert – oder warum nicht. Hooks, die den Scroll stoppen. Angles, die konvertieren. Creatives, die aus Aufmerksamkeit Umsatz machen. Bei SHEKO bekommst Du die Bühne dafür: Du bist der kreative Kopf hinter unserem Launch in Italien.

Über SHEKO

Als Online-Shop gestartet, sind wir heute eine der am schnellsten wachsenden Health & Nutrition Brands Deutschlands – mit Balance Shakes, Kollagen, Probiotika und Supplements, die in dm, Rossmann und Müller stehen. Inhabergeführt, profitabel, mit echtem Wachstum vor uns. Nächster Halt: Italien. Und Du übernimmst dabei die kreative Führung.

Aufgaben

Creative Testing mit hoher Schlagzahl

Du konzipierst und briefst 10–20 Creative-Experimente (Batches) pro Woche für Meta, Google und YouTube – und sorgst so für einen konstanten Strom frischer, performanter Assets. Von Research und Angle-Ideation bis zum fertigen Creative-Briefing mit Hooks, visuellen Cues und Copy.

Full-Funnel Ownership

Du verantwortest den gesamten Creative-Lifecycle: Marktrecherche, Hypothese, Briefing, Übergabe an die Produktion, Performance-Post-Mortem. Du weißt genau, warum eine Ad gewonnen hat – oder warum sie gefloppt ist – und machst daraus den nächsten Batch.

Italien-Expertise

Du übersetzt keine Wörter, Du übersetzt Intention. Du verstehst, wie sich der italienische Konsument vom deutschen unterscheidet – in Ästhetik, Tonalität, Lifestyle und Essgewohnheiten – und machst aus diesen Nuancen Creatives, die kulturell wirklich resonieren.

Benchmarking & Marktanalyse

Du vergleichst die italienische Creative-Performance laufend mit unserem bewährten deutschen Playbook: Was lässt sich adaptieren, was muss neu gedacht werden? Du trackst Deine Winning-Angle-Rate und lieferst wöchentlich eine Einschätzung, wie sich der italienische Markt im Vergleich zum deutschen Setup verhält.

Performance & Zusammenarbeit

Dein North Star: Neukundenumsatz bei Ziel-ROAS. Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unseren Paid Social Buyern, unserem Paid Search Manager und unseren Video Editors und Freelance Creators – und schlägst frühzeitig Alarm, wenn Creative Fatigue einsetzt, inklusive mutiger Vorschläge, um die Performance oben zu halten.

Qualifikation

Must-have

  • Italienisch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und ein tiefes Gespür für italienische Kultur, Medien und Konsumenten
  • Erfahrung als Creative Strategist, Performance Creative oder in einer ähnlichen Rolle im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld
  • Du denkst datengetrieben – in ROAS, CTR, Hook Rates und Winning-Angle-Rates, nicht in Bauchgefühl
  • Starke Briefing-Skills: Du schreibst Hooks, Skripte und Creative-Tickets, mit denen Editoren und Designer direkt loslegen können
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und mit hohem Output – Du weißt, was zu tun ist, ohne dass es jemand ansagen muss
  • Fließendes Englisch + solides Deutsch für die tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Hamburger Team

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit Health-, Nutrition- oder Wellness-Brands
  • Vertrautheit mit dem deutschen D2C-Markt oder mit der Skalierung von Brands über mehrere Märkte
  • Hands-on-Skills in Canva, CapCut, Figma oder AI-Creative-Tools
  • Grundverständnis von Media Buying auf Meta und Google

Benefits

  • Echte Gestaltungsfreiheit: Flache Hierarchien, offene Feedback-Kultur und die Möglichkeit, ein wachsendes Unternehmen aktiv mitzuprägen
  • Persönliche Entwicklung: Wir entwickeln gemeinsam Karriereziele, die zu Dir passen – fachlich wie persönlich
  • Starkes Team: Hands-On-Mentalität, enormer Zusammenhalt und eine Kultur, in der gegenseitige Unterstützung selbstverständlich ist
  • Modernes Office: Wohlfühlfaktor in Hamburg-Winterhude, zentral am schönen Mühlenkamp in Alsternähe. Dresscode? Komm wie Du Dich am wohlsten fühlst
  • Die Basics: Wasser, Tee, Kaffee & Shake-Flat, regelmäßige Team-Events und legendäre Firmenpartys

Das klingt nach Dir? Dann bewirb Dich mit Deinem Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben ist kein Muss – aber wenn Du uns kurz erzählst, welche Ad Du zuletzt gebaut hast und worauf Du stolz warst, lesen wir das sehr gerne. Wir freuen uns auf Dich.

title: Credit Strategy Analyst
descriptionHtml:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

This role sits in the Credit Risk team who are hugely influential to our overall lending process. They look at measuring our risk, optimising our credit risk funnel and forecasting the performance of our loan portfolios. To do this, they work with the credit risk modelling, engineering, data management, capital markets and business operations teams to truly understand our objectives and shape analytical solutions.

Focusing on our Credit Risk lending capabilities, you’ll be given the opportunity to think outside the box and come up with a wide range of suggestions and ideas to optimise our ability to lend to small businesses, while also delivering strong returns for our investors.

  • Primarily responsible for monitoring our Credit Strategy to identify useful trends and opportunities to optimise our lending strategy

  • Guiding business decisions by carrying out ad hoc analysis, providing credit risk insights and recommendations for optimising credit risk strategies and business processes

  • Collaborate with experts from different functions, particularly Engineering and Operations, to ensure daily running of our lending business and to implement any Credit Strategy changes

What we’re looking for 🌱

  • A degree in a highly numerical discipline (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or Physical Sciences)

  • Open to entry-level candidates and recent graduates. Prior internship or work experience in credit risk, portfolio analytics, or banking is a strong plus, but not required.

  • Excellent communication skills, particularly with regards to translating data analyses and numbers into actionable insights tailored to the audience

  • Intermediate-to-advanced Excel skills.

  • Practical coding proficiency in at least one analytical language (SQL, Python, or R). Candidates with SAS experience or demonstrated aptitude to learn new languages quickly are also considered.

  • Curious and eager to learn, and comfortable working independently on solving open-ended problems.

  • Able to take ownership of redesigning departmental workflows, using AI to automate complex tasks and drive operational efficiency

  • Competently able to Identify high-impact AI use cases and implement advanced prompting techniques to solve multi-layered business challenges

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

title: CRO Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a CRO Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Some our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • AB Tasty

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

  • The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages

  • A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program

  • Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design

  • High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact

 

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

 

  • The frequency and quality of experiments launched

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

  • Ability to absorb inbound landing-page demand without creating a delivery bottleneck

  • Quality of tracking, reporting, and learnings shared with stakeholders

 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

 

If you’re excited about this role and think you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.
