title: Customer Care Analyst & Ops - Alternance
descriptionHtml:
À propos de Green-Got :

Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance.

Nous construisons l'infrastructure financière du monde de demain.

Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l'ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Une reconnaissance qui nous place au niveau des acteurs réglementés de premier plan, et qui change en profondeur ce que nous construisons, et comment.

Green-Got propose :

  • Un compte de paiement associé à une carte pour payer et être payé au quotidien.
  • Une gamme de placements financiers performants pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition.

L'expérience membre est au cœur de ce modèle. C'est le socle sur lequel repose la confiance que nos membres nous accordent - et que l'équipe Customer Care entretient chaque jour.

Green-Got en chiffres :

  • 100 M€ de transactions traitées chaque mois ;
  • 2,3 Md€ de transactions sécurisées depuis notre lancement ;
  • 1,7 M€ de dons reversés à des projets de transition ;
  • 4,8/5 sur Trustpilot ;
  • 5 % de notre chiffre d'affaires pour soutenir directement des projets de terrain, en finançant directement la Fondation Green-Got.

Le contexte :

📍 Locaux à Paris + télétravail, ouvert au full remote depuis partout en France ;
📄 Alternance : contrat de 35h /semaine ;
💶 Selon profil ;
🗓 Prise de poste : au plus tôt.

Chez Green-Got, le Customer Care est la voix de nos membres en interne, et la voix de Green-Got auprès d'eux, un rôle stratégique dans une institution financière qui grandit vite et qui doit tenir ses promesses 7 jours sur 7.

Nos membres ont changé de dimension avec nous : Compte Premium, PER, compte commun, offre indépendant. Chaque nouveau produit génère de nouvelles questions, de nouvelles situations, de nouveaux défis. L'ouverture prochaine des services BtoB va encore élargir le périmètre.

Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui aime comprendre, qui sait garder son calme sous pression, et qui considère chaque échange comme une opportunité d'améliorer le produit, pas juste de fermer un ticket.

**Tu es à l'aise avec les gens et rigoureux sur le fond. Les deux à la fois.
**

Vos missions

**Tes missions :

**Membre de l'équipe Customer Care, tu es le point de relais central entre nos membres et toutes les équipes de Green-Got : produit, tech, compliance, marketing, impact. Ton périmètre est vivant : il évolue avec nos lancements, nos besoins, et la trajectoire de Green-Got.

Ta capacité à t'adapter, à prioriser et à garder un haut niveau de qualité dans tous les contextes est ce qui nous permettra de grandir sereinement.

FRONT - Relation membre 50 %

  • Premier point de contact : tu réponds à nos membres sur tous nos canaux, chat (90 %), email (8 %), téléphone (2 %), avec clarté, empathie et dans les délais.
  • Expertise produit : tu connais Green-Got sur le bout des doigts. Tu accompagnes nos membres sur leurs comptes, leurs transactions, leurs questions, et tu trouves la bonne réponse après investigation.
  • Gestion des nouvelles situations : tu identifies, qualifies et résous les cas inédits. Tu es garant de la qualité du premier contact.

RUN - Support opérationnel 35 %

  • Voix des membres en interne : tu collectes, structures et remontes les besoins, frustrations et suggestions aux équipes produit, tech, marketing.
  • Amélioration continue : tu optimises les process existants, challenges les workflows, et maintiens notre documentation (FAQ, process) à jour à chaque évolution produit.
  • Suivi des incidents : tu identifies les bugs, les remontes aux équipes concernées et en assures le suivi jusqu'à résolution.
  • Recette fonctionnelle : tu participes aux phases de test des nouvelles fonctionnalités avant mise en production.

BUILD - Gestion de projet 15 %

  • Initiative et ownership : tu identifies des leviers d'amélioration de l'expérience membre, tu définis des indicateurs, proposes et mets en œuvre des actions concrètes.
  • Pilotage : tu mets en place les outils et routines nécessaires au suivi de tes projets et en garantis le résultat.

Vos compétences

**Ton profiil :

**L'empathie, la rigueur dans l'exécution et la capacité à rester serein quand ça s'accélère sont pour toi des réflexes naturels. Tu comprends que la qualité du service est un engagement, pas une intention. Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui en est convaincu.

Chez Green-Got, nous sommes curieux, exigeants, collectifs, et nous allons vite.

  • Sens du service : tu sais que derrière chaque ticket, il y a une personne. Tu ne fermes pas un ticket, tu résous un problème.
  • Rigueur et organisation : tu priorises, tu documentes, tu assures un suivi sans failles.
  • Aisance rédactionnelle : ton orthographe est irréprochable, tu adaptes le ton à chaque interlocuteur. La précision est ta signature.
  • Curiosité analytique : tu aimes comprendre pourquoi une situation se produit, pas juste la résoudre. Tu identifies les patterns et tu les remontes.
  • Gestion du stress : tu gardes ton calme quand la situation l'exige. La pression ne dégrade pas ta qualité.
  • Anglais opérationnel : tu lis, tu réponds, tu échanges sans chercher tes mots. Nous avons des membres non francophones et nous en aurons davantage.
  • Sensibilité à l'impact : la transition environnementale a une réelle importance pour toi. Tu comprends les enjeux et tu portes la mission de Green-Got avec sincérité.
  • Appétence pour les outils numériques : Intercom, Notion, Slack, Aircall, et une vraie curiosité pour l'IA et l'automatisation appliquées au service client.
  • Formation : BTS, IUT, école de commerce, IAE ou toute formation en lien avec la relation client. Une première expérience en care ou service client est un vrai plus.

Avantages

**Ce que l'on t'offre :

**Green-Got entre dans une nouvelle phase. Avec l'agrément ACPR, nous construisons une expérience membre de premier plan - avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant.

Le service client de demain ne se construit uniquement avec des scripts et des macros. Il se construit avec des personnes qui comprennent le produit, les membres, et l'enjeu de chaque interaction.

  • Un rôle avec de l'impact réel : dans un secteur en pleine transformation, au contact direct de nos membres chaque jour.
  • De vraies responsabilités : tu n'exécutes pas, tu contribues. Tes remontées terrain façonnent le produit.
  • Apprentissage : aux côtés d'une équipe qui transmet, dans un environnement réglementaire de premier plan.
  • Évolution : les profils les plus engagés grandissent avec nous et prennent des responsabilités clés.
  • Flexibilité : remote possible depuis chez toi et partout en Europe.
  • Équipe : ambitieuse, exigeante, déterminée, et qui passe de bons moments ensemble.

Le package :

  • Alternance remote ou Paris.
  • Rémunération selon profil,
  • Des évènements réguliers : Team Day GG, Team Building CC, Green-Camp…

Déroulement des entretiens :

Envoie-nous ton CV et tout autre élément qui nous aide à jauger tes compétences et ta motivation.

  • Call rapide pour faire connaissance. Si ça matche, on t’envoie un Business Case à préparer.
  • Entretien en visio avec Vincent (Customer Care Manager) pour analyser le Business Case et te tester / te connaitre.
  • Échange avec un ou plusieurs membres de l’équipe pour le fit culturel.
  • Entretien avec Adèle (Head of Operations).
  • Entretien avec Andréa (CEO).

Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer !

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. title: Customer Success Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

We're hiring a Customer Success Engineer to join the Technical Solutions team, the small team that keeps Omnea working for our customers every day. This role is based in London. This is a customer-facing role with a technical problem-solving heart: when an integration breaks, a workflow misbehaves, or a customer needs Omnea to do something it doesn't do yet, you help find the root cause and the right solution. We resolve around 95% of what comes to us ourselves, from straightforward fixes to changes in production code and small feature requests. You'll be trusted to work out what's really wrong and see it through, drawing on the team's support when you need it.

You'll go deep on the product and broad on the problems: an integration misbehaving with a customer's ERP in the morning, a feature a customer has been asking for after lunch, and helping a colleague through a tough customer conversation by the end of the day. You'll be a trusted voice customers can turn to, joining their calls, providing clear answers and working closely with the Account Management team to set them up for long-term success with Omnea. AI helps us investigate faster, tracing logs, drafting hypotheses and suggesting fixes, but people own the outcome. You'll use your judgment, and the team's expertise where needed, to make sure solutions are safe for a live enterprise environment, address the root cause and surface patterns Product needs to hear about.

The CSE team sits between Customer, Product and Engineering. It's a small, close-knit team with a lot of autonomy, and the scope of the role grows as Omnea does. There is room to lean into your strengths, whether that's guiding customers towards solutions or bringing their feedback into the product, while building your technical skills. You'll develop deep knowledge of Omnea, and your work will be felt by customers every day.

What You'll Do

  • Investigate the hard problems. One issue might be an integration failing with a customer's ERP, the next a workflow that isn't doing what anyone expected, the next a cross-system bug nobody else has cracked. You'll use AI to speed up the first pass, then confirm the cause and get it fixed.

  • Make solutions happen. Own issues through to resolution, whether that means guiding a customer through a solution, improving a workflow or working on a code change. You'll have opportunities to fix bugs and build small customer-requested features in the codebase, with support from the team as you grow. Depending on your strengths, you might lean further into customer guidance or into shaping and improving the product.

  • Back up our Implementation and Customer teams. When a colleague hits a tricky configuration, an edge case or a question they can't answer, they come to you. You'll help them think it through, step into live implementations when they get technical, and make sure the customer gets the right answer.

  • Stay close to customers. You'll have ongoing calls with some customers, join QBRs and escalation calls, get brought in on specialist projects, and represent the Technical Solutions Team when customers move from implementation to ongoing support.

  • Bring the customer's voice into Product. You'll hear what customers struggle with before anyone else does. Spot the patterns across the issues you resolve and turn them into clear, well-argued input for Product, so the same problem doesn't need solving twice.

  • Make it scale. As we grow, we can't just add people. You'll build the tooling, automation, playbooks and docs that help customers solve more on their own and let the team handle more without slowing down.

About You

  • You have at least 3 years of relevant experience, for example in technical support engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, software development or another technical, customer-facing role.

  • You're curious. You want to know how things work and why they broke, and every problem is a chance to learn something.

  • You solve problems analytically. You enjoy messy, ambiguous issues, and you don't stop at the symptom when you can find the root cause.

  • You're comfortable switching context. A bug fix, a customer call and a colleague's question can all land in the same hour, and you can move between them without losing the thread.

  • You want variety. You'd rather handle ten different problems than one big project.

  • You take ownership. You work independently, raise your hand for the hard problems, and see them through to resolution without needing the spotlight.

  • You care about customers, about getting it right, and about the team around you. You're inspired by the idea of unreasonable hospitality: going beyond the expected to make people feel genuinely looked after.

  • You explain technical issues clearly, whether you're talking to an engineer or a non-technical stakeholder.

  • You're not afraid of the technical side. You don't need a CS or STEM degree: technical aptitude can come from your work, side projects or things you've built yourself. Hands-on experience with APIs, SQL or integrations helps, and you'll pick up the codebase with AI, the docs and the team behind you.

  • You use AI tools to move faster, with the judgment to know what to trust and what to double-check.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Du bekommst kein „Startpaket" aus kalten Leads, sondern ein starkes Bestandsportfolio mit starken Marken, das nur darauf wartet, ausgebaut zu werden.

Aufgaben

  • Strategischer Sparringspartner auf Entscheider-Ebene: Du erarbeitest dir Zugang zu den relevanten Stakeholdern, führst strategische Account-Reviews und wirst zum Trusted Advisor deiner Kunden.

  • Produkt und Zusammenarbeit: Du bündelst Kundenfeedback strukturiert fürs Produktteam und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing und Produkt zusammen.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst 1 bis 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Customer-Success, Account Management oder Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld, und willst jetzt den nächsten Schritt mit mehr Verantwortung gehen.

  • Du hast ein kommerzielles Gespür: Du erkennst Expansions- und Wachstumschancen in deinem Portfolio und gehst aktiv auf sie zu.

  • Du kannst deeskalieren: Auch in kritischen Situationen bleibst du souverän, findest Lösungen und hältst Kunden.Kommunikation ist eine deiner Stärken. Du gehst selbstständig in Gespräche, auch auf Entscheider-Ebene, und bleibst dran, bis der Termin steht.

title: Data Scientist - Measurement, Experimentation & Causal Inference
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

As a Data Scientist, you will help measure the impact of PlayStation's products, features and commercial initiatives through experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.

Working at the intersection of data science, machine learning, product and commercial strategy, you will apply robust analytical techniques to solve complex business problems, generate actionable insights and support evidence-based decision-making across PlayStation.

This role goes beyond traditional A/B testing. You will apply modern causal inference, statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to evaluate initiatives where controlled experiments are difficult or impossible, collaborating closely with product, engineering, analytics and business teams to deliver high-quality measurement and insights.

This is an opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives affecting millions of PlayStation players while developing your expertise in experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Apply measurement methodologies across experimentation, causal inference and advanced analytics to evaluate product and commercial initiatives.
  • Design and execute robust measurement approaches across randomised experiments, quasi-experimental methods and observational causal inference where controlled experimentation is impractical.
  • Apply statistical, machine learning and AI techniques to solve complex measurement challenges and generate actionable business insights.
  • Apply advanced data science and machine learning techniques where appropriate to complement experimentation and support complex business decisions.
  • Contribute to the development and adoption of best practices for experiment design, statistical analysis and causal measurement.
  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, analysts and business stakeholders to identify high-impact measurement opportunities and ensure product and commercial decisions are supported by rigorous evidence.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams by providing feedback on experimentation and measurement capabilities to improve tooling and workflows.
  • Develop reusable analytical solutions, dashboards and code that improve the quality, consistency and efficiency of measurement.
  • Communicate analytical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Stay current with emerging developments in statistics, machine learning and AI, identifying opportunities to improve measurement capabilities and analytical workflows.
  • Contribute to a culture of evidence-based decision-making by sharing knowledge, collaborating across teams and promoting analytical best practices.

What We're Looking For:

Required:

  • Master's degree (or equivalent industry experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science or another quantitative discipline. PhD preferred.
  • 3+ years of industry experience applying experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning or related analytical techniques to solve business problems.
  • Good understanding of experimental design, A/B testing and modern causal inference methods, including quasi-experimental approaches.
  • Experience applying data science, machine learning and statistical modelling techniques to analyse complex datasets and generate actionable insights.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for analytical workflows.
  • Experience developing robust analytical solutions using sound statistical principles and software engineering best practices.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Curiosity, creativity and a pragmatic approach to solving ambiguous business problems.
  • A collaborative mindset with a passion for continuous learning and improving analytical capabilities.

Preferred:

  • Experience working in gaming, digital products, consumer technology, e-commerce or subscription businesses.
  • Familiarity with modern data engineering and analytics tooling such as Databricks, Snowflake, Git and Airflow.
  • Experience with modern business intelligence and data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Domo or Power BI.
  • Experience applying AI tools, including large language models (LLMs), to improve data science workflows and analytical productivity.
  • Experience developing reusable analytical frameworks, libraries or internal tooling.
  • Experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.

What You'll Influence:

  • Measurement for PlayStation's product and commercial initiatives.
  • High-quality experimentation and causal inference across product and business teams.
  • Product and commercial decisions through rigorous analytical evidence.
  • The continued evolution of PlayStation's measurement and experimentation capabilities.

Why You'll Love This Role:

  • Help shape how PlayStation measures product and commercial success across a global business.
  • Work on challenging real-world problems using experimentation, causal inference and machine learning.
  • Collaborate with talented scientists, engineers and product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Learn from experienced data scientists while developing your expertise in modern measurement and experimentation.
  • Contribute to the adoption of evidence-based decision-making across PlayStation.
  • Continue growing your technical and business skills in a collaborative, supportive environment.

Benefits:

  • Discretionary bonus opportunity
  • Hybrid Working (FlexModes)
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Dental Scheme
  • 25 days annual leave
  • On-site gym
  • Subsidised café
  • Complimentary soft drinks
  • On-site bar
  • Secure cycle storage and shower facilities

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

title: Deployment Lead, Semiconductors - London
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team turns research breakthroughs into production-grade systems. We embed deeply with customers to solve high-leverage problems and act as the delivery engine for our most complex large-scale engagements. We move quickly from prototype to production and surface reusable patterns that shape our platform. We operate at the intersection of deployment and development – working closely with OpenAI Research, Product and Partnerships.

About the Role

As a Deployment Lead, you will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to Semiconductor customers. You will own how solutions are scoped, built, shipped, and adopted across high-value engineering workflows such as RTL design, verification, and physical implementation. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals.

You will focus on the semiconductor vertical to deploy next-generation AI capabilities. You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities.

Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures).

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role. Success requires deep technical project management expertise, extreme ownership of outcomes, and an ability to immerse in customer workflows and partner with customer teams to solve complex engineering problems at pace.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel between 25-50% is required.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical delivery plan for multiple interdependent work streams, translating customer objectives into a roadmap with milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

  • Run day-to-day engineering execution by tracking and driving delivery across OpenAI FDE and customer teams. Keep progress unblocked and sequenced. Make real-time trade-offs on scope and priority to protect the critical path.

  • Embed with Semiconductor customer teams to land production deployments and drive adoption. Map workflows, shape tools/integrations, and translate requirements into a delivery plan.

  • Shape production deployments that integrate with customer infrastructure, data systems, and engineering toolchains, including export-controlled environments.

  • Partner with Product and Research so platform components and research work streams land in time to support deployment goals.

  • Codify solution patterns and evals. Extract reusable patterns and package field signals to improve product and models.

  • Own value cases and ROI. Set impact hypotheses, baselines, and KPIs; run pre-/post-deployment measurement and report to exec sponsors.

  • Help define how OpenAI engages Semiconductor customers.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring 7+ years of customer‑facing technical delivery leadership.

  • Have deep expertise in Semiconductor workflows, including RTL design, verification, EDA tooling, and physical implementation.

  • Track record of successfully leading large, complex, high-stakes customer engagements where customer outcomes depended on tight coordination and fast decision making, ideally involving AI.

  • Excel in high ambiguity environments. Know how to simplify complex and dynamic work.

  • Move fluidly between system level understanding and execution level detail; can dive into customer workflows/data, map constraints, sketch architectures and move ambiguous problems to shipped systems.

  • Think strategically and pattern-match. Able to step back from execution detail, recognize broader trends across deployments, and connect customer needs to scalable, reusable solutions.

  • Have strong technical fluency and sharp sequencing instincts. Confident discussing technical details, pressure-testing architectures, and making trade-offs.

  • Have shipped AI/LLM systems. You understand solution patterns, integration basics, and production pitfalls.

  • You’re a translator with executive presence. You make complex technical trade-offs legible to business leaders and convert strategy into day-to-day technical execution.

  • Enjoy being onsite with customers to accelerate delivery (often 25-50%, sometimes higher).

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Director of INCO Entrepreneurs
descriptionHtml:
About us:

INCO is a leading social enterprise on a mission to shape a more inclusive and sustainable economy that creates opportunities for all. We have teams and programs in over 50 countries around the world. Our work is split across 5 complementary activities:

  • INCO Academy: skilling programs for individuals facing barriers to employment, leading to careers in fast growing industries such as technology, sustainability, healthcare and more (400,000+ job seekers trained to date).

  • INCO Kids: education and awareness programs empowering school-age learners with future proof knowledge in technology, sustainability, citizenship and more (350,000+ learners supported to date).

  • INCO Entrepreneurs: incubation and acceleration programs for underrepresented founders, and social entrepreneurs building and growing high-impact startups (2,000+ businesses supported every year).

  • INCO Ventures: management company, in charge of impact investment funds to support the growth of

    start ups and companies with social, environmental and territorial impact (€230M managed or advised).

  • INCO Spaces: co-working, co-living spaces for social and environmental innovators and entrepreneurs

    who make the world a better place (Paris, Berlin, Warsaw, and more).

About the role:

We are looking for a Director of INCO Entrepreneurs to lead our global portfolio of incubation and acceleration programs, helping underrepres nted and impact-driven founders build, fund and scale their businesses.

You will own the INCO Entrepreneurs strategic direction, program outcomes, funder relationships, and the related budget.

You will lead a global team with roughly 5 direct reporting lines and collaborate closely with the Associate Director and a group of Program Managers

across regions.

Most of our programs are funded by corporate partners who expect measurable impact.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in program management, team leadership, stakeholder engagement, acceleration and incubation programs, making sure every program changes founders’ trajectories.

You will report to the VP of Global Operations and be part of INCO’s operational leadership team.

What you’ll do:

Strategy and portfolio leadership

  • Define and own the multi year strategy for INCO Entrepreneurs: which founders we serve, what we prioritise and how we stand out in the entrepreneurship support ecosystem.

  • Manage the program portfolio: launch, scale, redesign based on impact data, funder demand and ecosystem gaps.

  • Spot market gaps and new models, such as sector-specific accelerators, investment-readiness tracks and hybrid or online formats, where INCO Entrepreneurs can add distinctive value.

  • Build strong links with INCO Ventures (deal-flow pipeline, investment readiness), INCO Spaces (physical hubs for founders) and INCO Academy.

Growth, funders and business development

  • Own the total of the entrepreneurship portfolio’s budget

  • Lead the senior relationship with key funders. Set expectations,support contract negotiations and renewals, and find opportunities to expand.

  • Support proposal strategy and collaborate with the partnerships team, so every commitment can be delivered and is financially sound.

  • Represent INCO Entrepreneurs externally at ecosystem events with investors, public bodies and in the media as a credible voice on inclusive entrepreneurship.

Impact and quality

  • Set the impact framework and headline KPIs, such as founder revenue growth, funding raised, jobs created, business survival and founder diversity.

  • Make sure monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) results feed into program design decisions and into persuasive impact stories for funders.

  • Hold the unit to high standards in founder experience, mentor and expert quality, and program outcomes.

Leadership and team

  • Lead and develop the team’s leadership.

  • Shape team structure and staffing plans in line with the funder pipeline and budget. Lead senior hiring.

  • Build a high-performance, collaborative and inclusive culture across regions and time zones, with clear goals, regular feedback and real room to grow.

  • Coach the Associate Director as a potential future Director.

Financial management

  • Own the entrepreneurship portfolio P&L: budgeting, forecasting, margin and cost per founder supported.

  • Allocate resources across programs maximising our impact on the ground.

Organisational leadership

  • Contribute to INCO-wide strategic planning as a member of the operational leadership team.

Are you an experienced Veterinary Surgeon ready to take the next step into clinical leadership, or an established Clinical Director looking for a new challenge? Holmefield Veterinary Clinic is looking for a confident and motivated Clinical Director to lead our friendly, experienced team across our two practices in Brayton and Sherburn-in-Elmet, North Yorkshire. This is a fantastic opportunity to make a real difference in a well-established, highly respected small animal practice, combining hands-on clinical work with the chance to shape the future of the business. You'll have the freedom to bring new ideas, influence clinical standards, support your team's development and drive the practice forward, all while continuing to enjoy the clinical work you love. We're looking for someone who is passionate about delivering excellent patient care, enjoys bringing people together and has the confidence and enthusiasm to lead a team, build on the practice's existing strengths and make the role their own.

Lead, inspire and make your mark


As Clinical Director, you'll enjoy a great balance between clinical work and leadership, with approximately 80% of your time spent working clinically across a varied first opinion caseload, including consultations, surgery and medical cases. Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you'll take a leading role in supporting and developing the wider team, providing guidance with clinical decision-making, mentoring less experienced vets and new graduates, and helping to create an environment where everyone feels supported, valued and encouraged to grow. You'll also play an important part in shaping the strategic direction of both practices, working to maintain high clinical standards, improve patient and client care, and support the overall performance and future growth of the business. From leading multidisciplinary teams and developing clinical services to identifying opportunities for improvement, you'll have the autonomy to bring new ideas and make a genuine impact.
With a strong clinical foundation already in place, including certificate holders in small animal surgery and feline medicine, this is a fantastic opportunity to build on the practice's existing strengths. Whether that's introducing new services, supporting colleagues through further qualifications or developing the team's clinical capabilities, you'll have the freedom to help shape the future of Holmefield while maintaining the friendly, collaborative culture that makes the practice such a great place to work. We're looking for a confident, experienced GP vet with strong leadership and communication skills, who enjoys being hands-on clinically while taking responsibility for the wider success of the practice.

Fix or flex – find your perfect balance


We understand that finding the right work-life balance is important, particularly when balancing clinical and leadership responsibilities. This is a full-time position working 40 hours per week across either 4 or 5 days, alongside 1 in 4 Saturday mornings. There are no out-of-hours or on-call commitments, giving you plenty of time to enjoy life outside of work. We are also happy to dicuss flexible working options. With two practices across Brayton and Sherburn-in-Elmet, you'll have the opportunity to work closely with colleagues across both sites while enjoying a varied and rewarding working week.

Meet your new team

You'll be joining a friendly and experienced team of 6 Veterinary Surgeons, supported by a dedicated nursing and client care team who are passionate about delivering excellent care. With certificate holders in small animal surgery and feline medicine, there's a great mix of experience and clinical interests across the team. Our long-established, purpose-built main practice in Brayton has recently been extended and refurbished, offering bright, spacious facilities including digital X-ray, a dedicated dental suite, brand-new ultrasound with abdominal and cardiac scanning capabilities, K-laser, multiparameter monitoring and Doppler blood pressure equipment. We also have separate species wards, a dedicated cattery, a peaceful bereavement room and a dedicated vets' office. Our smaller branch in Sherburn-in-Elmet provides a more community-focused setting for consultations and routine surgery, with more complex and higher-risk cases managed at our main site.

Clinical development is a real priority at Holmefield, and as Clinical Director, you'll have the opportunity to build on the team's existing strengths while helping to shape the future of both practices. Whether that's mentoring colleagues, supporting further qualifications or introducing new clinical services, you'll play a key role in encouraging professional development and creating an environment where everyone can continue to learn, grow and thrive.


Location and culture


Our main practice is based in the picturesque village of Brayton, near Selby, with our branch in the thriving village of Sherburn-in-Elmet. Both locations offer a lovely semi-rural setting, with local pubs, restaurants, independent shops and plenty of character. We're ideally located for exploring North Yorkshire, with York just a 20-minute drive away and Leeds, Harrogate and Hull all within easy reach. Selby railway station also provides direct connections to Leeds, Manchester and London. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the North York Moors, Yorkshire Wolds and East Yorkshire coast offer plenty of opportunities for walking, cycling and exploring.
At Holmefield, we're proud of our close-knit and supportive culture. Regular team and practice meetings ensure everyone has a voice, while staff wellbeing is a genuine priority, with a mental health first aider and access to additional support resources. We're also a sociable bunch, enjoying everything from pub nights and BBQs to summer and Christmas get-togethers. As Clinical Director, you'll play an important role in maintaining this positive culture, supporting your colleagues and creating an environment where everyone feels valued, heard and encouraged to develop. descriptionHtml:

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Director of Sales Talent Acquisition to lead our global team of sales recruiters and make sales hiring a genuine competitive advantage for Grafana Labs. You will set the direction for how we attract, assess and hire the sellers who drive our growth, and you will do it as a core member of the sales organization, not a service function that sits beside it.

You’ll work hand in hand with senior sales leaders, RevOps, Finance and the wider People team to turn hiring plans into predictable outcomes. This is a leader who is energized by data, spots risks to hiring goals before they land, and turns insight into innovative, AI-powered tools that help the business make faster, better decisions. If you have built and rolled out ICP-based hiring and want to do it at global scale in a fast-growing, remote-first company, this is your role.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead, coach and develop a global team of sales recruiters and sourcers, setting a clear strategy, high standards and a culture of ownership across regions.
  • Be highly data driven: build a rigorous view of pipeline, funnel conversion, time to hire and capacity against hiring plans, and flag risks to hiring goals early so the business can act before targets are missed.
  • Plan effectively and remove surprises: build forward-looking hiring plans with sales leaders, RevOps and Finance, surface dependencies and trade-offs early, and keep stakeholders informed so there are no unwelcome surprises.
  • Set a high bar for the team and yourself, driving performance against ambitious hiring targets and consistently hitting and exceeding them.
  • Lead from the front and stay close to the work: step into key searches, candidate conversations and closes when it matters, and put the team’s success ahead of your own profile.
  • Turn insights and data into innovative, AI-based dashboards and tools that give sales leaders, RevOps and Finance real-time visibility and help the team work smarter.
  • Build strong, trusted partnerships with senior sales leaders, RevOps, Finance and other business stakeholders, becoming their go-to adviser on talent strategy, headcount planning and market conditions.
  • Position Sales TA as an integral part of the sales team, aligned to its goals, planning cycles and rhythms, and accountable for shared outcomes.
  • Define and roll out ICP-based hiring for sales roles, so that every search is anchored in a clear, evidence-based picture of what great looks like at Grafana.
  • Build an always-on sales talent pipeline: work with sourcers and use CRM tools to run nurture campaigns that keep future sellers warm, so the team is never starting from zero when a role opens.
  • Collaborate closely with the wider People team, including Talent Team peers, People Ops, Compensation and Total Rewards, to deliver a consistent, high-quality candidate and hiring manager experience.
  • Own the sales hiring process and tooling, including Greenhouse, ensuring data quality, process adherence and continuous improvement across the team.
  • Champion the Grafana Labs employer brand in the sales talent market, with a focus on engaging both passive and active candidates globally.

What makes you a great fit

  • 3+ years leading a Talent Acquisition team, ideally in a global tech sales capacity.
  • A deep understanding of what makes a great software sales professional, and how to assess for it across segments, regions and seniority levels.
  • Strong evidence of using data and AI to solve hiring problems, including building dashboards or tools that changed how a business made hiring decisions.
  • Evidence of implementing and rolling out ICP-based hiring.
  • Experience using sourcers and recruiting CRM tools to build nurture campaigns and an always-on pipeline of sales talent.
  • A competitive, goal-driven mindset: you thrive on a high bar, set ambitious targets for yourself and your team, and have a track record of hitting and exceeding them.
  • Excellent planning skills, with the ability to anticipate dependencies, build realistic hiring plans and remove surprises for the business before they happen.
  • A leader who rolls up their sleeves: you are happy to get stuck into a critical search, a candidate close or a messy process problem alongside the team, you share credit freely, and you care far more about the result than about who gets the recognition.
  • A track record of partnering credibly with senior sales leaders, RevOps and Finance, and of earning a seat at the table.
  • A collaborative mindset, with an understanding that success is not possible without being part of a wider People team.
  • Comfort in a high-paced environment, where you embrace change and ambiguity.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

title: Employer Brand Strategist
descriptionHtml:
In short: one of Conduct's first marketing hires, owning employer brand and our talent community. You will make the case, to exceptional people in every function, for why Conduct is where they should do their life's work.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies compete by being different, and most of that difference lives in software they built for themselves. It decides how parcels reach your door and how food reaches the supermarket. That software is their advantage. It is also the hardest thing in the business to change safely, so good ideas wait months, sometimes years, for the systems to catch up.

Every large enterprise has a software company hiding inside it. Conduct is building its operating system. It reads a company's code and processes, works out what has to change, and helps the business and its systems move together. We start with SAP, and go wherever custom software has grown too complex to change safely.

Rio Tinto, Daimler Truck, and DHL already trust us with their most critical systems. We have signed partnerships with major systems integrators, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is ahead of what we can serve.

We are a talent-dense team doing our life's work in London and New York. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company, and how the world's largest companies operate.

About the role

We're looking for someone to own employer brand and talent community as part of the founding marketing team. Hiring exceptional people fast enough is the biggest challenge Conduct faces. We're scaling from about 70 people to 500, across engineering, deployment strategy, go-to-market and operations, and every one of those candidates needs to understand why Conduct matters.

You will articulate why Conduct matters to talent: who we are, what we care about, why the product matters and where it is going. You will take the case the founders make for the company's ambition and turn it into something every candidate hears, from the careers page to the final interview. You will work closely with the talent team on candidate experience, and with our Social & Community Lead, who owns our social channels and developer community, to bring the employer brand to life online.

You will also build Conduct's talent community: the people who aren't ready to join yet but should be one day. You will design recruiting and talent events across every function, and relationships that keep great people close.

What you'll do

  • Tell the talent story. Write the talent narrative: why work at Conduct, the opportunity areas and the vision, with a clear story for each function we hire into.

  • Own the careers experience. The careers page, job descriptions, candidate materials and everything we say to candidates.

title: Engineering Manager, Sandbox
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

Agents don't run in browsers. They run in sandboxes — and you will lead the team building ours.

You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad.

We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. An RL training run doesn't need one environment; it needs thousands, created and destroyed every second. An agent needs to be sandboxed from the world while still feeling fast enough to be useful. That tension — airtight isolation, at fleet scale, at low latency — is the product.

Your customers are the people building the next generation of AI software on our infrastructure; the primitives you ship become the runtime their agents live in.

What You Will Do

  • Build the isolation layer: microVMs or containers, namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, snapshot and restore.

  • Own the security boundary. Customers run code they didn't write and can't fully trust — your systems make that safe.

  • Scale to fleets: creation latency, density, and lifecycle management for thousands of concurrent environments.

  • Design and build alongside your team, owning the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions.

  • Grow the engineers, not just the software — set the standard for ownership and coach people past their comfort zone.

  • Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback.

  • Partner with Product Managers to turn frontier research needs into shippable primitives.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • Deep Linux internals: namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, virtualization — ideally microVMs of the Firecracker class.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • You understand network isolation at the packet level — not just firewall rules.

  • Performance instincts: you know what a syscall costs, and you have the profiles to prove you've cared.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

The successful candidate will have a proven track record in selling cybersecurity technologies, introducing disruptive cyber software solutions, and exceeding sales quotas consistently.   • Introduction of New Solutions: Demonstrated success in introducing and selling new disruptive cyber software solutions

  • Channel Partner Management: Experience in establishing and monetizing strong Channel Partner relationships, with existing relationships in the region being essential.

  • Sales Process Management: Proficiency in managing all aspects of the sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, and deal closure.

  • Sales Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience working in a Sales role in cybersecurity

  • Education: A college degree or equivalent work experience required

  • Fluent in French and excellent English communications skills

Travel Required

Perks of Horizon3

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. title: Enterprise Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Why is this segment interesting?

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis, both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of experience in Sales, including at least 2 years managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

What we are looking for:

Semperis is looking for a passionate and results-driven Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our EMEA team.

Fluent German and English language skills are required for this role.

What you will be doing:

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Semperis, you will ensure your customers' success and satisfaction with our products and support them every step of the way. You will be an essential member of our Customer Success team, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including Technical Delivery and Sales teams to maximise opportunities for our Enterprise Business customers and Semperis.

Our Customer Success Managers are strategic and empathetic communicators who can convey complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. Our CSM will build and nurture long-lasting relationships across multiple client accounts. Our CSM’s strengths include the ability to identify gaps in the product and internal operations and build effective and scalable solutions to address them. Our CSM will also onboard new customers, ensuring a smooth and successful implementation of our solutions.

You will be responsible for:

  • Design a success plan for a Book of Business of strategic customers throughout their lifecycle. From onboarding and implementation through upsell, cross-sell, and renewal, you will guide your customer down the path of success every step of the way to reach their business objectives and operational goals

  • You will be empowered to achieve and report on customer health, satisfaction, retention, and growth targets

  • Act as the voice of the customer, gather insights to provide feedback to internal teams including our Product Development team. Collaborate on new developments to ensure the product suits our client’s needs

  • Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs and is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our customers' operations

  • Monitor record-keeping to ensure that relevant customer information is captured to enable informed, personalised customer interactions with Semperis Support, Customer Success (CS), Sales, etc

  • Develop and execute programs for ongoing customer development (health checks, product upgrades, workshops, etc.)

  • Identify potential customer references and assist with development of customer case studies

  • Gain and maintain an understanding of Semperis technology, products, and services

  • In addition to managing an assigned customer segment, assist with development and enhancement of processes and systems for the overall Semperis CS program

What you will bring to the table:

Technical & Cyber Security Skills

  • Hands-on product enablement experience with a security product vendor, including running product health checks, articulating the output with expertise, configuring or tuning alert and response rules, remediating Active Directory and Entra security posture vulnerabilities

  • Understanding of security concepts (NIST IR process, MITRE Attack framework, APTs, etc.) and workflows, Active Directory and Entra ID vulnerabilities and attack patterns, IAM and Security team organisation structures

  • Strong foundational knowledge of cyber security domains:

  • Network security, endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), cloud security (CSPM/CWPP), identity (IAM/SSO/MFA), SIEM, zero-trust, threat intelligence, etc

  • Fundamental understanding of modern architectures: on-prem and cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2)

Customer-facing & Soft Skills -

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Customer Success Manager, technical account manager, or related customer-facing role in a Cybersecurity SaaS solutions company

  • Executive presence & communication: can explain complex threats or product value to CISOs, CIOs, architects, and analysts in their language

  • Storytelling with data: Turn telemetry, risk scores, and attack surface metrics into compelling business narratives

  • Project/program management: Be in tune with customer onboarding, health checks, maturity roadmaps, and expansion opportunities

  • Conflict resolution & expectation management during incidents or escalations.

  • Consultative selling & value realization: Identify use cases that justify expansion, upsell & cross-sell modules, or multi-year renewals

Business & Strategic Skills:

  • Renewal & expansion forecasting (understand ARR, NRR, consumption metrics)

  • Ability to build and Execute Customer Success Plans / Joint Success Plans with Account owners (sales reps)

  • Risk identification (technical debt, low adoption, competing solutions) and mitigation planning (QBRs, escalation paths)

  • Competitive intelligence: Know how your product differentiates from the competition

Preferences:

  • Fluent German and English language skills are requiredExperience with SFDC and Active Directory

#LI-LP1

Why Join Semperis?
You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you.

**Semperis maintains office locations in several cities across the globe. Where the job description specifies a required location, candidates will follow our hybrid work model. This includes working up to three days per week and remotely the remaining days.

Semperis is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. The information collected by the Semperis application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity, and maintain employment statistics. 

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and/or other applicable state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Semperis. Please inform Semperis representative Anna Taylor, Director of Global Recruiting, if you need assistance completing this application or to otherwise participate in the application process.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence Intern (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Aufgaben

Was du machst

Du willst wissen, wie ein Startup wirklich funktioniert, und zwar nicht aus der Vorlesung, sondern von innen? Als Entrepreneur in Residence arbeitest du eng mit dem Gründer und unseren Teams zusammen. Du springst zwischen den Bereichen und packst bei den Projekten mit an, die dich am meisten reizen: Marketing, Operations, Produkt, Customer Experience, Data oder Finance.

Was das konkret bedeutet:

  • Projekte managen: Du treibst mehrere Projekte parallel voran, mit Leuten aus dem Team und mit externen Partnern.

  • Playbooks bauen: Du verbesserst Prozesse im ganzen Unternehmen und machst sie mit AI-Tools schneller, damit wir skalieren können, ohne im selben Maß zu wachsen.

  • Die Zahlen kennen: Du analysierst Daten aus Marketing, Shop und Operations und hilfst uns, bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen.

  • Die Roadmap umsetzen: Du unterstützt die Teams im Alltag und bei den Projekten, die gerade am meisten zählen.

Das ist kein Praktikum, bei dem du Recherche-Ordner füllst. Du verantwortest das Ergebnis.

Standort: Berlin, Germany
Start: Q1/2027

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

→ Richtig viel Drive und Belege für außergewöhnliche Leistung, egal ob beruflich, sportlich, akademisch oder anderswo
