title: Event Manager
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

As Event Manager, you will be Proxima Fusion in Munich, you will plan and deliver events ranging from investor dinners and international conferences to community engagement, exhibitions and team retreats. Your will translate strategic briefs into effective event formats and independently manage delivery, from planning and budgets, to on-site production and follow-up.

This is a hands-on role combining creative judgment,meticulous project management and team spirit. You will bring event expertise to the table, advise internal stakeholders on what will work and take responsibility for turning plans into successful experiences.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Events achieve the objectives agreed with each team and provide a considered, professional experience with Proxima for our guests and stakeholders.

  • Delivery stays on schedule and within agreed budgets, with risks, dependencies and changes managed early.

  • A coordinated event portfolio gives teams visibility of upcoming activity and resource needs, while evaluation and lessons learned improve future delivery.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Translate event objectives, audiences and content briefs into strong formats, detailed delivery plans and well-designed guest experiences.

  • Independently manage events, including timelines, budgets, venues, suppliers, logistics, invitations, production, run-of-show, on-site execution and follow-up.

  • Deliver events involving investors, policymakers, industrial partners, media and other external stakeholders. These may include executive dinners, partner meetings, or events at our offices.

  • Manage Proxima’s presence at conferences, press moments, exhibitions, industry fairs and other high-profile external platforms together with the Communications team.

  • Produce community and public engagement events in Garching and Gundremmingen, working with the teams responsible for local communications and engagement.

  • Deliver meetings and events for Proxima’s industrial partnership network, including the Alpha Alliance.

  • Select, brief and manage agencies, venues and suppliers, including procurement, contract coordination and quality control.

  • Maintain an overview of Proxima’s event portfolio and forward calendar, identifying dependencies, resource conflicts and delivery risks early.

  • Track expenditure, evaluate events against agreed objectives and capture lessons that improve future delivery.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in event management or production, ideally across corporate, conference, institutional or cultural formats

  • A strong record of independently delivering complex events from initial brief through on-site production and follow-up.

  • Excellent project-management skills and the ability to manage multiple events, budgets, deadlines and external partners simultaneously.

  • The judgment to translate a strategic brief into an effective event format, combined with the confidence to advise and challenge different internal stakeholders where necessary.

  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and high-profile guests, such as executives, investors, government representatives or industrial partners.

  • Strong supplier and agency management skills, including briefing, negotiation and quality control.

  • A hands-on approach and exceptional attention to detail. You anticipate problems, remain calm under pressure and make sound decisions when plans change.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

Leitung oder Stellvertretung? Das klären wir im Gespräch. Du leitest schon eine Filiale? Top. Du warst bisher Stellvertretung oder erfahrener Verkäufer und willst den nächsten Schritt machen? Auch top. Entweder übernimmst du direkt die Leitung, oder du startest als Stellvertretung und wächst rein.

Was du mitbringst

Klingt nach deinem Ding?

Dann schnapp dir den Lenker und bewirb dich. Kein Anschreiben, kein Bewerbungs-Blabla. Dein Lebenslauf reicht.

title: Finance & Accounting Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Finance & Accounting Manager (m/f/d)

Building a finance function from zero is rare — doing it at a fast-growing robotics AI company is rarer. Sereact is scaling internationally (Germany, US, Switzerland), and our Director Accounting is looking for a smart early hire to build our finance function together: processes, systems, and standards, from day one. You'll work directly with leadership and help take the group through its first statutory audit. Based on-site at our Stuttgart headquarters.

Who We Are

Sereact builds AI that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world — in warehouses and factories. Our mission is to redefine how physical work gets done, and we're looking for curious, bold people who want to make a real difference.

Overview

Working side by side with our Director Accounting, you'll help bring bookkeeping in-house, help shape our finance systems setup (including how we use Odoo alongside DATEV), and get us ready for our first statutory audit — working closely with the founders and our external tax and audit partners. We value people who work independently, take initiative, and build rather than wait for the perfect setup.

Your Responsibilities

  • Day-to-day accounting: Own the books (general and sub-ledgers) and gradually bring bookkeeping in-house from our external provider.

  • Payments & working capital: Run accounts payable, accounts receivable, and the payment process.

  • Closing & audit: Prepare monthly and quarterly closes under HGB and support the annual financial statements, including our first-ever statutory audit.

  • Systems: Help shape our finance systems and decide the target setup — whether Odoo replaces DATEV or runs first as a subledger alongside it.

  • Partners: Be the day-to-day counterpart to our tax advisors and auditors.

  • Process & automation: Build our finance processes and first automations hand in hand with our Director Accounting, including group-wide topics around our US and CH entities.

Qualifications

  • A degree (business, finance, or a related field) is preferred — but above all we're looking for smart, analytical people who learn fast. Solid HGB fundamentals and hands-on DATEV (or comparable) experience matter more to us than a specific certificate.

  • Experience with monthly and annual closes; IFRS knowledge is a plus.

  • A hands-on, builder mindset — you like building from scratch and don't wait for finished processes or a team. No need for a perfect résumé.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and fast change and structure things yourself — pragmatic over perfectionist, but with a clear sense of when rigor matters (closing, audit).

  • Tool- and automation-savvy; you use modern tools and AI as a matter of course (Odoo or ERP experience is a plus).

  • Fluent German and good English.

Our Interview Plan

  1. Application: Apply via our careers page with your CV — a few lines on why this role interests you are welcome.

  2. Technical fit interview, including a live case study (40 min): A deeper dive into your accounting know-how and problem-solving approach. Together we'll work through a short, role-relevant case — no prep needed, we're interested in how you think.

  3. Cultural fit interview (40 min): A conversation about how you work, what motivates you, and what you're looking for. Expect CV highlights, your “why,” and time for your questions.

  4. On-site visit in Stuttgart, including a founder interview: Meet the team in our office, talk with one of our founders, and get a clear feel for the role and environment.

What We Offer

  • Real ownership: build the finance function from scratch together with our Director Accounting, with direct exposure to the founders.

  • Grow with the function: as Sereact scales, your scope and responsibilities grow with it.

  • Wellpass (gym membership)

  • Flexible working hours

  • Home office when you need it

  • A motivated team and an open company culture

  • Competitive compensation

Sounds like you? We'd love to hear from you — even if you don't tick every box.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will sit exactly where sales, customer success and engineering meet. When a larger customer signs, you make sure they get precisely the product they need, and that it goes live. You understand their finance and operations setup, configure and extend Agent F for it, drive the data migration and the integrations, run the project to go-live and stay until the expansion works.

This is operational work inside customer projects. You will be the technical counterpart for the customer’s finance, IT and operations teams, the person who knows what was promised and what is possible, and the one who brings back to engineering (as clear, prioritised requirements) whatever cannot be solved on site. On key accounts the CEO is in the room and the whole team pulls through together.

Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain. For you, that means time to live and the ARR of the accounts you bring live.

What you will build and own

  • Implementation projects. Own scope, plan and delivery from kick-off to verified go-live for your accounts: stakeholders, timeline, risks, decisions.

  • Migration and integration. Map the customer’s data, run the imports, reconcile totals against the source and connect Agent F to the systems the customer keeps. Verify the result with the customer before go-live.

  • Configuration and extension. Workflows, rules, automations and custom logic on the platform, set up for the customer’s way of working.

  • Customer-facing technical lead. Run the technical workstreams with the customer’s finance, IT and operations teams; document decisions and keep everyone informed.

  • Product feedback. Turn what customers need into specified, prioritised requirements for engineering; validate delivered features with the customer.

  • Expansion readiness. Identify and prepare the next step in each account (the next entity, module or process) together with the account owner.

  • FDE economics. Track the hours you deliver per account against what was sold and keep delivery inside the agreed effort.

For example, a corporate subsidiary signs with a go-live date tied to its next month-end. You would scope the migration, map and import the history, reconcile it with the customer’s controller, configure the approval workflows, connect the bank feed, and run the first close with them (inside the SLA) while logging the two product gaps you found as clear requirements for engineering.

What you bring

You have five or more years in technical implementation, solutions consulting or IT project management for business software (ERP, accounting, finance or operations systems) with real customer projects behind you. You are hands-on with data, mappings, configuration and integrations and comfortable reconciling a migration yourself. You do not need to be a software engineer.

You can walk us through an implementation you ran: what the customer needed, what went wrong, how you got to go-live and what you would do differently. You are calm with customers, precise with engineers and stubborn about go-live.

Core experience

  • Implementation or technical project management of ERP, accounting, finance or operations software with corporate or Mittelstand customers.

  • Data migration: mapping, import, reconciliation against the source, validation with the customer.

  • Configuration of business software: workflows, rules, permissions, integrations.

  • Working with finance teams: understanding the chart of accounts, closing processes and what has to reconcile.

  • Running projects with multiple stakeholders: plan, risks, decisions, communication.

  • Writing clear requirements for engineers and validating what they deliver.

  • German and English; daily use of AI tools in project and data work.

Useful additional experience

Experience with SQL, scripting or low-code tools; integrations with banking, payroll or procurement systems; month-end and year-end close from the inside; consulting or customer-success experience with SaaS products.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would take over an onboarding in progress, bring it live inside the SLA and document the path. You would then own your next accounts from kick-off, build the migration and configuration playbook with engineering and hand the first clear requirements into the roadmap.

We would look for customers live on time and reconciled, fewer issues after go-live, requirements that ship, and hours delivered inside what was sold.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in customers who are live and whose numbers reconcile. When a go-live blocker, a failed migration or a month-end issue puts a customer deadline at risk, you take ownership, contain the impact, work with engineering on the fix and verify the result with the customer before treating it as resolved.

Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, respond promptly and stay engaged when an onboarding commitment or a financial deadline is at risk. That requires flexibility beyond normal working hours as part of agreed coverage. You keep people informed and see the issue through to a verified recovery or an explicit handover.

How you will work

This is a founding role in a small team. You report to the CEO and work daily with the Growth & Sales Managers who own the accounts, with the Head of Sales on what was sold, and with the engineering team on what the product can do. You will use AI tools in project, data and documentation work and remain responsible for the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. Travel to customer sites is part of the role. German is required.

Start a conversation

Share an implementation you ran. Tell us what the customer needed, how you handled the migration and the configuration, what went wrong, how you got to go-live and what you learned. A short written case or a walkthrough is enough.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, DACH
descriptionHtml:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Munich — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.

This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.

You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.

The Pod Model

Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. .

Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.

We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.

What You'll Do

• Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand
• Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC
• Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like Aleph Alpha's Luminous, or sovereign EU models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it
• Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys
• Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing
• Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't
• Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades
• Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both
• Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for German-language use cases and DACH-specific regulatory environments (GDPR, EU AI Act, German data localization)
• Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live
• Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable
• Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from Germany, Austria, and Switzerland
• Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff • Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams

What We're Looking For

• CS degree or equivalent experience
• 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)
• Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)
• Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency
• Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story
• You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like
• High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count
• You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency
• Event-driven thinking and cloud-native instincts
• Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, or real-time voice/messaging systems
• Self-sufficient by default — there's no engineering team behind you. You read the code and the docs, ask the customer (not your manager), and make sound engineering judgment calls on your own
• Customer-facing engineering experience — you can run discovery with a customer's engineers and present to their executives in the same week
• Ability to translate "it's not working" into root cause
• Comfortable working on customer sites and in high-stakes technical conversations
• Excellent written and verbal communication in English and German. You can run whiteboard sessions, live troubleshooting, and escalations with customer engineering teams.
• Based in Munich, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland
• Legally authorized to work in Germany, or eligible for sponsorship

Bonus Points For

• Experience with AI voice assistants, STT/TTS, or LLM-based conversational systems
• Building eval sets for a specific domain
• Hands-on production experience with an LLM gateway — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, or an in-house OpenAI-compatible proxy — including config-driven model definitions, routing and fallback rules, and virtual key management
• Familiarity with the open-weight model landscape and the trade-offs between regional and multilingual models, including EU sovereign AI initiatives (Gaia-X, Aleph Alpha, European LLM projects)
• Experience with an inference serving engine behind the gateway — vLLM, SGLang, or TGI for production serving; Ollama for lightweight on-prem — and sizing GPU capacity for self-hosted models (KV-cache footprint, concurrent batch size, and context length against VRAM)
• SQL proficiency (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle)
• ETL and data wrangling experience
• CI/CD pipeline design and automation
• Background in telecom, CPaaS, or high-growth SaaS
• Experience with sovereign or on-prem cloud deployments and DACH regulatory frameworks (GDPR, EU AI Act, German data sovereignty and localization requirements, Swiss data protection)
• Security mindset (IAM, encryption, audit logging)

title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Retail & E-commerce
descriptionHtml:
Jij helpt retailers om AI echt onderdeel van hun dagelijkse operatie te maken.

Duizenden producten, meerdere kanalen, wisselende vraag en klanten die snel antwoord verwachten. In retail en e-commerce liggen veel kansen voor AI, maar alleen als de oplossing aansluit op processen, systemen en mensen.

Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig.

Wat ga je doen?

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

  • Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value.

  • Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

  • Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

  • Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

AI op het snijvlak van commerce, data en operatie

Je begrijpt hoe productdata, assortiment, orderstromen, fulfilment, klantenservice en commerciële sturing samenkomen. Denk aan:

  • Agents die productcontent voor duizenden artikelen verrijken en controleren.

  • Een klantenservicetoepassing die retouren en leveringsvragen niet alleen beantwoordt, maar ook de vervolgstappen voorbereidt.

  • Vraagvoorspellingen waar categoriemanagers hun beslissingen op durven te baseren.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in retail of e-commerce: je kent de processen, data en platformen van binnenuit.

  • Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security.

  • Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met PIM, OMS, ERP of commerceplatformen, en met klassieke ML zoals vraagvoorspelling.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

  • Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

  • Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team;

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

title: Forward Deployed Intern
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

title: Forward Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
À propos de nAIxt Consulting / ILLUIN Technology

nAIxt Consulting est la practice conseil d'ILLUIN Technology, société née en 2017 au cœur de CentraleSupélec, l'un des clusters IA de référence en Europe. Spécialisée dans l'IA appliquée dans les entreprises (grands groupes, comptes publics, ETI, PME), ILLUIN est pionnière du NLP francophone et mène ses propres recherches en IA générative. Nos consultants interviennent en immersion chez le client pour déployer des solutions IA à fort impact (assistants conversationnels, automatisation documentaire, analyse de données), avec la vision agnostique des technologies IA (solutions du marché, produits Illuin, des approches sur mesure).

Le rôle

Nous recherchons plusieurs Forward Deployed Strategist (FDS) pour rejoindre nôtre équipe. Dans ce rôle, vous portez la stratégie d'intégration des solutions IA (de l’automatisation des tâches ponctuelles à la vision Agentic), l'adoption et l'orchestration des transformations IA, en collaboration avec les Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE). Immergé chez le client, vous faites le lien entre les décideurs, les métiers et les équipes de delivery pour transformer le potentiel de l'IA en usages réels et mesurables.

Vous pilotez la transformation IA d'un périmètre métier. Vous construisez la stratégie d'adoption, orchestrez les acteurs (direction, métiers, IT, Data) et garantissez un impact mesurable, du cadrage des cas d'usage jusqu'à l'ancrage des nouveaux usages.

Vos missions

Stratégie & cadrage

  • Construire la feuille de route IA d'un périmètre métier et la faire vivre

  • Qualifier et prioriser le portefeuille de cas d'usage selon la valeur, la faisabilité et les risques

  • Concevoir les processus cibles intégrant l'IA et les agents, et définir les interactions entre l'humain et l'IA

  • Construire les business cases et les critères Go / No Go avec les décideurs

  • Identifier dès le cadrage les prérequis de sécurité, de gouvernance et de qualité des données

  • Éclairer les arbitrages entre produits existants et développements sur mesure (Make vs Buy)

Orchestration de la transformation

  • Dialoguer d'égal à égal avec le Delivery Manager sur l'avancement, les risques et les arbitrages priorité/délai/périmètre

  • Être en mesure d'assurer un pilotage projet de bout en bout sur des missions à faible volumétrie ne justifiant pas un Delivery Manager dédié

  • Aligner direction, métiers, IT et Data autour d'objectifs et d'un plan partagés

  • Séquencer les déploiements pour que chaque cas d'usage renforce le suivant

  • Planifier les déploiements, anticiper les dépendances et lever les blocages

  • Piloter le passage des pilotes à l'échelle avec les équipes de delivery ILLUIN

  • Préparer et animer les instances de pilotage (Coproj, Copil)

Adoption & conduite du changement

  • Concevoir la stratégie d'adoption (formation, communication, relais métiers, rituels)

  • Construire les plans de montée en compétences

  • Installer et animer des réseaux d'ambassadeurs IA chez le client

  • Identifier les résistances et mettre en place les réponses adaptées

Impact & mesure

  • Définir et suivre les KPIs d'adoption et d'impact (taux d'usage, temps gagné, qualité, économies opérationnelles)

  • Mesurer les résultats et les présenter aux décideurs en comitologie

  • Mettre en place les dispositifs de retours utilisateurs et d'amélioration continue

  • Ajuster la trajectoire de déploiement selon les signaux terrain

Vie du cabinet

  • Encadrer et faire progresser des consultants juniors en mission

  • Contribuer à la prospection commerciale, aux propositions et aux soutenances

  • Capitaliser les retours d'expérience et enrichir les méthodologies et playbooks du cabinet

Profil recherché : avant tout, vous êtes passionné(e) par l’IA et souhaitez contribuer pour la rendre véritablement utile pour les entreprises

Formation

  • Bac+5 école d'ingénieur, école de commerce ou université

  • Spécialisation ou formation complémentaire en Data / IA et/ou en conduite du changement fortement appréciée

Expérience

  • 3 à 7 ans d'expérience, dont 2 ans au moins sur des projets IA, data ou transformation numérique

  • Vous avez accompagné au moins 2 projets de déploiement IA de bout en bout, du cadrage à l'adoption

  • Vous avez déjà préparé et animé des instances de Project Management et de pilotage face à des décideurs

  • Expérience en contexte grands comptes ou cabinet de conseil est fortement appréciable

  • Anglais courant est un plus

Outils & compétences techniques

  • Fondamentaux IA (LLM, RAG, agents) suffisants pour évaluer une faisabilité et dialoguer avec les Data Scientists

  • Construction de business cases chiffrés et de grilles de priorisation

  • Construction et présentation de dashboards (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker)

  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux data, gouvernance, sécurité et éthique IA

  • Compréhension générale des architectures cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Notions de gestion de projet (planning, jalons, gestion des risques, méthodes Agile) suffisantes pour dialoguer avec un Delivery Manager et, si besoin, piloter seul un projet de moindre envergure

Compétences clés

  • Capacité à embarquer des acteurs aux intérêts parfois divergents

  • Data storytelling, vous présentez des résultats chiffrés de façon convaincante aux décideurs

  • Capacité à naviguer l'ambiguïté des grandes organisations

  • Veille IA active, vous intégrez les évolutions du marché dans vos recommandations

  • Orientation résultats, vous cherchez l'impact avant la production de livrables

How we work

We operate like athletes. High standards, high output, and we enjoy the ride together.

Meet me and Sacha (CoS) → take-home on a real problem → meet the team → offer.

title: Founding Product
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year.

Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality from top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody builds, founders included. The whole company is technical and runs on coding agents. You will not be asked to write production software, but you will use agents for discovery synthesis, specs, prototypes and data analysis rather than doing them by hand.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We’re building the AI platform freight forwarders rely on. We started with quoting and are expanding across the shipment lifecycle. As Product Lead, you will be central to that expansion, helping decide where we focus and turning those decisions into products customers depend on.

What you’ll do:

  • Own product outcomes: Own the roadmap, priorities and performance of specific products, from defining the customer problem through launch, rollout and adoption. Partner with the founders on overall product direction and strategy.

  • Build from customer insight: Work closely with freight forwarders across commercial and operational roles. Understand how they work, identify the problems customers share and build products for those needs rather than one-off solutions.

  • Prototype and build: Turn ideas into working prototypes and early product versions, using AI tools and code to test them with customers. Work hands-on with engineering to take promising ideas into production, not just write specs and hand them over.

  • Drive product expansion: Build a clear view of the market, including where we win, where we do not compete and why customers choose us. Use that understanding to identify the next workflows Nexcade should enter and turn them into products that grow revenue.

  • Raise the standard of product thinking: Define success measures, test assumptions and examine accuracy, edge cases and second-order effects before scaling. Write clear specs and decision documents, including a written recommendation on the hard calls.

  • Build the product operating system: Establish a clear planning and decision-making cadence without adding bureaucracy. Make sure product meetings are well prepared, teams have the context they need and decisions translate into shipped work.

  • Make product and platform trade-offs: Work closely with engineering to decide when to invest in shared capabilities and when a faster, product-specific approach is right.

What we look for

  • Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling.

  • Product taste: You can turn complex workflows into products that feel simple, coherent and trustworthy. You care about the details that make people choose to use them.

  • Technical fluency: You work effectively with strong engineers, understand trade-offs across architecture, AI, data and integrations and bring the customer and product perspective to choices about speed, quality and reuse.

  • Excellent judgement: You get beyond what customers ask for to understand how their work really happens and distinguish repeatable needs from bespoke requests. You use customer and market insight to make product choices that drive adoption, expansion and revenue.

  • High agency and directness: You take ownership, hold a high bar and disagree openly and constructively. You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration and changing priorities.

  • Obsess over the problem: You are drawn to complex, messy problems in industries the economy depends on and want to understand how the people and systems behind them really work. Industry experience is a bonus, but not required.

Why join

The biggest product choices are still ahead: how deep we go, where we expand and how everything fits together. Our product is already live with leading freight forwarders and this role will shape what comes next. You will build AI for the work that keeps global trade moving, alongside a team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will get meaningful equity in the company you help build.

title: Freelance System Engineer / Technical Architect
descriptionHtml:
Role Details:

Duration: 6 months

Day Rate: Dependent on experience

We're looking for a Systems Engineer / Technical Architect to help us reimagine a function of government as part of an agentic ecosystem.

You'll join a small multidisciplinary team of designers, researchers and engineers, working closely with civil servants and the department's own technical teams.
You'll own working out what the new system is. What are the constituent pieces, how do they fit together, and what’s needed to make it secure, accountable and auditable? The role suits someone who can sketch a target architecture on Monday and make it real with a prototype by Friday.

In this role you will:

  • Design the target architecture based high-level requirements and constraints, agentic capabilities and best practices

  • Recommend approaches to new challenges such as delegated authority and permissions

  • Set out security, resilience and threat risks and mitigations, including agent-specific risks such as prompt injection and automated abuse

  • Design and build the components that make the system accountable and auditable, such as audit logging and permission checks

  • Identify and test the riskiest technical assumptions

  • Build working prototypes and PoCs with the engineers

  • Produce clear architecture decision records, diagrams and patterns that teams can reuse

  • Engage with the client’s architects, security and assurance experts to get input and agreement on the right approach

  • Set out a realistic path from prototype to delivery

 

Key skills and experience

Must haves:

  • Significant experience as a technical or solution architect working on complex, ambiguous problems

  • A strong background in API design, integration patterns and event-driven or distributed systems

  • Deep knowledge of how agents interact with other parts of the system; tools, MCP servers, agent-to-agent protocols etc

  • Experience designing for security, privacy, observability and auditability from the start including threat modelling

  • Experience of authentication and authorisation, including delegated access, such as OAuth

  • Hands-on coding skills, with the ability to build working prototypes quickly

  • Cloud architecture experience (AWS, Azure or GCP) and infrastructure as code

  • The ability to explain architecture clearly to designers, policy specialists and senior stakeholders

Nice to have:

  • Experience in working on UK government services

  • Exposure to data-sharing standards and legislation, such as the Digital Economy Act

  • An agency or consultancy background

Location

You will need to be able to work from our offices (London) for a minimum of two days a week.

2. Initial screening call
A short conversation to cover the basics — your timezone, working languages, availability, and a chance for you to ask early questions about the role and how we work.

3. Technical interview (~60 minutes)
A deeper conversation about your technical background and experience. We’ll talk through how you’ve approached real problems, the decisions you’ve made, and how you’d apply that thinking to the work at IF.

4. Ways of working interview (~45–60 minutes)
A conversation about how you collaborate, communicate, and work with others — including how you operate in an advisory capacity with clients and teams.

We’ll aim to keep you updated at every stage and let you know the outcome promptly after each step.

title: Go-To-Market Strategy Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Growth at United Media

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

descriptionHtml:

In the coming years, companies will replace their internal data teams with AI agents to run more efficiently. We will be the solution they'll use. Why We Have This Role

How You’ll Grow

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Nous recrutons, pour renforcer nos équipes Sales, un.e Head of Alliances.

Missions

En tant que Head of Alliances, vous pilotez le go-to-market de VML Consulting avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify) et les innovateurs de l’IA. Point de convergence entre nos partenaires, nos équipes commerciales et nos Business Units, vous transformez la force de l’écosystème en pipeline, en différenciation et en croissance. Comme l’ensemble de l’équipe de Business Développement, vous reposez sur un profil hybride dont les 2 piliers sont d’être :

  • Responsable du go-to-market conjoint avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques : co-construction des offres, des plans d’affaires et de la démarche de co-selling autour de nos capabilities auprès de clients et prospects,
  • Orchestrateur de l’écosystème en interne : enablement des équipes, montée en compétence et certifications sur les plateformes partenaires, pour activer la bonne expertise au sein de VML Consulting et du réseau WPP

Cette hybridation est la clé du succès : être à la fois moteur du business généré via l’écosystème partenaires et garant de la capacité des équipes à délivrer avec ces technologies.

Dimension Business :

  • Définit et déploie la stratégie de go-to-market et de marketing partenaires de VML Consulting avec ses partenaires technologiques stratégiques, afin de maximiser la valeur, la différenciation et le pipeline générés par l’écosystème,
  • Construit et anime les plans d’affaires conjoints (joint business plans) avec chaque partenaire clé (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), en pilotant objectifs, jalons et indicateurs de performance partagés,
  • Orchestre le co-selling et le co-marketing : aligne partenaires, équipes commerciales et Business Units pour transformer les opportunités de l’écosystème en deals, du sourcing à la conversion,
  • Conçoit et orchestre le plan d’événements dédiés ou co-construits avec les partenaires (webinaires, ateliers, salons, temps forts commerciaux), afin de générer visibilité, demande et pipeline,
  • Met en œuvre, en continu, l’excellence de la démarche partenaires via les processus et outils internes ainsi que les portails partenaires, à des fins de visibilité, de pilotage et d’animation globale en interne,
  • Sécurise et défend les intérêts économique et contractuel de VML Consulting dans le cadre des accords de partenariat (referral, reselling, MDF, niveaux de partenariat),
  • Pilote le niveau de préférence et de mindshare de nos partenaires à notre égard : positionne VML Consulting comme partenaire de référence dans leur écosystème, fait progresser notre niveau de partenariat et suit la performance des objectifs conjoints,
  • Contribue au thought leadership de VML Consulting sur les enjeux d’écosystème et de plateformes (IA, data, commerce, CX), via des prises de parole conjointes valorisant nos réussites dans une logique de ROI business,
  • Construit et fait vivre un patrimoine de connaissances sur l’écosystème technologique (roadmaps produits, niveaux et programmes de partenariat, dispositifs de financement) afin d’accélérer et de fluidifier l’action commerciale,
  • Incarne, diffuse et fait vivre l’excellence du modèle partenaires en interne, en particulier auprès des communautés commerciale et managériale, pour l’inspirer et développer son réflexe écosystème.

Dimension Enablement & Delivery :

  • Travaille de concert avec le CTO, à qui revient la responsabilité de l’enablement, des certifications et de la montée en compétences des équipes sur les plateformes partenaires ; il s’assure que ces chantiers progressent au rythme des priorités business et des engagements pris auprès des partenaires,
  • Veille à la disponibilité et à la capitalisation des assets conjoints (cas clients, références, supports de co-vente) et au partage des retours d’expérience.

Profil recherché

Vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d’expérience, dont une expérience significative en alliances / partenariats technologiques, channel ou business development – idéalement acquise en cabinet de conseil, ESN, agence ou chez un éditeur / hyperscaler.

Notre croissance reposant sur un écosystème de partenaires technologiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de co-selling, de co-marketing et de joint business planning.

Vous pouvez justifier de contributions ou de succès significatifs dans le cadre d’initiatives partenaires ou de développement business, au-delà d’en comprendre la logique ou les bonnes pratiques.

Votre capacité à nouer des relations de grande qualité, tant avec les équipes partenaires (alliance managers, channel, avant-vente) qu’avec les décideurs internes (Directions commerciales, Business Units, Marketing), fait de vous un orchestrateur d’écosystème performant, du sourcing d’opportunités à la conclusion de deals conjoints équilibrant les intérêts du partenaire, du client et de VML Consulting.

Les enjeux des plateformes technologiques et de l’écosystème IA / data / commerce vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer sur vos expériences pour bâtir un discours solide en interne comme auprès des partenaires.

Votre rigueur et votre curiosité font de vous un acteur à la fois à l’aise dans la logique de développement business sur des clients existants que sur de la conquête opportuniste, ou en relai d’un partenaire.

La maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, est indispensable : vous adressez des partenaires et des interlocuteurs internationaux de manière totalement autonome.

Intégrer VML Consulting, c’est choisir d’évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, humain et innovant, propice au développement de chacun, à la réalisation de missions enrichissantes et aux évolutions de carrière. title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

title: Head of Finance (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über diese Rolle

Du willst nicht nur Zahlen berichten, sondern mitentscheiden, wie ein Unternehmen wächst?

Als Head of Finance (m/w/d) sorgst du dafür, dass wir jederzeit wissen, wo wir finanziell stehen: wie viel Liquidität wir haben, mit welchen Produkten und Kanälen wir Geld verdienen und wie viel wir in Marketing, Ware und neue Märkte investieren können. Du lieferst die Zahlen, auf deren Basis wir entscheiden, und sorgst dafür, dass unser Wachstum solide finanziert ist.

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes E-Commerce Scale Up mit Sitz in der Speicherstadt Hamburg. Unsere Mission ist es, Kinder mit innovativen Produkten für das lebenslange Lernen zu begeistern und das Leben von Millionen Familien liebevoller und bunter zu gestalten.

Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte aktiv die Zukunft eines dynamischen Unternehmens mit!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Liquidität & Cashflow: Du verantwortest unsere rollierende Liquiditätsplanung, damit wir jederzeit wissen, wie viel Geld für Marketing, Wareneinkauf und Saisonspitzen zur Verfügung steht.

  • P&L & Controlling: Du pflegst unsere monatliche P&L auf und zeigst mit dem Deckungsbeitrag von DB1 bis DB4, mit welchen Produkten und Kanälen wir Geld verdienen.

  • Abschluss & Finanzierung: Du verantwortest Bilanz und Jahresabschluss gemeinsam mit dem Steuerberater und führst die Gespräche mit Banken und Finanzierungspartnern.

  • Automatisierung: Du automatisierst unsere Finance-Prozesse, damit die Zahlen schnell und verlässlich vorliegen.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in Finance oder Controlling, idealerweise davon mehrere Jahre in einer 8-stelligen D2C E-Commerce Brand.

  • Du verstehst die Dynamiken im E-Commerce: Ad Spend, Saisonalität, Wareneinkauf in Asien sowie Payouts von Shopify und Amazon.

  • Du baust komplexe Finanzmodelle selbst in Google Sheets oder Excel.

  • Du arbeitest hypothesengetrieben und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von harten Daten statt Bauchgefühl.

Deine Vorteile

  • Attraktive Vergütung & echte Aufstiegschancen – Leistung wird gesehen und außergewöhnlicher Einsatz auch außergewöhnlich belohnt.

  • Karriere ohne Politik & Hierarchien – Kein langes Warten auf Beförderungen – wenn du wächst, wächst die Verantwortung mit dir.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten, das zu dir passt – Remote, hybrid oder im Office – du entscheidest.

  • Teamreisen & coole Offsites – Team-Events, Workations & eine Kultur, in der Leistung und Spaß zusammenpassen.

  • Modernste Ausstattung – MacBook, höhenverstellbarer Schreibtisch & alles, was du für Höchstleistung brauchst.

  • Modernes Office in der Speicherstadt Hamburg – Ein inspirierender Arbeitsplatz mit Blick auf die Elbphilharmonie im Herzen der Stadt.

Wir freuen uns auf dich! Damit wir jede Bewerbung fair und sorgfältig prüfen können, nehmen wir Bewerbungen ausschließlich über dieses Bewerbungsportal entgegen. Wir bitten um dein Verständnis, dass wir per E-Mail eingesandte Bewerbungen nicht einzeln berücksichtigen können.

title: Head of Insurance Supply
descriptionHtml:
🍇 About grape: Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first. At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you!

Your role

As Head of Insurance Supply, you will own grape’s carrier and reinsurance partnerships. You will build and diversify our capacity panel, secure the structures behind existing and new products, and ensure our insurance supply grows with the business.

Today, this responsibility is led by our CEOs. You will take it over, build it into a dedicated function and represent Insurance Supply as a member of grape’s Leadership Team.


What you’ll do:

1. Build and diversify our capacity panel

  • Develop grape’s capacity strategy for Switzerland and Liechtenstein.
  • Identify, qualify, negotiate with and onboard new carriers and reinsurers.
  • Lead relationships from the first conversation through due diligence, commercial negotiation and signed agreement.
  • Secure the contracted capacity required for grape’s annual business plan and written commitments for the following year.
  • Diversify the panel to support growth, enable new products and reduce concentration risk.

    • 2. Build strong carrier partnerships

  • Own carrier and reinsurer relationships at operational, commercial and executive level.
  • Establish a clear governance cadence, including operational reviews, strategic meetings and annual capacity negotiations.
  • Own commercial terms, contracts, renewals, outsourcing agreements and service levels.
  • Monitor partnership performance, resolve issues early and build relationships that grow over time.
  • Represent grape credibly across the insurance, reinsurance and broking market.

    • 3. Shape products and build the function

  • Design and secure the carrier and reinsurance structures required for new products.
  • Evaluate pricing, loss ratios, reserving, commissions, capital requirements and solvency implications.
  • Work closely with Actuarial, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product and Distribution.
  • Own the Insurance Supply strategy, priorities, OKRs, processes and reporting.
  • Provide the Leadership Team with a clear view of capacity coverage, pipeline and risk.
  • Hire and lead a Carrier Partnerships Manager as the function grows.

    • What you’ll bring:
  • At least eight years of insurance experience, including carrier partnerships, MGA capacity management, programme business, reinsurance broking or business development at a carrier.
  • A demonstrated track record of taking capacity relationships from initial contact through negotiation to a signed binding authority, treaty or comparable agreement.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to negotiate with senior stakeholders across carriers, reinsurers, MGAs and brokers.
  • A strong understanding of insurance portfolio economics, including loss ratios, reserving, pricing, capacity and capital implications.
  • Experience building long-term external partnerships and a relevant network across the carrier, reinsurance or broking market.
  • The ability to move between strategy, relationship building, negotiation and operational detail.
  • Fluent English.

    • Strong advantage:
  • Experience working within an MGA or directly with MGA and programme structures.
  • Knowledge of Swiss and Liechtenstein employee insurance, particularly KTG, UVG and UVG-Z.
  • Familiarity with the Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory environment.
  • German or French proficiency.
  • Experience building or leading a capacity or carrier-partnerships function.
    • If you have built insurance capacity partnerships in another European market and can transfer that experience to Switzerland and Liechtenstein, we would still like to hear from you. 🤝 What we offer in return: 🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions. 💻 Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office. 🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home. 🌐 Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office. ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to. 🧠 Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually ❤️‍🩹 Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy. 🎫 Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams. ✈️ Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues. 🚂 Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office. 🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days. 🧖‍♀️ Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs. 👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life. ✈️ Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review). 🏁 Our recruitment process We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps: Step 1 - Your motivation To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team. Step 2 - Role fit In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager. Step 3 - Case study For roles with higher technical demands, we will invite you to complete a case study or technical assessment. This allows us to better evaluate your specific skills and problem-solving abilities. Step 4 - Our culture connect Throughout the interview process, you'll gain insight into our company culture, and we'll explore how your values and mindset align with our ways of working. The final interview will offer a deeper look into this connection, along with broader discussions about the role and our vision. Our diverse experiences, perspectives, and voices make us the company we are, and we would love to learn more about you! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- Health is our foundation. Innovation drives our mission. Together, we’re building the future of employee insurance. At grape, collaboration isn’t just a buzzword, it’s the foundation of how we work, live, and succeed. From bold brainstorms and lessons learned, we overcome challenges side by side. Our time together is our greatest asset. Disrupting an industry that truly needs change takes courage, creativity, and team spirit and that’s exactly what defines us. With well-being at the core, we foster an environment where ideas and people thrive. Your growth matters as much as our mission. Whether it’s supporting your self-care, developing new solutions, or redefining how health and insurance connect, we grow together. Our values guide us every step of the way: keeping Health at Heart, Inventing Together, and always striving to Embrace Clarity.

title: Head of Software
descriptionHtml:
We can't hire everyone… but we can help them shine somewhere brilliant.

At Octopus, we're lucky to attract some incredibly talented humans. And while we can’t bring every talented person into our team, we can help them land somewhere that’s just as mission-driven. That’s why we’re sharing opportunities from MOPO; a company we’ve proudly backed through a strategic investment.

MOPO is on a mission to enable renewable energy access in underserved markets. Already operating in Nigeria, DRC, Sierra Leone and Liberia, our solar power stations distribute energy through proprietary MOPO batteries managed by a network of local agents. Our model is already powering thousands of homes and small businesses, reducing reliance on fossil fuels and enabling livelihoods. With backing from Octopus Energy, British International Investment, and Norfund, MOPO is scaling rapidly and is positioned to transform energy access and e-mobility across the continent.

Joining our growing team, you’ll provide hands-on technical leadership and people management for the software team behind MOPO’s core software products: our Android Rental App and the MOPO Platform, a web application built with Django, Python and Vue.js. Together, these tools enable our network of local agents to manage battery distribution and customer relationships across our markets.

You’ll manage four engineers, two platform engineers and two mobile app engineers, helping them develop their skills, solve challenging problems and deliver reliable software. We have been steadily growing our team and this expansion is likely to continue. Working closely with product managers and stakeholders across the business, you’ll connect engineering decisions to the needs of our agents, customers and operations teams.

You’ll own and develop our engineering ways of working. We currently use an Agile/Kanban approach, and we’re looking for someone who can build on that foundation as we grow: improving how we plan, collaborate and deliver, while keeping processes practical and proportionate to the team.

We’re a small, growing team supporting an expanding product range across multiple markets in Sub-Saharan Africa. Things move quickly, so you’ll need the flexibility and pragmatism to keep delivery moving, alongside the judgement and confidence to challenge priorities and push back on unrealistic expectations.

Working location

The role is based primarily in our Sheffield HQ, with up to two days working from home if desired. Occasional international travel to Sub-Saharan Africa is entirely optional, but is something they offer to all of their employees if they are interested.
