title: Head of Supply Chain Delivery
descriptionHtml:
About Plentific

Plentific is pioneering real-time property operations for real-world impact. Our platform connects property owners, operators, service providers and residents, and covers more than 1.7 million properties and 5,000+ service providers. We believe property repairs, maintenance and management can and should work better for everyone. That means giving landlords more control, supporting trade professionals and strengthening the communities they serve.

The Role

Our clients, mainly social housing providers and local authorities, rely on Plentific's contractor network to deliver their repairs and maintenance works on time and to standard.

We're looking for a Head of Supply Chain Delivery to lead that team. You'll be responsible and accountable for how we deliver supply chain mobilisation for social landlord's supply chain needs, and for contractor performance and delivery. You'll lead a team of three account managers who manage our top contractors like key accounts, and you'll also run account management yourself for our key strategic contractor partners.

This is a hands-on leadership role. We're looking for someone with a repairs and maintenance contractor background in the social housing sector, ideally at or alongside a Tier 1 contractor. You'll know how contractors run their businesses, and be comfortable making decisions from data.

What you'll do

Design the delivery solution for every new mobilisation

  • Take the client's requirements from Sales and put forward the delivery solution for each mobilisation proposal.

  • Make these decisions using the data including pricing rate benchmarks, contractor capacity and workload by trade and region.

  • Agree rates and SLAs with the contractors and negotiate on deliverables and pricing.

  • Oversee the contractor mobilisation through to delivery, stepping in on escalations.

Own contractor performance across the network

  • Own SLA attainment, aged WIP and escalations across our contractor network.

  • Accountable for contractor's performance per client against baseline KPIs, so every contractor is held to account for how they perform for each client.

  • Put improvement plans in place for under-performers, and route more work, projects and works packages to the contractors who perform well.

Lead the contractor account management team

  • Accountable for contractor monthly account management calls covering KPIs, aged WIP plans, pricing and quote health, capacity and growth, and platform adoption.

  • Set clear goals, KPIs for the team and review progress against them regularly.

Build strategic contractor relationships

  • Hold director-level relationships with our strategic Tier 1 contractors and join their monthly account calls.

  • Understand each strategic contractor's capacity, growth plans and interest in new regions or trades, and turn that into more work through Plentific.

  • Share what you hear from contractors so we keep improving our platform and our way of working.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in repairs and maintenance, construction or facilities management, including time at or alongside a Tier 1 contractor. You understand how contractors run their businesses: operatives, scheduling, pricing and margins.

  • Experience leading and developing a team, with clear goals and regular performance conversations.

  • Commercial confidence: you can price work against a schedule of rates and negotiate rates and SLAs with contractors.

  • Data literate. You're comfortable working with dashboards and KPIs, and you make decisions from data rather than relationships alone.

  • You build trusted relationships with contractor directors and senior stakeholders.

  • Highly organised, able to run several mobilisations at once against tight deadlines.

  • Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work, and keen to find new ways they can save time.

Nice to Have

  • Understanding of public procurement regulations and how frameworks operate within housing repairs

  • Experience with FSM or work order management tools

  • Experience in running competitive tenders and structuring contracts with subcontractors

Why Plentific

You'll join a scale-up with ambitious growth plans and the backing to deliver them, in a role where your deals directly shape how the sector manages its homes.

  • Flexible working, including a work abroad scheme

title: Inbound Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

title: Information Security Engineer - Infrastructure Security
descriptionHtml:
A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role

We're looking for an Information Security Engineer who can think broadly about how infrastructure is built, attacked, defended, and improved. You may have deep experience in one area—such as endpoint security, Active Directory, Data Loss Prevention, cloud security, identity, or detection and response—but you’re motivated by solving security problems across the environment.

As an Information Security Engineer focused on infrastructure security, you'll help protect Palantir's global endpoints, servers, identity systems, applications, networks, and data flows. You'll work across teams to reduce attack surface, improve defensive controls, investigate security events, and turn security findings into durable architectural and operational improvements.

This is not just a corporate security role; the adversaries we face are sophisticated. We need someone who understands both the details and the broader system: how a weakness in one part of the environment can create risk somewhere else, how controls interact, and how to build security improvements that hold up in practice.
Core Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and improve security controls across endpoints, servers, identity systems, cloud services, SaaS applications, networks, and data flows.
  • Drive security posture improvements through hardening standards, configuration management, vulnerability remediation, access controls, monitoring, and ongoing validation.
  • Assess security risks in new platforms, products, architectures, vendors, and services, and turn findings into practical recommendations and engineering work.
  • Build and maintain automation for security operations, including configuration validation, drift monitoring, patching, access reviews, policy enforcement, alert triage, and security hygiene.
  • Partner with Identity, Infrastructure, Engineering, Legal, and other Information Security teams to strengthen security architecture and address recurring risks.
  • Turn insights from assessments, red team exercises, incident investigations, and operational reviews into durable fixes, such as configuration changes, architectural improvements, policy updates, and automation.
  • Build expertise in one or more security domains while contributing across the broader infrastructure security lifecycle.

    • What We're Looking For
  • Experience securing one or more major infrastructure domains, such as Windows, macOS, Linux, Active Directory, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, networking, identity systems, or enterprise endpoints.
  • A broad infrastructure security mindset and curiosity about systems beyond your primary area of expertise.
  • Familiarity with common infrastructure attack paths, adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, and the controls used to prevent, detect, and contain them.
  • The ability to assess complex environments and recognize how weaknesses across identity, endpoints, applications, networks, cloud services, or data flows can combine to create risk.
  • Experience evaluating security tools and validating that controls are deployed effectively and continue to work as intended.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, CI/CD, or other approaches to making security controls repeatable and scalable.

    • What We Value
  • The ability to own projects, make progress through ambiguity, and balance competing priorities while working well with colleagues.
  • Experience in complex, high-assurance, regulated, or rapidly changing environments.
  • Comfort moving between strategic problem-solving and hands-on technical work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and work with partner teams to drive remediation.
  • Contributions to security programs, tooling, automation, incident investigations, or technical research—whether public or internal.

    • What We Require
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in information security, infrastructure security, security engineering, security operations, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience securing at least one major infrastructure or security domain, with the ability and interest to work across multiple domains.
  • Active TS/SCI security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain one.
  • A strong sense of ownership, sound judgment, and integrity.
    • Life at Palantir We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please and let us know how we can help. Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

descriptionHtml:
Ingénieur de Recherche à l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée de l’ENSTA (F/H) :

Contexte :

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, recherche et innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Début 2026, l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée de l’ENSTA (UEA, i3-CRG, CNRS) s’engage dans un projet de quatre ans financé par l’Agence Innovation Défense (AID). Ce projet s’appelle RésiCheVal (Résilience des chaînes de valeur). L’UEA s’intéresse à développer les outils permettant d’évaluer la capacité des filières associées à l’industrie de défense à résister dans un environnement géopolitique incertain où l’innovation technologique permanente est souvent une condition essentielle de la supériorité des forces armées.

Activités principales

L’ingénieur de recherche sera rattaché(e) à l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée (UEA). Il est attendu des candidat(e)s d’être en mesure :

  • De contribuer à la production d’états de l’art sur les formalismes de théorie des graphes en matière d’étude des chaînes de valeur dans le domaine des biens d’armement.

  • D’accompagner la production d’outils d’aide à la décision fondés sur ces formalismes.

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion,

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.


Pour postuler et pour tout renseignement, les candidats sont invités à contacter dès à présent le Directeur et le Directeur adjoint de l’UEA, respectivement Richard LE GOFF (Le dossier de candidature devra comporter un CV détaillé avec liste des publications.

Nous recherchons une Ingénieure ou un ingénieur de recherche et développement en IA embarquée pour rejoindre le département INFRES à Télécom Paris.

Le recrutement s’inscrit dans les activités de formation et d’expérimentation en systèmes embarqués et connectés de Télécom Paris, en lien avec le financement CMA5G et les thématiques 5G, Edge AI et Internet des objets (IoT).

Le poste vise à concevoir, intégrer et maintenir des plateformes matérielles et logicielles, des bancs d’essai et des démonstrateurs utilisés dans les travaux pratiques, les projets étudiants et les expérimentations menées avec les enseignants-chercheurs.

Vos principales missions seront de :

  • Développer et maintenir des plateformes expérimentales en IA embarquée et systèmes connectés.

  • Contribuer aux prototypes, essais et démonstrateurs des activités de recherche et de formation.

  • Participer à la préparation et à l’accompagnement des travaux pratiques et projets.


Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 minimum en informatique, électronique ou systèmes embarqués. Vous maîtrisez les langages C/C++ et Python, l’environnement Linux et les outils de gestion de versions tels que Git. Vous disposez de compétences en débogage, tests et intégration matériel-logiciel, ainsi que d’une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais technique.

Des connaissances en systèmes embarqués, microcontrôleurs, firmware ou intelligence artificielle embarquée seront appréciées. Autonome, rigoureux et doté d’un bon esprit d’équipe, vous savez analyser et résoudre des problèmes. Vous possédez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, indispensables pour accompagner les apprenants, préparer des démonstrations et transmettre vos connaissances.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).

descriptionHtml:
Responsable produit / Product Owner (H/F)

CDI

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !

Qui sommes-nous ?
Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact.

Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business.

Dans le cadre de notre stratégie produit, nous recherchons un Product Owner Senior pour la verticale Service Tertiaire & B2B. Cette verticale est stratégique : elle sert de socle commun à toutes les offres du Groupe.

Elle doit devenir l'un des moteurs des innovations qui vont changer la façon dont les entreprises détectent, qualifient et développent leurs opportunités commerciales. Elle alimente aussi les autres verticales d'Intescia (Construction, Immobilier, Manufacture et Services au Territoire) avec des capacités communes : connaissance des entreprises, détection d'opportunités, enrichissement de données et intelligence artificielle.

Votre mission :

En binôme avec le Product Manager de la verticale, vous transformez la vision et la roadmap en produits livrés, utilisés et créateurs de valeur.

Vous êtes le garant du backlog et le référent produit au quotidien des équipes de développement. Vous faites le lien entre les besoins des utilisateurs, les enjeux business et les contraintes techniques, data et IA. Votre objectif : livrer de façon régulière des fonctionnalités de qualité, qui ont un vrai impact.

Les fonctionnalités que vous livrerez sur cette verticale seront réutilisées dans l'ensemble des offres d'Intescia. La qualité de conception, la modularité et la cohérence de l'expérience sont donc au cœur de votre rôle.

Vos activités :

Piloter le backlog produit

  • Traduire la vision et la roadmap en epics, user stories et critères d'acceptation clairs, testables et orientés valeur.

  • Prioriser le backlog en continu selon la valeur client, l'impact business, la faisabilité technique et la dette.

  • Garantir un backlog toujours prêt (« ready »), avec deux à trois sprints d'avance.

Animer la delivery

  • Être le référent produit des équipes Tech, Data et IA au quotidien : vous répondez aux questions, arbitrez et levez les blocages.

  • Animer ou contribuer aux rituels agiles : affinage, planification de sprint, revue, rétrospective.

  • Recetter les fonctionnalités et valider leur conformité avant mise en production.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de delivery (vélocité, délais de livraison, qualité) et contribuer à leur amélioration.

Livrer les fonctionnalités IA de nouvelle génération

Spécifier et livrer des fonctionnalités qui s'appuient sur les dernières avancées de l'intelligence artificielle :

  • Agents IA

  • Recherche conversationnelle

  • Qualification automatique des prospects

  • Recommandations intelligentes

  • Automatisation des tâches commerciales

  • Copilotes de prospection

  • Sales Engagement augmenté

  • Vous travaillez étroitement avec les équipes Data et IA pour cadrer les cas d'usage, définir les critères de qualité des modèles (pertinence, précision, explicabilité) et organiser l'expérimentation : prototypes, tests utilisateurs, déploiements progressifs.

Exploiter la richesse de la donnée Intescia

Concevoir des fonctionnalités qui valorisent concrètement les actifs data du Groupe :

  • marchés publics

  • projets privés

  • données entreprises

  • presse économique et spécialisée

  • données essentielles

  • données financières

  • signaux d'affaires

  • données ouvertes

  • enrichissements issus de l'IA

Vous veillez à la qualité, à la fraîcheur et à la bonne exposition de ces données dans les parcours utilisateurs.

Construire des briques transverses réutilisables

Vous travaillez avec les Product Owners et Product Managers des verticales Construction, Immobilier, Manufacture et Services au Territoire. Ensemble, vous spécifiez des composants, des API et des services communes autour de la recherche, du scoring, de la recommandation, des signaux d'affaires et de l'automatisation.

Vous gérez les dépendances entre équipes, assurez une documentation fonctionnelle de qualité et facilitez l'adoption de ces briques par les autres verticales.

Rester au plus près des utilisateurs

  • Participer aux entretiens utilisateurs, aux ateliers et aux tests d'usage avec les équipes Design et Customer Success.

  • Analyser les retours clients, les données d'usage et les indicateurs d'adoption pour améliorer le produit en continu.

  • Accompagner les lancements avec les équipes Sales, Marketing et Customer Success : supports, démos, notes de version.

    La rémunération sur ce poste est de 55K€ annuelle + variable.

    Le profil que nous recherchons :

Vous êtes un Product Owner expérimenté, reconnu pour la rigueur de votre delivery et pour votre capacité à transformer des besoins complexes en fonctionnalités simples et utiles.

Vous avez idéalement au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Owner dans un environnement B2B SaaS, Data ou IA.

Vous maîtrisez :

  • les méthodes agiles (Scrum, Kanban) et les outils associés (Jira, Confluence ou équivalents)

  • la rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles et de user stories

  • les échanges avec des équipes techniques, data et IA (API, modèles de données, notions de machine learning et de LLM)

  • l'analyse de données d'usage pour guider vos priorités

Vous avez un réel intérêt pour :

· l'intelligence artificielle

· les plateformes de données

  • les produits B2B

  • les outils de prospection

  • les CRM

  • les technologies d'automatisation

Vous êtes à l'aise pour arbitrer, vous communiquez avec clarté et vous aimez les environnements en forte évolution, où l'innovation est au cœur de la stratégie.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Vous livrerez concrètement la prochaine génération de solutions d'intelligence commerciale.

  • Vous serez au cœur de la stratégie IA du Groupe et mettrez en production des fonctionnalités qui changeront durablement les usages de milliers d'entreprises.

  • Votre travail ira au-delà de votre verticale : les briques que vous livrerez enrichiront les offres Construction, Immobilier, Manufacture et Services au Territoire.

  • Vous rejoindrez une équipe produit ambitieuse, avec beaucoup d'autonomie, un impact direct sur le produit et la possibilité de contribuer à une plateforme qui servira tous les métiers d'Intescia.

title: Investment Analyst (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über die Rolle

Eine gute Kaufentscheidung beginnt damit, dass jemand genau hinsieht. Bei Buena bist du das: Du verstehst das Unternehmen, hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und begründest, welchen Preis wir zahlen sollten.

Du verantwortest die Due Diligence für Hausverwaltungen, die wir übernehmen möchten: von der ersten Sichtung des Datenraums über die Bewertung und die Präsentation im Investment Committee bis zu den finanziellen und operativen Anlagen für den Kaufvertrag. Wenn das Committee ins Detail geht, kennst du das Unternehmen und kannst deine Empfehlung fundiert begründen.

Unser Prozess steht. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für die Qualität der Analysen übernimmt, die Due Diligence eigenständig steuert und unseren Prozess mit dem Wachstum weiterentwickelt.

Über Buena

Buena übernimmt Hausverwaltungen und digitalisiert sie mit selbst entwickelter Software. Wir verbinden Akquisitionen, operative Erfahrung und Technologie, um Immobilieneigentum und Verwaltung einfacher zu machen.

M&A ist ein zentraler Teil dieser Strategie. Die Unternehmen, die wir kaufen, werden Teil von Buena. Deshalb zählt unser Verständnis ihrer Zahlen, Verträge, Teams und Abläufe weit über den Abschluss einer Transaktion hinaus.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Das Unternehmen hinter dem Datenraum verstehen. Du führst Finanzdaten, Verträge, Objektlisten und Mitarbeiterinformationen zusammen. Du erkennst Lücken, gehst Widersprüchen nach und klärst offene Fragen mit den Verkäufern, bis ein belastbares Gesamtbild entsteht.

  • Die Bewertung fundiert herleiten. Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung, arbeitest mit unseren Kaufpreismodellen und prüfst die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen. Du zeigst, was deine Erkenntnisse für den Kaufpreis und die Investitionsentscheidung bedeuten.

  • Deine Ergebnisse im Investment Committee vertreten. Du verdichtest die Due Diligence zu einer klaren Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und offenen Fragen und präsentierst sie direkt vor den Entscheidungsträgern.

  • Die Details bis zum Closing begleiten. Gemeinsam mit unserem M&A-Anwalt bereitest du die finanziellen und operativen Anlagen zum Kaufvertrag vor und stellst sicher, dass die Angaben stimmen.

  • Für die Qualität einstehen. Du prüfst die Beiträge unserer Praktikant, erkennst Fehler frühzeitig und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fertige Analyse.

  • Den Prozess weiterentwickeln. Du lernst unsere Playbooks kennen, setzt sie sorgfältig um und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Datenräume, Analysen und Entscheidungen besser organisieren können.

Du passt gut zu uns wenn

  • Du bereits an Transaktionen gearbeitet hast. Idealerweise bringst du ein bis zwei Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst im Transaktionsumfeld, bei Private Equity oder Venture Capital mit. Auch fundierte Praktikumserfahrung kann relevant sein. Entscheidend ist, wie tief du in die Arbeit eingestiegen bist und welche Verantwortung du dir jetzt zutraust.

  • Deine analytischen Grundlagen sitzen. Du bist sicher in Excel, kannst Finanzdaten interpretieren und verstehst Bewertungskonzepte wie Equity Bridge und Discounted-Cashflow-Analyse.

  • Du den entscheidenden Details nachgehst. Eine Zahl, die sich nicht nachvollziehen lässt, oder eine Vertragsklausel mit unerwarteten Folgen ist für dich ein Grund, genauer hinzusehen.

  • Du dein Urteil erklären kannst. Du gehst souverän mit Rückfragen um, unterscheidest belastbare Erkenntnisse von Annahmen und änderst deine Einschätzung, wenn neue Informationen es erfordern.

  • Du Verantwortung übernimmst. Du hältst den Prozess in Bewegung, verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent und holst dir Unterstützung, wenn sie gebraucht wird.

  • Du dich in einem direkten, informellen Umfeld wohlfühlst. Du bringst sorgfältiges Arbeiten aus dem Transaktionsumfeld in ein Startup ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten.

Die Besonderheiten von Hausverwaltungen und unsere internen Abläufe kannst du bei uns lernen. Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

Warum Buena

Früh eigene Verantwortung übernehmen. Du begleitest deine Targets durch die Due Diligence und stehst für die Ergebnisse ein. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in konkrete Kaufentscheidungen ein.

Direkt mit den Entscheidungsträgern arbeiten. Du präsentierst im Investment Committee und arbeitest eng mit Kolleg aus M&A, Legal und Operations zusammen.

Mit jeder Transaktion dazulernen. Unsere volle Pipeline bietet dir immer wieder die Gelegenheit, Unternehmen zu verstehen, Risiken zu bewerten und zu sehen, wie deine Erkenntnisse einen Deal beeinflussen.

Mitgestalten wie wir Unternehmen kaufen. Unser Prozess ist strukturiert und lässt sich weiter verbessern. Sobald du ihn kennst, hast du den Freiraum, einzelne Schritte zu hinterfragen und bessere Lösungen vorzuschlagen.

So lernen wir uns kennen

Wir sprechen über deine Transaktionserfahrung, deine Herangehensweise an Due Diligence und die Verantwortung, die du als Nächstes übernehmen möchtest. Anschließend bearbeitest du einen praxisnahen Case und lernst das Team kennen, auch bei einem gemeinsamen Mittag- oder Abendessen. Referenzgespräche sind Teil der abschließenden Phase.

Du möchtest die Due Diligence hinter Buenas nächsten Akquisitionen verantworten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: iOS Developer - AI Finance Agent
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

 

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in United Kingdom. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in United Kingdom.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: IT Techical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

We are seeking a talented Technical Program Manager (IT) to own and drive our IT and DevOps IT project portfolio end-to-end.

You will work closely with a team of IT Technicians, IT Specialists, and IT Engineers, covering everything from helpdesk-driven initiatives and IT operations to office openings, automation, IT infrastructure design, CPE management, M&A integrations, and DevOps for IT.

You will ensure that the right projects move forward at the right pace, with the right people and resources. Beyond coordinating the overall portfolio, you will also take direct ownership of selected strategic projects, such as greenfield office buildouts (FDOBs) and M&A integrations.

This is a hands-on role combining portfolio management, project ownership, team coordination, and operational execution. You will help bring structure, visibility, and consistency to our IT project delivery while remaining close enough to the technical work to make things happen.

If you enjoy driving complex technical projects, coordinating diverse teams, and building scalable processes in a fast-growing environment, this role offers the opportunity to have a direct impact on how Mistral scales its IT operations globally.

What You Will Do

Portfolio and Program Management

  • Own the IT project portfolio, maintaining a single and accurate view of all projects, including their status, priorities, risks, and dependencies.

  • Drive planning and prioritization sessions with the IT Manager, ensuring alignment between the project portfolio and broader business and IT objectives.

  • Run regular project reviews and status reporting, proactively identifying risks, blockers, and delays while defining clear remediation plans.

  • Ensure projects are thoroughly executed, covering proper scoping, documentation, testing, handover, and closure, including post-launch validation.

Resource and Team Coordination

  • Manage resource allocation across projects in collaboration with the IT Manager, balancing workload, skills, and availability across IT Technicians, Specialists, and Engineers.

  • Identify capacity conflicts and propose trade-offs or changes in project sequencing to ensure efficient delivery.

  • Support and coach team members on project execution, helping them write project briefs, break down work, and define milestones and acceptance criteria.

  • Coordinate with stakeholders outside IT, including Facilities, HR, Security, Finance, and external vendors, on cross-functional projects.

  • Manage external vendors and integrators involved in IT projects, including statements of work, delivery follow-up, and acceptance.

Hands-On Project Ownership

  • Directly own and lead selected strategic projects, including:

    • FDOBs (Fit-outs / New Office Buildouts): Drive the end-to-end delivery of IT infrastructure and services for new office locations.

    • M&A Activities: Lead IT due diligence, Day 1 integration planning, and the full IT, identity, and network integration of acquired companies.

    • SEV and Incident Management: Support the coordination and management of critical incidents and ensure effective follow-up.

  • Be hands-on when needed, with the ability and willingness to contribute technically to delivery across endpoint setup, networking fundamentals, identity tooling, and documentation.

  • Define and maintain project standards, templates, and playbooks, such as office opening checklists and M&A integration runbooks, enabling the team to replicate successful project delivery.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in technical program or project management within IT, ideally across IT infrastructure, operations, or corporate IT environments.

  • Proven track record of managing a portfolio of concurrent technical projects across teams with different levels of seniority and expertise.

  • Hands-on IT background, with the ability to discuss and occasionally contribute to endpoint management, networking, identity (SSO/MDM), and automation topics.

  • Experience with at least some of the following: office openings and buildouts, workplace and IT infrastructure rollouts, M&A integrations, or DevOps-for-IT initiatives.

  • Strong command of project management methodologies, including Agile and traditional/Waterfall approaches, with a pragmatic mindset rather than rigid adherence to frameworks.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to write clear and concise status reports, run effective meetings, and communicate confidently with both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills.

  • Highly organized, rigorous, and persistent, with a strong sense of ownership and a focus on seeing projects through to completion.

  • Fluent in English. French is a plus.

Bonus:

  • Previous experience as a Sysadmin, IT Support Technician, or Engineer before moving into program management.

  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Linear, Asana, and Notion, as well as ITSM tooling.

  • ITIL Foundation certification or similar.

  • Experience managing external vendors and integrators, including project budget tracking.

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

title: Junior Procurement Trader
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You Will Do

  • Make deals: negotiate prices, contracts and work closely with our Sales team to identify and seize market opportunities.

  • Establish and maintain international supplier relationships as part of our strategic procurement, purchasing a seven-figure trading volume per month.

  • Find new partners internationally, for example via trade shows or cold calls, and build these up into long-lasting relationships.

  • Resolve issues with internal and external stakeholders that block revenue.

  • Follow spot market trades, price dynamics and trends, and act on them at high speed.

  • Work with advanced AI tools that keep you a step ahead of the market.

Who You Are

  • You think like a trader. You like buying and selling and ideally have made money before, for example through trading, your own business, a side hustle or a sales role.

  • You want to win. You chase deals and results without waiting to be pushed.

  • You act fast. You decide and follow up.

  • You have a natural curiosity. You always ask how and why, and you learn fast from every conversation.

  • You are comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external parties in real-life meetings or (video) calls.

Background

  • You are fresh out of university, or you have a couple of years of work experience in a commercial role, for example sales or trading. Any industry works.

  • Self-employment, your own business or a side hustle is very welcome. We look for people who drive commercial value, understand trade and know how to create revenue.

Required Qualifications

  • You have a university degree.

  • You have strong analytical and negotiation skills, and can clearly articulate complex subjects with confidence and precision.

  • You bring a hands-on mentality: you take ownership, solve problems independently, and thrive in dynamic settings.

  • You are curious about AI and how it changes the way we trade.

  • German post: You speak German at C2 level (mandatory) and English fluently.

  • English post: you speak English fluently. Italian is a plus, and so is any other European business-fluent language.

What’s In It for You

  • Real ownership from day one - shape operational processes in a fast-scaling, AI-first company.

  • Learn from the best - work directly with senior operators, interact with skilled industry leaders and CEOs on a daily basis

  • Competitive compensation - attractive base salary and performance-based bonus program.

  • Personal growth & visibility - rapid learning opportunities, cross-functional exposure, and early leadership potential in a growing global team.

  • Vibrant company culture – modern Berlin office, monthly All-Hands, team events, and regular offsites.

Why Join

You’ll be joining a company that’s not only transforming a global industry but doing so with the speed, precision, and intelligence of AI.
Here, you won’t just manage supply chains - you’ll help redefine how global commerce operates.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Compensation: €70K – €90K

title: Laser Architect (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply.

We are seeking a Laser Architect to join our dynamic laser development team. The Laser Architect is the system‑level technical lead responsible for the conceptual design, modeling, and experimental validation of laser driver architectures for inertial fusion energy (IFE) at the research and pre‑pilot stage.

This role focuses on defining and evolving credible laser driver concepts that can ultimately support fusion energy production, while operating primarily at the R&D and demonstrator level, where performance exploration, risk reduction, and physics‑driven trade studies dominate over industrial optimization.

The Laser Architect ensures coherence between laser physics, system architecture, and fusion requirements, guiding the transition from laboratory concepts toward scalable driver solutions. They enable the transition of inertial fusion energy from proof‑of‑principle laser experiments toward credible, scalable driver concepts, shaping the technical foundations on which future pilot plants and commercial systems will be built.

What you'll do:

  • Define and refine laser driver concepts suitable for IFE.

  • Explore alternative architectures and assess their feasibility through modeling and experiments.

  • Maintain ownership of the global architectural vision, even as individual subsystems evolve in parallel.

  • Define the laser R&D roadmap, including critical component development/evaluation, integrated beamline demonstrators, and intermediate testbeds

  • Work closely with experimental teams to ensure results feed back into architectural decisions

  • Support design of diagnostics and test protocols aligned with future scaling needs.

Who you are:

  • PhD or equivalent experience in laser physics, optical engineering, or related fields

  • Deep expertise in high‑energy and/or high‑average‑power laser systems

  • Strong background in laser system modeling and scaling analysis

  • Demonstrated experience in conceptual design and experimental validation of complex laser systems

  • Ability to operate across physics, optics, and systems‑level reasoning

  • Ability to bridge theoretical modeling and experimental reality

  • Operates as a system thinker with strong physics intuition

  • Comfortable exploring multiple architectural paths in parallel

  • Values quantitative modeling, experimental feedback, and iterative refinement

  • Communicates technical trade‑offs clearly to scientists, engineers, and leadership

What we offer:

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a subsidized canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 15% on top of your monthly contributions.

  • Equipment: Choose between a state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptop. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

title: Lead Engineer - Travel FX App
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Lead Growth Marketing / Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - D2C E-Com
descriptionHtml:
Hast du schonmal gesehen, wie jemand beim Auspacken einer schön gestalteten Deko-Box die Augen leuchten lässt?

Hast du schonmal beobachtet, wie Menschen ihre ganz eigene Floristik-Kreation erschaffen und plötzlich Stolz und Freude auf einmal real werden?

Hast du schonmal ein Produkt in der Hand gehabt, das so durchdacht war, dass es Menschen einfach Lust macht, kreativ zu werden?

Ja? Nein?

Jeden Tag versuchen Menschen, ihre Wohnräume schöner zu gestalten — ohne professionelle Floristik-Kurse zu brauchen oder stundenlang Material zusammenzusuchen. Genau dafür entwickeln wir bei Flowers & Me wunderschöne DIY Deko-Boxen: durchdacht, inspirierend, einfach zum Selbermachen. Unsere Vision ist simpel: Wir wollen Menschen die Freude am Selbermachen leichter zugänglich machen und ihnen zeigen, dass sie selbst Designer ihrer Räume sind.

Und jetzt stehst du an einem Punkt, an dem deine Arbeit genau das möglich macht. Flowers & Me hat gerade erst begonnen. Wir skalieren von quasi Null auf 5 Millionen — und Performance Marketing ist der Hebel, der das möglich macht. Du baust das System, das uns von einer kleinen, ambitionierten Gründermarke zu einem europäischen Player entwickelt. Neue Märkte, neue Kundinnen und Kunden, exponentielles Wachstum.

Mit deiner Arbeit entscheidest du mit, ob Millionen Menschen die Freude am Selbermachen entdecken — oder ob sie es nie erfahren.

Aufgaben

Ja, wir zahlen fair, du arbeitest flexibel und hybrid, und du hast kurze Wege direkt zu Christian und unserem Gründerteam. Das ist für uns selbstverständlich.

Wichtiger ist: Du baust hier wirklich etwas – kein fertiges Setup, das du nur verwaltest. So gehst du es an:

  • Ownership: Du verantwortest Acquisition und Retention bei Flowers & Me und elvent und baust ein profitables, skalierbares Growth-System über den gesamten Funnel – mit klarem Fokus auf Wiederkauf, LTV und Brand-Wachstum.
  • Kanalsteuerung & Sparring: Du steuerst unser internes Meta-Team und unsere Google-Agentur strategisch, briefst, challengst und stellst Profitabilität sowie Wachstum sicher – ohne im Daily Doing zu versinken.
  • Strategie: Du entwickelst eine tragfähige Wachstumsstrategie inklusive Kanalpriorisierung, Retention-Hebeln, Testlogik und EU-Roadmap.
  • Brand & Community: Du baust eine konsistente Markenführung über alle Touchpoints (Ads, Newsletter, WhatsApp, Content) auf und entwickelst eine Community, die langfristig bei uns bleibt.
  • CRM & Retention (hands-on): Du baust Klaviyo-Flows, WhatsApp-/ChatArmin-Kanäle und Newsletter selbst auf und entwickelst sie weiter – Welcome, Post-Purchase, Winback, Replenishment, Cross-Sell und Reaktivierung mit messbarem Impact auf LTV und Wiederkaufrate.
  • Automatisierung: Du etablierst automatisierte Reporting- und Entscheidungsworkflows für schnellere, sauberere Performance-Entscheidungen über Acquisition und Retention hinweg.
  • KI-Einsatz: Du nutzt KI für Content-Produktion, Lokalisierung, Übersetzung und Lifecycle-/Creative-Workflows – mit Blick auf Qualität, Brand Fit und Skalierbarkeit über Märkte hinweg.
  • Leadership & Teamführung: Du führst das bestehende Marketing-Team (Meta-Spezialist, Videograf, Werkstudent) disziplinarisch, baust neues Personal auf und arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam an Unternehmenszielen, Budgetlogiken und Prioritäten.

Und ganz ehrlich: Das wird nicht nur bequem. Du wirst mit schnellwechselnden Trends, saisonalen Peaks, vielen Prioritäten und hohem Tempo umgehen. Nicht jedes Setup wird perfekt sein. Genau deshalb suchen wir dich – jemanden, der Klarheit schafft, Systeme baut und pragmatisch entscheidet.

Qualifikation

  • Bisherige Stationen: Du hast eine D2C-/Subscription-Brand idealerweise im Bereich 5–30 Mio. € Umsatz wesentlich mit aufgebaut bzw. skaliert und kannst konkrete Wachstums-, Retention- und Profitabilitätsbeispiele nennen.
  • Level: Du bist strategisch stark, bleibst aber hands-on. Du baust eine Roadmap und gehst trotzdem tief in Klaviyo, WhatsApp/ChatArmin, Newsletter, Reporting oder Briefings.
  • Meta & Paid Social (Steuerung): Du hast relevante Meta-Budgets gesteuert oder eng begleitet, kannst Creative-Testing-, Account- und Skalierungslogik auf Augenhöhe mit Spezialist:innen besprechen und challengen – ohne täglich selbst im Ads Manager zu sitzen.
  • Google / Shopping / PMax: Du bringst ein solides Verständnis für Search, Shopping, Feed-Qualität, PMax und Suchintention mit und kannst eine Agentur entlang klarer Profitabilitäts-KPIs sauber steuern.
  • Brand & Marketing Psychology: Du verstehst, wie Marken psychologisch aufgebaut werden, Community entsteht und Kund:innen langfristig bleiben – und übersetzt das in konsistente Tonalität, Story und Touchpoints.
  • CRM / Retention (hands-on): Du hast Klaviyo-Flows, WhatsApp/ChatArmin-Setups und Newsletter selbst gebaut und weißt, wie Welcome-, Post-Purchase-, Winback-, Replenishment- und Cross-Sell-Flows LTV und Wiederkaufrate konkret hebeln. GA4, GTM und CAPI sind für dich kein Nebenthema.
  • Mindset & Leadership: Du denkst unternehmerisch, priorisierst nach Impact, sprichst Klartext und übernimmst gerne disziplinarische Führung über ein bestehendes, kleines Team mit Spezialist:innen.
  • Sprachen: Mit sehr gutem Deutsch und Englisch steuerst du Kampagnen, Märkte und Lokalisierung sauber.

Bist du an Bord?

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Homeoffice- und Remote-Möglichkeit nach Abstimmung
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Zusätzliche Urlaubstage
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Flowers & Me Boxen (und wer liebt es nicht, selbst zu kreieren?)
  • Fitnessabo
  • Kostenlose Getränke und Snacks
  • Kostenloses Parken
  • Haustiere erlaubt

Also, bewirb dich noch heute

Wenn du Lust hast, Performance Marketing bei elvent und Flowers & Me nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern wirklich zu bauen, dann sollten wir sprechen.

Bewirb dich über unser Bewerbungsformular und hilf uns dabei, die Freude am Selbermachen noch mehr Menschen zugänglich zu machen.

Ansprechpartner: Christian Perian
