title: M&A – Praktikum / Intern (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Die Steuerberatung erlebt eine Konsolidierungswelle: Tausende Häuser suchen in den nächsten Jahren eine Nachfolge, und nur wenige Käufer prüfen sie mit derselben Sorgfalt wie ein professionelles Transaktionsteam. Hier lernst du M&A auf der Käuferseite, an echten Transaktionen und von der ersten Ansprache bis nach dem Abschluss.

Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen und erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen, um sie weiterzuentwickeln. Wir prüfen laufend neue Ziele, bewerten, verhandeln und schließen ab. Anders als bei einem Finanzinvestor endet unsere Arbeit nicht beim Abschluss, sie fängt dort an.

Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ein verwandtes Fach im fortgeschrittenen Bachelor oder im Master und willst den Transaktionsprozess vollständig kennenlernen, nicht nur einen Ausschnitt davon. Das Praktikum dauert drei bis sechs Monate in Vollzeit. Du arbeitest im Finance-Team und direkt mit der Geschäftsführung an laufenden Transaktionen.

Deine Verantwortung

Zielsuche und Marktanalyse

  • Du baust Longlists und Shortlists möglicher Ziele, recherchierst Märkte, Wettbewerber und Nachfolgesituationen und bereitest Erstansprachen vor.

  • Du wertest Teaser und erste Unterlagen aus und hältst in einer kurzen Einschätzung fest, ob sich eine vertiefte Prüfung lohnt.

Bewertung und Due Diligence

  • Du erstellst Bewertungen nach Multiplikatoren, Transaktionsvergleichen und Ertragswert, normalisierst Jahresabschlüsse und rechnest Kaufpreis-Mechanik und Sensitivitäten durch.

  • Du strukturierst Datenräume, koordinierst Fragenlisten mit dem Verkäufer und unseren Beratern und benennst Auffälligkeiten für die Verhandlung.

  • Du rechnest die Finanzierungsseite mit: Kapitaldienst, Rückbeteiligung, Zahlungsstruktur über die Zeit.

Verhandlung und Abschluss

  • Du bereitest Präsentationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für die Geschäftsführung vor: eine Empfehlung mit Begründung, keine Sammlung von Kennzahlen.

  • Du arbeitest an Absichtserklärungen, Term Sheets und Verhandlungsunterlagen mit und begleitest Gespräche mit Inhabern.

  • Nach dem Abschluss hilfst du, das übernommene Haus in unser Berichtswesen zu überführen, und machst sichtbar, ob die Annahmen der Bewertung eintreten.

Deine Perspektiven

Was du nach 3 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Du hast an mindestens einer Transaktion durchgehend mitgearbeitet, von der Analyse bis zur Verhandlung.

  • Ein Bewertungsmodell von dir ist in eine Entscheidungsvorlage eingegangen, und ein Dritter kann es weiterrechnen.

Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Du trägst die Erstprüfung eines Ziels eigenständig, vom Teaser bis zur Empfehlung.

  • Du kennst den Prozess so gut, dass du die nächste Prüfung strukturieren könntest.

Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:

Wer im Praktikum überzeugt, hat die Tür für den Einstieg in Finance & M&A offen. Fachliche Expertenlaufbahn und Führungslaufbahn stehen danach beide offen, entschieden am Beitrag und nicht am Berufsjahr.

Das bringst du mit

Erfahrung & Track Record

  • Fortgeschrittenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Fach mit Vertiefung in Finance, Corporate Finance oder Rechnungswesen.

  • Erste Praxis in M&A, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance, Private Equity oder einer Unternehmensberatung ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung.

  • Profile, die nicht in dieses Raster passen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen. Konkret: Steuerfachangestellte mit laufendem Studium, die Jahresabschlüsse von innen kennen, Mathematik- oder Physikstudierende mit Interesse an Bewertung, Gründer eines eigenen kleinen Unternehmens. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett.

Skills & Arbeitsweise

  • Du bist sicher in Excel und PowerPoint und baust Modelle, die ein Dritter verstehen und weiterrechnen kann.

  • Du liest einen Jahresabschluss so, dass du erkennst, was erklärungsbedürftig ist, statt Kennzahlen abzuschreiben.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug für Recherche, Aufbereitung von Datenräumen und Drafting.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf einem Niveau, das für Verhandlungsunterlagen trägt.

Mindset & Persönlichkeit

  • Du behandelst Vertrauliches selbstverständlich vertraulich und interessierst dich für das Unternehmen hinter den Zahlen.

  • Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen, nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört.

Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst

  • Keine zweite Reihe. Deine Arbeit geht in eine Verhandlung, die diesen Monat stattfindet.

  • Keine Deal-Romantik. Wir kaufen, um zu behalten. Wer nach dem Abschluss das Interesse verliert, verpasst den besten Teil.

  • Keine Übungsfälle. Du arbeitest an echten Zielen mit echten Inhabern.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick.

3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt.

Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

Compensation: €4K per month

AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Marketing Growth Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR:
We're looking for a full-stack engineer who wants to sit at the heart of Lovable's marketing engine - making every pound of spend measurable, and every manual workflow a tool. One sprint you're tracing spend from first click to revenue across Meta, Google and newer channels; the next you're shipping landing pages, experiments or an agent that saves the team hours a week. You think in React and APIs, but your first instinct is always: can we measure it, and does it help us grow faster?

Coding skills + excellent taste + growth instincts + marketing obsession = you.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience building and growing user-facing products in high-performing teams, ideally including growth work, marketplaces/platforms, or communities.

  • Strong product sense and UX taste for multi-sided systems with creators, learners, and customers - you can see problems from multiple sides and design for all of them.

  • Knowledge of Meta Pixel and Google Ad Network APIs, and experience working with data from ad networks. Experience with TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit and Beehiiv, plus CTV/podcast tracking, is a plus.

  • Comfortable using data, funnels, analytics, attribution, and A/B testing to shape what you build and how you iterate.

  • Skilled at designing, measuring, and iterating experiments, and thorough in setting up growth systems "right" from the start.

  • Experience collaborating across functions (design, marketing, partnerships, support, data) to launch and grow new product surfaces and ecosystems.

  • Enjoys designing reusable growth, ecosystem, and monetization tools that other builders can plug into, with a pragmatic and detail-oriented mindset.

  • Motivated by helping others succeed and by seeing impact through engagement, measurable results, and revenue - you care about the scoreboard as much as the code.

What you’ll do

In one sentence: You'll sit between marketing and engineering and build whatever we need to grow faster, from the site and tracking to the tools the team uses every day - expect to be driving the thinking here alongside our team leads.

  • Build the tools marketing runs on: Find the manual work slowing the team down and replace it with tools, automations or agents, ideally built on Lovable.

  • Shape what gets built: Work with design, marketing, data and partnerships to decide what's worth doing, then own it end to end.

  • Own how we measure marketing: Make sure every pound of spend can be traced from first click to revenue, across Meta and Google and newer channels like CTV and podcast. This is what lets us scale spend with confidence.

  • Make experimentation cheap & fast: Build the events, funnels and A/B testing setup that let the team test an idea in days and double down on what works.

  • Turn the website into a growth surface: Ship landing pages, signup flows and first-run moments that get new users to value fast, without waiting in a product queue.

  • Keep it Lovable: Growth should feel like part of the product, never bolted on.

Our tech stack

descriptionHtml:

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As the Mechanical Engineering Director at Focused Energy, you will design, build, and lead the Mechanical Engineering department, establishing its organizational structure, operating model, engineering standards, and budget. You will oversee end-to-end mechanical capability across key delivery programs, managing peer Chief Mechanical Engineers. Your leadership will ensure that mechanical subsystems are rigorously designed, manufactured, verified, and delivered on schedule to Systems Integration.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Mechanical Engineering department's structure, headcount, budget forecasting, and capacity allocation across active delivery programs.

  • Establish manufacturing and supplier engineering capabilities early in the lifecycle to optimize design-for-manufacture, assembly, and test readiness.

Who You Are

Must-Haves

Momo Medical is a fast-growing and ambitious scale-up, tackling one of the biggest societal challenges: the future of elderly care. Over the next decade, demand for care is expected to double, while 30% of the current workforce is projected to retire. Our innovative solutions aim to reduce the pressure on healthcare workers while improving the quality of care for residents.

The most valuable aspects of the role

🚀 Your work defines the way caregivers interact with the app as well as how it looks. All while staying in very close contact with them to understand exactly what they need.

🎊 Thursday pizza nights, Friday drinks, team activities, travel allowance, pension plan, and plenty of growth opportunities that match your ambitions.

Your key responsibilities

As part of a multidisciplinary team you will work on innovative solutions that have a direct impact on healthcare professionals in the Netherlands and abroad. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills, specialize or grow into a team leader role. You can work on the front-end or the back-end, or even better: both!

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Maintain and improve the connection between business logic and UI in our Flutter app by employing Bloc and Clean Architecture.

  • Design, build, and maintain TypeScript services that drive the app to thousands of phones simultaneously. .

  • Design event-driven systems that provide the app with the freshest data possible

  • Automate manual workflows and improve reliability through observability, testing, and CI/CD.

  • Mentor teammates, set technical direction, and help prioritize the roadmap.

Who are you?

  • You have an advanced skill set of Flutter, Node, and TypeScript,backed by a track record of delivering full-stack features end-to-end in fast-paced environments.

  • You validate your features with automated tests, ranging from unit-tests to fully automated widget tests and end-to-end tests.

  • You’re comfortable modelling data and tuning performance in relational databases such as PostgreSQL.

  • A good level of English is required, and it is a plus if you can speak Dutch.

  • You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across the company and keeping multiple initiatives moving forward.

  • You’re available 32–40 hours per week and happy to spend at least four days a week with the team in Delft.

Why join Momo Medical?

Because you want to make a difference in healthcare at home and abroad. Because you are excited about a fast-growing scale-up where no two days are the same. And because you want to work with young, enthusiastic and talented international colleagues who all work hard to make healthcare a little bit better every day.

  • Salary: €4,000–5,000 (medior) or €5,000–6,000 (senior) per month based on 40 hours, plus 8% holiday allowance.

  • Provided lunches, weekly company drinks and dinners, and regular team and company events.

  • Reimbursement of travel expenses and a pension plan

Good to know

Tech at Momo

At Momo, we use the following tools: Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Express, Vitest, Node, PostgreSQL, Docker, Testcontainers, GitHub, and AWS.

What are the next steps?

First, we’ll review your CV and motivation to get a sense of how you are and to envision how you might fit within our team. After that, you’ll receive a short take-home assignment that helps us understand how you think, and you get insights into the kind of work we do at Momo. The next step is a chat at our offices in Delft, where we can go more in-depth on the role, the team and the Momo culture. Then, as a final exploration, you’ll have the chance to spend a work-along day with us to experience a day at Momo and to meet more people working on the same mission. When both you and we see the match, we’ll share an offer and start the onboarding process so you can join us in supporting caregivers!

title: Mid Market Account Executive - DACH
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

    • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
    • Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.
    • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Winning DNA: Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt
  • Native German language speakers

Advantageous:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

title: Migrations Architect
descriptionHtml:
• Location: London/ Bristol UK OR  Paris France. (Hybrid) 

  • Level: TL1

  • Team: Client Delivery

  • Salary: £80,000-£90,000

  • Reporting To: Head of Migration Enablement and Architecture

This role can be based in the UK (Bristol or London) or France (Paris). You'll need existing right to work in whichever country you're applying to.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

A technical leader in our Migration Enablement team, you will be responsible for the design, plan and build of the data migration for each of Kaluza’s platform deployments. The Migration Architect will be well-versed in the complexities and risks associated with data migration programmes, and be well-equipped to develop methodologies that reduce and remove these risks. 

You will be a key member of the Deployment Design team: a specialist unit focused on winning Kaluza new business and then delivering on the deals made. The team’s mission is to create seamless, scalable, and secure deployment solutions that empower our clients to accelerate innovation, achieve operational efficiency and business success. Through collaboration, a focus on repeatability, and a user-centred approach, we design and implement reliable SaaS deployment architectures that enhance performance, minimise risk, and support future growth.

Responsibilities will include -

  • Source System & Data Architecture Analysis: Gaining a detailed understanding of clients’ existing systems, data models, integrations, business processes and data dependencies to determine migration requirements and complexity.

  • Source-to-Target Data Mapping: Leading analysis and definition of mappings between legacy data structures and the Kaluza target data model, including transformation rules, defaults, derivations and handling of data gaps.

  • Migration Solution Architecture: Designing end-to-end migration solutions covering data extraction, transformation, validation, loading, reconciliation and exception management, ensuring alignment with Kaluza architecture and engineering standards.

  • Data Extraction Strategy: Consulting with and supporting clients in designing and developing robust extraction capabilities, including defining extract specifications, formats, sequencing, dependencies and data quality expectations.

  • Migration Tooling & Engineering Collaboration: Working closely with Engineering teams to define requirements for migration tooling, APIs, ETL processes, validation frameworks and automation required to execute migrations safely and efficiently.

  • API, Integration & ETL Expertise: Applying a strong understanding of APIs, integration patterns, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines and large-scale data processing to design scalable migration approaches.

  • Data Quality & Validation: Defining validation rules and data quality controls across extraction, transformation and loading, identifying data issues early and agreeing remediation approaches with clients and engineering teams.

  • Migration Reconciliation: Designing reconciliation frameworks to demonstrate completeness and accuracy of migrated data, including source-to-target reconciliation, control totals, exception reporting and business validation.

  • Client Solution Design: Architecting and presenting client-specific Kaluza migration solutions, clearly explaining technical design decisions, trade-offs, dependencies and the business outcomes the proposed approach will deliver.

  • Migration Strategy & Planning: Developing client-specific migration strategies and plans, including migration cohorts, sequencing, volumes, frequency, throughput, eligibility criteria and migration windows.

  • Migration Performance & Scalability: Assessing data volumes, processing capacity and system constraints to ensure migration solutions can achieve required throughput and scale while protecting platform stability.

  • Migration Testing Strategy: Defining the technical migration testing approach across component testing, integration testing, end-to-end testing, migration dry runs, trial migrations and production readiness.

  • Cutover & Production Migration Architecture: Designing the technical approach for migration cutover, including sequencing, dependencies, entry/exit criteria, rollback or recovery approaches, monitoring and operational readiness.

  • Technical Migration Leadership: Acting as the technical authority for migration throughout implementation and live execution, providing technical direction, resolving complex issues and coordinating decisions across client, Engineering, Product and programme teams.

  • Technical Governance & Design Assurance: Representing migration within programme and architecture governance, reviewing technical designs, managing architectural risks and dependencies, and ensuring migration solutions remain aligned with agreed standards.

  • Issue & Root Cause Analysis: Leading investigation of complex migration failures and data issues, distinguishing between source-data, transformation, integration, platform and migration-tooling problems and driving appropriate resolution.

  • Requirements & Technical Analysis: Translating business and migration requirements into clear technical requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria, while challenging assumptions and identifying gaps, dependencies and constraints.

  • Migration Optimisation: Using evidence from testing, dry runs and live migrations to fine-tune migration rules, tooling, performance, sequencing and operational processes.

  • Commercial & Pre-Sales Support: Leading the migration architecture elements of commercial proposals, including solution definition, technical feasibility, assumptions, dependencies, complexity assessment and estimation.

  • Deployment & Implementation Architecture: Leading migration architecture within the broader client deployment and implementation design, ensuring migration is integrated effectively with platform configuration, integrations, testing and operational readiness.

  • Technical Documentation & Migration Playbooks: Producing high-quality architecture documentation, technical specifications, data mapping artefacts and client-specific migration designs, while developing reusable Kaluza standards, patterns and playbooks to accelerate and standardise future migrations.

  • Knowledge Sharing & Technical Enablement: Building migration capability across Kaluza by documenting lessons learned, establishing reusable architectural patterns and providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineering, implementation and migration teams.

About You 

You are a hands-on, analytical problem-solver who thrives at the intersection of technology and business. You have a passion for detail and a proven ability to translate complex client needs into practical, scalable solutions. You are comfortable working with large, diverse datasets and possess a strong understanding of how enterprise systems function.

Ideally, you'll have/be:

  • Experience: 

    • Experience within data migration programmes, with specific experience of developing Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes

    • Experience in a technical/engineering leadership role, able to demonstrate leadership qualities

    • Technical experience of Energy industry or utilities is a significant benefit

  • Skills:

    • Data analysis and management

    • Systems architecture and software development

    • Verbal and written communication including the ability to convey complex technical information to non-technical audiences

    • Delivering impactful presentations as part of Kaluza sales activities

  • Other Requirements: Kaluza is a global business, as a result the person in this role will be required to travel as part of commercial and deployment activities. By way of a guide, it’s expected that between 9 and 12 business trips a year will be required.

What will set you apart

  • A passion for solving problems with multiple varied experiences of doing so;

  • The determination to see a job done well from start to finish;

  • A deep curiosity that can be applied to Kaluza’s clients and their customers, enabling you to devise customer-centric approaches.

  • A leadership style that multiplies the talents of the teams around you.

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

Our Perks

  • Pension Scheme

  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme

  • Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP

  • Life Assurance

  • Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app

  • Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests

  • Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts

  • Flexible Bank Holidays - Giving you an additional 8 days which you can choose to take whenever you like

  • Progressive Leave Policy - With no qualifying service periods, including 26 weeks full pay if you have a new addition to your family

  • Personal Learning Budget - Upskill, learn and grow!

  • Home Office Budget

  • And more!

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn. You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

title: Modelling Resident
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Most AI is frozen in place - it doesn’t adapt to the world. We think that’s backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. We bring together exceptional people with the drive and creativity to push the boundaries of continual adaptation. We’re looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence.

Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in accountability, initiative and shared success. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. We operate with low egos, high velocity, and extreme ownership to build technology that expands access and benefits the many, not the few.

How We Work

  • Impact over activity: We are building a generational company. We value people who execute on ideas rather than comment from the sidelines. We believe our competitive edge lies in caring about excellence across the entire lifecycle - from research to product. No task is beneath anyone: no one is too senior to test the build, clean the data, or unblock a teammate.

  • Vulnerable, low-ego collaboration: We believe exceptional work comes from people who challenge, support and push one another to think bigger. Rapid iteration requires stepping into discomfort. We encourage bold, half-baked, and unorthodox ideas. When we disagree, we share feedback directly, never through side channels.

  • Celebrate decisively: Extraordinary effort should be deeply memorable. We celebrate milestones generously and publicly - via spot bonuses, team dinners, spontaneous gifts, and company-wide recognition - to fuel each other for the next sprint.

The Role

Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, adaptable, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible. It’s how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few.

A modelling residency puts you in the center of a frontier lab. You'll be embedded in real work: placed on key production and research projects and mentored directly by our modelling team. We're building our frontier innovation around efficiency, gradient-free exploration, real-time learning, and interface design. By the end of this 8-month residency, our hope is that you leave with a track record you're proud to put on your resume and experiences that meaningfully upskill you.

What You'll Do

  • Innovation: Build the future of adaptive algorithms that continuously learn. Co-design algorithms that react in real-time to product signal and feedback, and explore new ways of capturing feedback that make those algorithms better

  • Cross-stack optimization: Collaborate across software, hardware, and algorithmic domains to drive system-wide efficiency gains

  • Measure what matters: We believe the ultimate signal of value is real-world impact. The smartest algorithm is one capable of interacting with the world — that's why product signal matters so much to how we work.

 

Skills You'll Bring

We look beyond traditional markers of experience. What matters most to us is what you’ve built and the impact you’ve had. We value demonstrable output, curiosity and alignment with our core values:

  • A degree or equivalent research/engineering experience in a computer science field.

  • Genuine interest in, and at least one project touching: model efficiency, synthetic data, interfaces, real-time alignment, or algorithmic optimization

  • Systems thinking — the ability to understand and optimize across the full ML stack

  • Strong Python skills and experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow)

  • Familiarity with model optimization techniques such as RLHF and fine-tuning

  • Strong communication and self-awareness — you know how to collaborate in a remote environment and you're open to feedback

  • You care about technical excellence and last mile impact. We value impact more than effort, and about owning outcomes end to end.

We value impact over credentials. Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to check every box - but you do need to be adaptable.


What We Offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: A dynamic environment with opportunities to take on new challenges, expand your responsibilities, and make an impact beyond your immediate role.

  • Adaption Passport: An annual travel allowance to explore somewhere new, experience different cultures and keep expanding your horizons. It can be used to travel to any country you haven’t previously been to.

  • Lunch on us: A weekly allowance for takeout or grocery delivery, wherever you are in the world. Whether it's stocking your fridge or having dinner delivered, it’s one less thing to think about.

  • Comprehensive benefits: High-quality medical coverage and benefits designed to support your health and well-being.

  • Team offsites and visits to SF HQ: We're a global team, but believe there's real value in spending time together in person. We regularly bring teammates together at our SF HQ and for team offsites in locations around the world, including London, Mexico City, and New York.

title: Navigation Engineer (Precise Navigation)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Navigation Engineer within our Precise Navigation team, you will design and develop high-precision navigation and positioning solutions based on tightly-coupled IMU/GNSS filtering, improving localisation accuracy, integrity, and robustness to jamming and spoofing for our autonomous systems – from concept to field deployment. You will work hand-in-hand with the Navigation and Radar teams, as well as software and Electronic Warfare (EW) teams, to deliver robust, resilient Position, Navigation and Timing (PNT) and ensure overall performance, robustness and reliability.

Responsibilities

  • Navigation Architecture: Drive the architecture and implementation of navigation / PNT solutions for autonomous platforms.

  • Resilient PNT: Develop navigation resilient to GNSS degradation, jamming and spoofing (anti-jam / anti-spoof).

  • Sensor Fusion: Design multi-sensor fusion (GNSS, INS/IMU, RF, vision) and the associated estimation and filtering algorithms.

  • Testing & Validation: Design test plans (e.g. GNSS receiver testing in jamming environments), run simulations and replays, and report on findings and performance against targets.

  • Technical Coordination: Collaborate across HW, software, EW and ML teams on technical interfaces and system-level trade-offs.

  • System Reviews & Documentation: Contribute to design and architecture reviews and maintain requirements traceability and documentation.

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc in Engineering (aerospace, robotics, EE or related); PhD is a plus.

  • Strong mathematical background combined with good physical intuition.

  • Experience with GNSS, INS/IMU and navigation/estimation filters (e.g. Kalman filtering), particularly in tightly-coupled architectures.

  • Experience with navigation in GNSS-denied / contested environments.

  • Familiarity with RF and EW constraints (GNSS jamming / spoofing) is a plus.

  • Solid software / algorithm skills; combined algo + software profile rather than a pure coder.

  • Broad engineering culture with understanding of electrical, embedded and mechanical systems.

  • Rigorous, structured and mission-driven mindset with strong analytical skills.

  • Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Offre de stage :  Imprimer l'énergie de demain : développement de générateurs thermoélectriques innovants
department: Matériaux à haute performance et éco-matériaux
descriptionHtml:
Unité : CERI MP

Responsables : Dr. CHARLON Sébastien, Pr. SAMUEL Cédric, Dr. Amulya RAJ

Nature de l’emploi : Stage de master 2 ou équivalent d’une durée de 6 mois

Lieu de travail : Douai (59)

Description de l’IMT Nord Europe :

École sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.

IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr

Contexte scientifique et missions :

Le développement de capteurs autonomes en énergie pour l'Internet des objets (IoT) représente un défi scientifique et technologique majeur. Dans ce contexte, les technologies de récupération d'énergie constituent des solutions prometteuses pour convertir différentes sources d'énergie présentes dans notre environnement (mécanique, thermique, solaire, électromagnétique, etc.) en énergie électrique.

Le projet européen THERMOHARV, réunissant l'Université de Mons, l'Université de Lille, le C2DE et l’IMT Nord Europe, ambitionne de développer une nouvelle génération de microgénérateurs thermoélectriques organiques (OTEG), flexibles et performants, capables de convertir directement la chaleur fatale en énergie électrique. Ces dispositifs pourraient notamment contribuer à l'alimentation de capteurs autonomes dans les bâtiments, les centres de données ou les environnements industriels.

Dans ce cadre, le Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Matériaux & Procédés (CERI MP) d'IMT Nord Europe développe des encres fonctionnelles à base de nanotubes de carbone, présentant des propriétés thermoélectriques. Ces encres sont déposées sur des substrats polymères flexibles grâce à un procédé innovant de fabrication additive par écriture directe (Direct Ink Writing, DIW).

L'enjeu scientifique consiste à maîtriser les interactions entre la formulation des encres, leur imprimabilité et les performances thermoélectriques des dispositifs obtenus afin de concevoir des générateurs optimisés.

Dans ce contexte, les missions scientifiques et technologiques confiées à la personne recrutée seront les suivantes :

  1. Formulation des encres : développer et optimiser des encres thermoélectriques à base de nanotubes de carbone, notamment en étudiant l'influence des conditions de dispersion sur leurs propriétés.

  2. Caractérisation physicochimique : étudier les relations entre la formulation, l'état de dispersion des nanotubes de carbone et les propriétés rhéologiques des encres.

  3. Optimisation du procédé d'impression : identifier les paramètres d'écriture directe permettant d'obtenir des dépôts homogènes, reproductibles et présentant une géométrie maîtrisée.

  4. Conception et optimisation des dispositifs : modéliser l'influence de la géométrie des générateurs sur leurs performances thermoélectriques.

  5. Fabrication et caractérisation d'un prototype fonctionnel : concevoir, fabriquer et évaluer les performances d'un prototype de générateur thermoélectrique flexible.

Ce stage permettra ainsi de participer à l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement d'un dispositif fonctionnel, de la formulation des matériaux jusqu'à la validation expérimentale d'un prototype, au sein d'un environnement de recherche collaboratif.


Profil de la personne recrutée :

La personne recrutée devra être étudiante en Master 2, en dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs ou suivre une formation équivalente dans le domaine de la science et du génie des matériaux, de la physicochimie ou du génie des procédés.

Des connaissances en formulation et dispersion d’encres, notamment par ultrasons, en fabrication additive (impression 3D, écriture directe) ainsi qu’en caractérisation des matériaux (rhéologie, goniométrie, profilométrie) seront particulièrement appréciées. Une expérience ou des connaissances dans le domaine de la thermoélectricité constitueront un atout supplémentaire.

Au-delà des compétences techniques, la personne recrutée devra faire preuve de rigueur scientifique, d’autonomie, de curiosité et d’un intérêt marqué pour la recherche expérimentale. De bonnes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de communication scientifique, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral, sont également attendues.

Conditions :

Le poste est à pourvoir à compter du 01/02/2027 pour une durée de 6 mois

Renseignements et modalités de dépôt de candidature :

  • Pour tout renseignement sur le poste, merci de vous adresser à

Dr. CHARLON Sébastien, Pour tout renseignement administratif, merci de vous adresser à la Direction des Ressources Humaines :

Date limite de candidature : 31/12/2026

title: Ontwikkelaar vastgoed
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij bouwen aan de vastgoedopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als ervaren ontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na acquisitie en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting verkoop en realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met adviseurs én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na acquisitie / tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de het ontwikkelteam om projecten succesvol verder te brengen.

Wat ga je doen
De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen of een acquisitie is verworven en projecten daadwerkelijk ontwikkeld gaan worden. Je werkt aan (middel)grote vastgoedontwikkelingen en ben je de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het uitwerken van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

· Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning/acquisitie, naar omgevingsvergunning tot aan de start van de verkoop;

· Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces;

· Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering;

· Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's;

· Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders;

· Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken;

· Je werkt nauw samen met makelaars, verkoopmanagers en notarissen om projecten succesvol in verkoop te brengen;

· Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming;

· Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Hier zit je op jouw plek

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.


Dit breng jij mee

· Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar;

· Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

· Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen;

· Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe projecten;

· Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten;

· Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie.

Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt om projecten na tendergunning/acquisitie verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je komt het beste tot je recht wanneer met alle betrokken partijen, de complexe projecten succesvol weet te ontwikkelen én realiseren.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Het salaris voor deze functie ligt bij senior profiel tussen € 6.512,- en € 9.512,- (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring;

  • Voor deze functie geldt een individuele bonusregeling, waarbij de hoogte van de bonus afhankelijk is van de behaalde resultaten;

  • Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra);

  • 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen;

  • Een laptop en een smartphone;

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap;

  • Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card;

  • Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike;

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit;

  • Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland;

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical;

  • Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.

title: Operations & Risk Analyst
descriptionHtml:
📍Primarily remote - with paid travel to any of our offices (London, Sheffield or Lincoln) twice a month.

Please note, you must be currently residing in the UK to be considered for this role.

 

Our mission:

Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Our mission? To be the gold standard platform for renting.

We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution

Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,000 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 320+ Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission!

The Opportunity:

We're looking for someone who loves digging into data, spotting trends and turning insights into meaningful improvements. Sitting within our Referencing team, you'll analyse performance, customer trends and risk indicators to help us understand what's working, where things could be better and how we can make smarter decisions.

You'll work closely with teams across Referencing, Insurance, Compliance, Operations and Product, using tools like SQL and Google Sheets to investigate challenges, uncover opportunities and make recommendations that have a real impact.

This is more than just reporting numbers. We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, takes ownership of their analysis and isn't afraid to challenge the status quo or bring forward ideas. You'll play an important part in improving our processes, strengthening controls and enhancing the customer experience.

In a nutshell, you'll be:

  • Analysing data to spot trends, risks and opportunities across Referencing.

  • Investigating the root causes behind issues, including fraud, insurance claims and customer experience.

  • Building reports that help teams understand performance and make informed decisions.

  • Turning complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Working with stakeholders across the business to drive improvements.

  • Taking a proactive approach to identifying problems and finding better ways of working.

What we need from you:

You should apply if you have:

  • Experience in an analytical role, ideally involving operational, risk or customer data

  • Strong Google Sheets skills, and confidence working with SQL

  • A track record of turning data into clear insight and going a step further to recommend action

  • Comfortable working independently, prioritising your own work, and knowing when to escalate or flag something

  • Confident engaging with stakeholders across different teams and functions, and can adapt how you communicate depending on the audience

  • A naturally curious mindset - you ask why something is happening, not just what happened

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
