title: Package Reliability Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Package Reliability Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own the reliability of our packaged products, from defining mission profiles and reliability targets to identifying package-level failure mechanisms, developing qualification strategies, and making evidence-based release recommendations.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Architecture, Device Reliability, Product Engineering, and OSAT/laboratory partners to translate product use cases into mission profiles and FIT/MTBF targets. You will assess reliability risks, define and execute package-level reliability test plans, lead failure analysis activities, and ensure findings are driven to resolution.

Your core focus will be to transform product requirements into robust reliability strategies, validate package concepts through targeted stress testing, and provide data-driven recommendations that enable confident product release.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own mission profiles and reliability targets by defining product operating conditions (temperature, voltage, humidity, thermal cycling, and lifetime requirements) and allocating FIT, MTBF, and lifetime targets across package, interconnect, and device-level contributors.

  • Assess package reliability risks by evaluating failure mechanisms across substrates, die attach, interconnects, solder joints, board attach, and optical/fiber interfaces, including delamination, warpage, fatigue, electromigration, and optical or electrical drift.

  • Define and execute package reliability qualification plans covering thermal, mechanical, environmental, and board-level stress testing in accordance with JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, IEC, and customer-specific requirements.

  • Lead the technical interface with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and labs, defining reliability requirements, reviewing data, and challenging results when the supporting evidence is insufficient or unrepresentative.

  • Drive root-cause investigations and failure analysis, leveraging techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, SEM/EDX, and related methods, and translate findings into CAPA/8D actions, design improvements, and requalification decisions.

  • Develop risk-based qualification strategies for novel packaging technologies, such as UBC and optical interconnects, where industry standards are incomplete or do not yet exist.

  • Provide data-driven release recommendations by assessing whether products are ready for customer sampling, qualification milestones, or production release, while clearly communicating any remaining reliability risks.

Your Qualifications

  • Educational background with a Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Reliability Engineering, or a related field.

  • Package reliability expertise with 3–5+ years of experience evaluating semiconductor package construction (substrates, die attach, interconnects, and solder joints) and understanding the failure mechanisms associated with these technologies.

  • Understanding of high-speed I/O and RF reliability, including how reliability degradation impacts high-speed serial, RF, and optical interfaces (e.g., signal integrity, insertion loss, jitter, and eye closure over product lifetime). This expertise goes beyond conventional digital logic reliability and is a core requirement for this role. Experience with photonics reliability is highly desirable.

  • Solid foundation in reliability engineering, including FIT and MTBF calculations, mission profile development, acceleration models, and translating product use cases into measurable reliability requirements and targets.

  • Experience with industry qualification standards, including JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, and IEC, as well as the judgment to apply knowledge-based qualification approaches when existing standards are not sufficient.

  • Failure analysis expertise, with the ability to interpret results from techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, and SEM/EDX, and translate findings into risk-based recommendations.

  • Experience collaborating with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and external laboratories, including defining technical reliability requirements, reviewing qualification data, and driving technical discussions to ensure robust evidence for product qualification.

  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate reliability risks, trade-offs, and evidence gaps to architects, engineers, suppliers, and leadership.

  • Thrives in a startup environment, demonstrating initiative, ownership, adaptability, and the ability to make progress in a fast-paced, resource-conscious setting.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect!

title: Photonics Packaging & Cryogenic Integration R&D Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry.
Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components.
Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Team/Project

We are looking for a Photonics Packaging & Cryogenic Integration Engineer to contribute to the development and industrialization of our photonic quantum systems.

You will work on the integration of single-photon sources, photonic integrated circuits and optical/electromechanical assemblies, with a strong focus on miniaturization, automation and operation under cryogenic conditions.

This is a highly hands-on role at the intersection of photonics, electronics, mechanics, automation and experimental physics.

You will contribute across the full development cycle: design, prototyping, assembly, testing, optimization and transfer toward industrial-scale production.

Your Key Responsibilities:

    • Design and develop packaging and integration solutions for photonic and quantum devices.
    • Integrate single-photon sources, photonic integrated circuits and optical components into complete systems.
    • Develop and optimize optical coupling strategies, including fiber coupling and direct chip-to-chip integration.
    • Design, build and assemble precision positioning and alignment systems, including nano-positioning stages and multi-axis platforms.
    • Develop experimental setups operating under cryogenic conditions, typically in the 2–4 K range.
    • Design mechanical parts and assemblies using CAD tools.
    • Contribute to electronics development, including PCB design, instrumentation and control systems.
    • Automate alignment, test and characterization processes using Python, C++, Rust or similar programming languages.
    • Work with microcontrollers, FPGA-based systems or other hardware-control architectures when relevant.
    • Build, test and iterate rapidly on prototypes, including using 3D printing and other rapid prototyping techniques.
    • Perform test and measurement activities to characterize system performance and identify failure modes.
    • Contribute feedback to the design of photonic chips and single-photon sources based on integration and testing results.
    • Support the transition from laboratory prototypes to repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes.
    • Document designs, experiments, procedures and lessons learned, and actively share knowledge within the team.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

You should ideally bring:

  • A PhD in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, applied physics, condensed matter physics, solid-state physics, optics, photonics or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and testing scientific or high-precision equipment.
  • Experience with photonics, optomechanics, semiconductor devices, cryogenics or precision engineering.
  • Familiarity with optical alignment, fiber coupling and/or photonic packaging.
  • Experience with mechanical design and CAD tools.
  • Good understanding of electronics, instrumentation and test equipment.
  • Programming skills in Python, C++, Rust or similar languages for automation and hardware control.
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary systems combining optics, mechanics, electronics and software.
  • Strong experimental problem-solving skills and the ability to iterate quickly from concept to prototype.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and collaborate in an international environment.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be particularly valuable:

  • Cryogenic systems and experiments at very low temperatures.
  • Photonic or optoelectronic packaging.
  • Chip bonding, indium bump bonding or related micro-assembly techniques.
  • Pick-and-place systems or automated precision assembly.
  • Nano-positioning and multi-axis motion control systems.
  • Robotics or computer vision.
  • FPGA or microcontroller development.
  • PCB design using KiCad or similar tools.
  • Finite-element simulation using tools such as ANSYS or COMSOL.
  • Semiconductor or quantum photonics environments.

More than a specific academic background, we are looking for someone who enjoys building complex scientific systems and solving problems directly at the hardware level.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

title: Portugal Content Specialist
descriptionHtml:

title: POST-DOCTORANT.E / INGENIEUR.E : Conception de systèmes et d’interfaces capteurs et énergie pour les systèmes électroniques étirables autonomes – CDD 12 mois
descriptionHtml:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que Concepteur(trice) de Systèmes Etirables Autonomes, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en formation, recherche et innovation affecté au département électronique flexible. Au sein de ce département vous conjuguez passion scientifique et goût pour l’innovation.

Au sein du Centre Microélectronique de Provence, le département FEL mène ses recherches dans le domaine de l'électronique flexible et étirable, pour des applications dédiées aux objets "wearable" et au « monitoring » environnemental. La conception de systèmes complets, du capteur au module de de communication, en fonction des contraintes énergétiques et environnementales est un élément essentiel permettant la réalisation de prototypes compatibles avec les cas d'usages étudiés.

Vous aurez pour mission principale, à partir du savoir-faire du département de développer l'expertise électronique dans le domaine des objets autonomes / autoalimentés pour le monitoring environnemental (Projet Hydrademo) et des interfaces "wearable" pour la perception augmentée( Projet flexeo3D). Par ailleurs, vous contribuerez au développement de modules de formation en mastère spécialisé, dans le cadre du programme EDU4chip

· Vous accompagnez le développement de systèmes autonomes dans le cadre de différents projets du département

· Vous contribuez au montage à la dispense d'un module d ’enseignement en conception de systèmes autonomes (25h) à destination des étudiants du mastère spécialisé « Concepteur de Circuits Microélectroniques »

· Vous assurez la conception et la réalisation des interfaces spécifiques capteurs et énergie pour nos démonstrateurs systèmes

· Vous participez à la réalisation de prototypes innovants et à leur test en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes de recherche

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à faire dialoguer enseignement, recherche et application concrète sera essentielle pour réussir.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un :

· Titulaire d’un Diplôme de doctorat ou d’ingénieur ou équivalent en électronique

· Junior accepté : oui si expérience pertinente lors des stages

En outre, vous possédez :

• Une expérience dans le développement de systèmes à microcontrôleurs

• Une expérience pratique de la conception et de la réalisation des cartes électroniques

• De bonnes connaissances en électronique analogique

• La connaissance de procédés d’intégration électronique sur support flexible serait un plus

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

• Votre sens pratique et votre esprit « maker »

• Votre capacité à évoluer dans un environnement collaboratif de recherche et développement

• Votre autonomie et votre sens de l’initiative

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

· Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

title: Principal AI Security Specialist, UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

About the Role

The AI revolution is here, and enterprises are racing to adopt GenAI - but they cannot deploy what they cannot secure. Zscaler is seeking an experienced Principal AI Security Specialist to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI innovation and robust enterprise security.

In this highly strategic, field-facing role, you will combine the elite consultative strengths of a Solutions Engineer with deep expertise in LLMs, RAG architectures, and data protection. As our premier technical authority, you will partner with Fortune 500 executives and architects, serving as a trusted advisor to help them confidently unlock the power of AI without compromising their data or infrastructure. If you are a builder, an educator, and a master storyteller who thrives in a fast-evolving market, this is your chance to lead the industry's most critical conversation.

What You’ll Do 

  • Architect the AI Technical Strategy: Partner with enterprise account teams to own and execute the technical sales strategy, driving complex, high-value AI security opportunities from discovery to close.
  • Deliver Compelling, High-Impact Demos & POVs: Configure and present tailored, outcome-driven demonstrations of Zscaler’s AI security platform that resonate with both deep-tech practitioners and C-level executives.  When needed, take customers through successful demos and POVs to validate Zscaler’s ability to securely enable enterprise AI.  
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert: Act as the field authority on modern AI patterns (such as RAG, agents, and prompt workflows), advising clients on how to prevent sensitive data exposure and unsanctioned AI usage.
  • Scale the Field Motion: Collaborate with Product and Engineering to inject real-world customer feedback into the product roadmap, while building reusable demo assets and enablement playbooks to upscale our global sales force.
  • Enable Those Around You: Develop reusable demos, technical assets, competitive positioning, and enablement content to help scale Zscaler’s AI field motion while sharing best practices and training with enterprise account teams

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer—both internal and external—and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.
  • You are driven by innovation. You have a deep curiosity for how things work and are energized by solving complex technical challenges. You believe in the power of technology to accelerate transformation and are always looking for a better, more secure, and scalable way.

What We’re Looking For 

  • Deep Fluency in AI/GenAI: Strong foundational knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), MCP (Model Context Protocol) orchestration patterns, and the inherent security risks associated with them.
  • 10+ Years of Solutions Engineering Mastery: A proven track record in a customer-facing technical role (Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Advisory) navigating complex, enterprise-level sales cycles.
  • Enterprise Security Foundations: Solid grasp of cybersecurity principles, including Zero Trust architecture, data loss prevention (DLP), cloud-native security platforms, and API integrations.
  • Elite Executive Communication: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with a demonstrated ability to seamlessly translate complex AI architectures into tangible business value and security outcomes.
  • Collaborate and Co-elevate: Successfully work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams in a hyper-growth, rapidly evolving market.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs.
  • Hands-on AI Prototyping: Interacting with LLM APIs, scripting, creating agentic automation routines, and building lightweight AI applications.
  • Advanced AI Risk Expertise: Direct experience helping enterprises deploy production AI technologies while navigating data leakage, model governance, compliance frameworks, and shadow AI usage.
  • Scale & Enablement Focus: A history of creating high-impact field assets, technical workshops, and competitive positioning content that helps broader go-to-market teams win.

title: Principal Consultant - Strategic Infrastructure Advisory
descriptionHtml:
About Infrata

Infrata, part of dss+, is a specialist infrastructure advisory business of around 100 people working with investors, lenders, owners, operators and governments across transport, aviation, maritime, energy, digital infrastructure and the energy transition.

Our reputation is built on technical and commercial due diligence: fast, rigorous, independent work on the assets and businesses our clients are buying, financing or operating. We are now building on that base to offer clients strategic advice across the full life of an asset, not only at the point of transaction.

Why this role

Infrata has strong technical expertise and established client relationships. We are looking for someone who can help us build on these strengths by developing new consulting services, winning work and leading projects.

You will work with our technical specialists to identify where clients need advice beyond due diligence, develop services we are well placed to deliver, and take them to clients. You will also lead the projects you win, bringing in specialists as needed.

Your impact at Infrata

The role has three main responsibilities: developing services, winning work and leading delivery.

  • Develop services. Work with clients and colleagues to identify problems we have the expertise to address but do not currently advise on. Develop services we can deliver consistently, with a clear scope, team, price and evidence of their value.

  • Win work. Introduce these services to existing and new clients, lead proposals and presentations, and secure new projects.

  • Lead delivery. Lead the projects you win, agreeing the approach, managing the client relationship and team, and taking responsibility for the quality of the advice. Our due diligence specialists will contribute their expertise; you will be responsible for the overall engagement.

Key accountabilities

Service development

  • Understand the team's expertise and identify opportunities to offer advisory services beyond due diligence.

  • Test ideas with clients before investing in their development, and focus on those with genuine demand.

  • Define the client need, approach, team, fees and deliverables for each service, supported by evidence of our experience.

  • Build the supporting material: credentials, case studies, proposal templates, pitch decks.

  • Identify opportunities to sell Infrata's data and analytical tools as products or recurring services, and assess whether they are commercially viable. You will establish what clients would pay for and work with our data and technology colleagues to develop it; you are not expected to build the technology yourself.

Business development

  • Carry a personal sales target for new strategic advisory work (target to be agreed at offer).

  • Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers at investors, lenders, operators and public bodies.

  • Identify opportunities, qualify them, and write or lead proposals and pitches.

  • Work with sector leads to extend existing due diligence relationships into advisory work.

  • Keep the pipeline and client records in our systems current.

Engagement leadership

  • Act as lead consultant on engagements you win: scope, plan, staff, budget, and deliver.

  • Define the questions the project needs to answer and the analysis required. Take responsibility for the conclusions and final recommendations.

  • Manage the client relationship day to day, including scope changes, difficult messages and sign-off.

  • Run the project team, including specialists drawn from across Infrata and dss+, and give them clear briefs and feedback.

  • Deliver high-quality work on time and within budget, building client confidence and opportunities for further work.

Building the team's consulting capability

  • Coach due diligence staff who work on your engagements in consulting skills: problem structuring, client handling, writing for decision-makers, presenting.

  • Set clear standards for strategic advisory proposals, workplans and deliverables, and apply them in your own work.

  • Help improve resourcing, time recording, project management and cash collection across Infrata.

Service areas in scope

The role covers four service areas. You should have the experience to lead projects in at least one of these areas and be comfortable selling services across all four.

Strategy
You will advise owners, operators, developers and public bodies on areas including market entry and growth strategy, asset and portfolio strategy, business planning, governance and assurance, policy and regulatory positioning, and investment case development.

Value creation
Working primarily with private equity and infrastructure fund investors and their portfolio companies, you will lead engagements such as full-potential reviews, 100-day plans, operational and commercial improvement programmes, exit readiness and portfolio performance reviews.

Climate advisory
You will support investors, lenders and operators with decarbonisation roadmaps, climate risk and resilience assessments, transition planning, sustainability strategy, and ESG and climate reporting.

Data and digital services
You will help investors, lenders, operators and public bodies get greater value from data. This could include turning existing traffic, asset, transaction and benchmark data into advisory products or subscription services, using AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery, and helping clients make better use of their own data.

Most projects will combine Infrata's knowledge of aviation, maritime, roads, rail, energy and digital infrastructure with dss+ expertise in operations, safety and sustainability.


Who you are

Essential experience

  • At least eight years in management consulting, strategy consulting or advisory, including substantial experience in infrastructure. A background in project finance, lender's or investor's technical advisory, or assurance would help you understand our clients' needs and how our team works.

  • Experience leading strategy, value creation or climate advisory projects, with responsibility for the engagement rather than an individual part of the work.

  • Direct experience of winning work: writing proposals, pitching, negotiating scope and fees, and converting relationships into revenue.

  • Experience developing or launching a new service, product or practice area, including on a small scale.

  • Experience leading mixed teams of generalists and technical specialists.

Desirable

  • Hands-on experience of project finance, due diligence or technical assurance on infrastructure transactions, and of the lenders, investors and sponsors involved.

  • Experience working with private equity or infrastructure fund investors on portfolio companies.

  • Sector depth in one of aviation, maritime, roads, rail, energy or digital infrastructure.

  • Climate, decarbonisation or sustainability advisory experience.

  • Experience commercialising data, analytics or digital products within a professional services business.

  • A second European language, or experience working with teams in Spain, Latin America or Canada.

Capabilities

  • Can make sense of complex or poorly defined problems and explain them clearly.

  • Writes and presents for senior decision-makers.

  • Exercises sound commercial judgement on project costs, fees and which opportunities to pursue.

  • Comfortable with technical detail without needing to be the technical expert.

  • Uses AI and data tools confidently and understands when they are useful for clients and when they are not. Technical development skills are not required.

  • Works well with technical specialists, including those new to consulting, earning their trust and helping them contribute effectively.

  • Takes initiative and is comfortable developing new services and ways of working, particularly in the first year.

Education and languages

  • Degree in engineering, economics, finance, business, environmental science or a related discipline. MBA or equivalent is useful but not required.

  • Fluent English.

Mobility

  • Willing to travel to clients and to Infrata and dss+ offices as the work requires.

What you'll experience at dss+

  • Work alongside investors, lenders, operators and governments on live infrastructure decisions.

  • The opportunity to help build our strategic advisory practice.

  • A values-led organisation and a collaborative, inclusive culture.

  • Competitive compensation, performance incentives, flexible working and international opportunities.

title: Principal Hardware System Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Shape how advanced AI hardware is tested before it reaches customers.

You'll lead the technical direction of manufacturing test solutions for Host Processor Modules, Server Blades, and multi-node rack systems. Your work will help ensure every system meets the highest quality standards before deployment.

You'll own the architecture of the test executive software and develop manufacturing test content that validates complex hardware at scale. Working across hardware, firmware, and software teams, you'll enable reliable, efficient testing throughout production.

This role offers broad technical influence. You'll solve complex engineering challenges, improve manufacturing quality through data, and help shape the future of Graphcore's production test capability.

The team and culture

You'll join the Product Test and Diagnosis team within Manufacturing Operations. The team defines and delivers test strategies across silicon, boards, server systems, and rack-scale platforms.

Day to day, you'll work closely with engineers across hardware, firmware, software, manufacturing, and quality. Decisions are driven by technical evidence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

You'll have the freedom to lead technically, mentor other engineers, and influence how manufacturing test evolves across globally distributed teams.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Extensive experience developing and deploying manufacturing test solutions for high-performance servers, accelerators (GPU-class), or comparable large-scale compute hardware. 
  • Proven technical leadership as an individual contributor, owning architecture and driving alignment across multiple teams without direct line management responsibility. 
  • Deep technical understanding across silicon, board, and system design sufficient to define effective manufacturing test coverage and lead complex debug/root-cause analysis. 
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience driving requirements and delivery with internal software/firmware/platform teams to enable testability and diagnosability. 
  • Hands-on experience using Linux, OpenBMC, and vendor-specific test tools, diagnostics, and system-level utilities to test hardware in lab and manufacturing environments. 
  • Strong software engineering skills with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, Bash, or similar), including building reliable test infrastructure and integrating heterogeneous test content. 

Desirable

  • Familiarity with rack-scale/multi-node systems, high-speed interconnects, and production qualification of complex assemblies. 
  • Experience improving manufacturing KPIs (yield, test time, false fail reduction) through data-driven test optimisation and robust statistical/diagnostic approaches. 
  • Knowledge of open-source tools commonly used for manufacturing test, system bring-up, and hardware diagnostics. 
  • Experience designing testability/diagnosability features into products (e.g., telemetry, self-test hooks, debug interfaces) in partnership with design teams. 

Benefits

  • Unlimited annual leave
  • Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity – share in Graphcore’s success
  • True flexibility in how and where you work
  • Office spaces designed for collaboration
  • Free food and an on-site barista

  • Income protection

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know. We're happy to support you.

Join the team at Graphcore

Graphcore is building the compute platform for the next generation of artificial intelligence. From advanced silicon to intelligent software, our technology is designed to unlock breakthroughs in AI and bring its benefits to every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, we’re backed by one of the world’s most ambitious technology investors, working alongside companies shaping the future of AI. Together, we share a bold goal: to help enable artificial superintelligence and ensure it delivers meaningful impact at a global scale.

At Graphcore, you’ll work with people who are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Our teams bring together AI researchers, chip designers, software engineers and systems experts from a wide range of backgrounds. It’s an environment where we take on big challenges with curiosity and focus, move quickly and decisively, take real ownership of our work, and speak up to challenge ideas, stepping up to support each other and lead through action.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Security
descriptionHtml:
What You'll Do

As a Principal Software Engineer - Security, you will help set the technical direction for Radiant's security capabilities across the cloud platform and infrastructure, leading the design and delivery of the systems that underpin them.

You'll work across identity, access control, secrets, network security, platform hardening, auditability, and compliance controls. You'll partner closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, networking, security, and compliance teams, and with customers on their most demanding security requirements.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on making security embedded, scalable, automated, and easy to consume across the platform, through architecture, code, and the standards other teams build on.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for security systems and platform capabilities, and lead their design and implementation.

  • Design and build core security services across IAM, RBAC, workload identity, secrets, encryption and key management, audit logging, network controls, and policy enforcement.

  • Translate product, customer, and regulatory requirements into robust architectures, APIs, and technical designs, working closely with the Security Product Manager.

  • Drive automation of policy enforcement, configuration hardening, detection, remediation, and software supply chain security.

  • Ensure strong tenant isolation and least-privilege access across the control plane and network and data plane.

  • Act as a senior technical voice in enterprise customer security reviews, audits, and incident response.

  • Raise the security engineering bar across the organisation through mentoring, code review, and technical standards.

 

Your Profile

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

  • Extensive experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, with significant depth in cloud and network security, IAM, or security infrastructure.

  • Deep technical expertise across:

  • Identity & access: IAM, RBAC/ABAC, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SSO, federation, mTLS, workload and service identity

title: Privacy & AI Officer
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij bijdragen aan een organisatie die in control is op het gebied van privacy en verantwoorde inzet van AI? En weet jij wet- en regelgeving te vertalen naar duidelijke processen en praktisch advies? Als Privacy & AI Officer help je afdelingen zorgvuldig om te gaan met persoonsgegevens en AI-risico’s tijdig te herkennen. Je adviseert, coördineert, bewaakt en rapporteert. Zo maak jij het verschil voor onze leden, collega’s en de continuïteit van Univé Zuid-Nederland!

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een toegankelijke professional met een passie voor privacybescherming en verantwoorde AI-governance. Je hebt een scherp oog voor risico’s en verbindt beleid, processen en praktijk op een natuurlijke manier. Met jouw analytisch vermogen en zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming help je de organisatie risico’s tijdig te herkennen en beheersen. Je schakelt makkelijk met collega’s, management en andere belanghebbenden en maakt complexe onderwerpen helder en praktisch.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Hbo+ werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een juridische richting.

  • Diepgaande kennis van de AVG, privacywetgeving en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

  • Praktische kennis van de AVG en ervaring met bijvoorbeeld DPIA’s, datalekken of privacyprocessen.

  • Kennis van en interesse in AI-governance, AI-beleid, de AI Act en het beheersen van AI-risico’s.

  • Ervaring met het implementeren en bewaken van beleid, regelingen en processen.

  • Sterk analytisch vermogen, zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming en resultaatgerichtheid.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om belanghebbenden mee te nemen.

Wat ga je doen

Als Privacy en AI Officer ondersteun je afdelingen bij het naleven van de AVG, het Univé privacybeleid en het AI-beleid. Maar pak je ook (pro-)actief zelf activiteiten op in het kader van dit aandachtsgebied. Je hebt een spilfunctie in het vroegtijdig onderkennen en beheersen van privacy- en AI-risico’s. Je adviseert je collega’s in de eerste lijn, coördineert de implementatie van beleid en zorgt voor het onderhoud en de naleving van privacy-instrumenten en processen.

Daarnaast registreer, coördineer en beheer je AI-toepassingen, AI-risico’s en relevante beheersmaatregelen. Je helpt bij AI-use cases, naleving van wet- en regelgeving en verantwoord gebruik en rapporteert hierover. Ook speel je een actieve rol in beleidsontwikkeling en advisering. Je volgt wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving en vertaalt deze naar de praktijk. Zo help je Univé Zuid-Nederland om aantoonbaar in control te blijven. Het zwaartepunt van de functie ligt bij privacy, waarmee jij vanuit de eerste lijn waarde toevoegt in dit domein. AI speelt daarin een aanvullende rol en er is ruimte om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen, net als de organisatie dat doet. Je adviseert niet alleen: je helpt ook zelf bij de uitvoering waarbij je samenwerkt met de eerste lijn business owners. Juist die combinatie maakt deze functie afwisselend en zichtbaar waardevol voor de organisatie.

Hieronder een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je helpt afdelingen bij privacy, AVG, AI-beleid en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

  • Je coördineert de implementatie, naleving en doorontwikkeling van beleid en processen.

  • Je registreert, coördineert Privacy- en AI-risico’s en zorgt voor opvolging en borging van de (beheers)maatregelen.

  • Je signaleert risico’s, ontwikkelingen en verbeterkansen en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke acties.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met de 2e lijn Risk & Compliance

Wat wij bieden

Een veelzijdige functie van 32 uur per week met directe lijnen naar de bestuurder, ruimte voor eigen initiatief en mogelijkheden om je professioneel te ontwikkelen. Je werkt aan onderwerpen die ertoe doen voor onze leden en collega’s, binnen een coöperatieve organisatie waarin samenwerken en verantwoordelijkheid nemen centraal staan. Daarbovenop kun je rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris tussen de € 3.859 en € 5.358 per maand, exclusief vakantiegeld, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.

  • Een contract van 1 jaar met de intentie voor een vaste aanstelling.

  • Een 13e maand, bedrijfsfitnessregeling, fietsregeling en een goede pensioenregeling.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 13 compensatie dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Een zelfstandige en verantwoordelijke functie binnen een betrouwbare organisatie.

  • Uitstekende werksfeer; plezier in je werk staat bij ons voorop.

  • Aantrekkelijke kortingen op onze verzekeringsproducten en diensten.

Wie wij zijn

Univé Zuid-Nederland is één van de acht regionale Univé’s, een coöperatie met de missie om de meest menselijke financiële dienstverlener van Nederland te zijn. Ons werkgebied bestaat uit Noord-Brabant, Limburg, Zeeland en delen van Utrecht, Gelderland en Zuid-Holland. Wij zijn verzekeraar en bemiddelaar in schade- en levensverzekeringen, voor zowel de particuliere als zakelijke markt. Daarnaast zijn wij ook erkend hypotheekadviseur. Onze belofte, persoonlijk en dichtbij, komt tot leven in onze lokale dienstverlening, samenwerkingen en sponsoring. Het mooiste van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de geschiedenis, de cultuur en de betrokkenheid. A Great Place to Work!

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.


Why This Role

Every FLUX release, API feature and enterprise offering requires legal oversight. Black Forest Labs’ (BFL) frontier technologies raise questions where there is no established precedent – especially as we push further into video, perception and physical AI.

We’re hiring a Privacy & Product Counsel to find solutions and help drive our product teams forward. You’ll sit in our Legal, Policy & Assurance (LPA) team and be embedded with research, product and engineering, shaping how BFL builds and ships.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build a privacy function at the frontier of AI and robotics.

What You’ll Work On

  • Product counselling. Be the go-to lawyer for product teams on new models, API features and innovative products, from first spec to launch, giving clear, risk-calibrated advice that keeps us shipping.

  • Marketing. Partner with our Growth, Marketing and DevRel teams to review launch announcements, model cards and campaign copy so that our claims about FLUX are accurate. Advise on privacy matters relating to product marketing, analytics, commercial and creator partnerships, and advertising claims.

  • Privacy by design. Own BFL’s GDPR programme across the model lifecycle: training data, fine-tuning, inference, logging and retention. Run point on DPIAs and privacy documentation as required.

  • Customer commitments. Partner with GTM on DPAs, zero-data-retention and no-training terms, security questionnaires and enterprise negotiations – and work with the team to ensure that what we promise matches what we do.

  • International transfers and vendors. Manage EU–US transfer mechanisms (SCCs, the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and TIAs), and run privacy diligence on sub-processors and AI tooling.

  • US privacy. Track and implement obligations under US state privacy laws (CCPA/CPRA and peers) and emerging AI-specific state legislation.

  • Regulatory interface. Prepare BFL for engagement with data protection authorities, and handle data subject requests, complaints and incidents, including breach assessment and notification.

  • Policy and documentation. Draft and maintain privacy notices, internal policies, records of processing and the privacy elements of compliance documentation.

  • Scale the function. Build playbooks, templates and training so the rest of BFL can handle routine privacy questions without you.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8 years’ PQE as a qualified lawyer in an EU/EEA jurisdiction or the UK, with a substantial focus on data protection and product counselling

  • Experience at a technology company, in a top-tier law firm’s privacy or tech practice, or both – ideally including time in-house advising product teams directly

  • Deep, practical command of the GDPR (and the German BDSG), the ePrivacy framework and international transfer rules, plus a working knowledge of how other relevant EU regulations, such as the EU AI Act, interact with them

  • Familiarity with US privacy and AI law (CCPA/CPRA, BIPA, and state AI and deepfake statutes)

  • A track record of advising on AI, ML or data-intensive products: you understand training pipelines, inference and feature releases well enough to ask engineers the right questions

  • Comfort giving direct, pragmatic advice under uncertainty – you can turn a novel legal question into a clear recommendation and workable product guidance

  • Strong drafting skills across DPAs, privacy notices, DPIAs and commercial privacy terms

  • Excellent written and spoken English; you can explain complex issues to researchers, executives and regulators alike

  • An ownership mindset and low ego: you’re comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where you build processes, not just follow them

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience with generative AI, computer vision or media products – particularly involving biometric data, likeness rights or synthetic media

  • Direct experience engaging with data protection authorities or the EU AI Office

  • CIPP/E, CIPT or equivalent certification

  • German language skills

  • An interest in adjacent areas such as security and trust & safety


How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe or the US and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg / San Francisco to stay connected with the team.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

Closing

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.


Compensation

EU: €150,000 - €200,000 + equity
US $200,000 - $250,000 USD

Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

title: Product Engineer KI-first (m/w/d) - Full Stack, 100 % remote
descriptionHtml:
In unserem Portal bereiten mittelständische Unternehmen ihren Antrag bei der Bescheinigungsstelle Forschungszulage vor. Sie erfassen dort Projektzeiten und Kosten, laden ihre Unterlagen hoch und arbeiten mit unseren Beratern aus ihrer Entwicklungsarbeit ein förderfähiges Vorhaben heraus. Das Portal läuft, Mandanten arbeiten damit, und es hat noch viel vor sich.

Dafür suchen wir die Person, die es verantwortet. Sie haben schon einmal eine produktive Anwendung weitgehend allein getragen und wollen das wieder tun. Sie entscheiden mit, was als Nächstes entsteht, und Sie bauen es: Funktionen, Antragsprozess, Oberfläche, Server und Sicherheitsarchitektur. Dabei arbeiten Sie KI-first. Coding-Agenten sind Ihr erstes Werkzeug und nicht Ihr letztes Wort, denn Sie bauen schnell und beweisen dort, wo es zählt, dass es stimmt.

fundloop unterstützt mittelständische Unternehmen dabei, ihre Forschung und Entwicklung zu finanzieren. Sie arbeiten zu 100 Prozent remote, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und zu den Menschen, die mit Ihrem Werkzeug arbeiten.

Aufgaben

Sie entwickeln unser Portal eigenverantwortlich weiter, von der Idee bis zum Betrieb. Im Einzelnen heißt das:

  • Funktionen bauen, die Mandate voranbringen: Sie nehmen auf, woran Berater und Mandanten hängen bleiben, entscheiden mit uns über die Reihenfolge und liefern in kurzen Zyklen aus.

  • Den Antragsprozess weiterentwickeln: Der Weg vom Mandantengespräch bis zum fertigen Antragsentwurf ist bei uns ein geführter, KI-gestützter Ablauf mit fachlichen Prüfschritten. Sie machen ihn treffsicherer und schneller und sorgen dafür, dass er auch bei vielen parallelen Mandaten trägt. Das fachliche Urteil bleibt bei unseren Beratern.

  • Mit Sprachmodellen arbeiten, im Portal und beim Bauen: Sie gestalten Prompts, Agenten und Prüfläufe und messen, ob ein Schritt wirklich besser geworden ist.

  • Die Sicherheitsarchitektur verantworten: Mandantentrennung auf Datenbankebene, Rollen und Rechte, Verschlüsselung, Zwei-Faktor-Anmeldung und Protokollierung. Unsere Mandanten vertrauen uns Personal- und Finanzdaten an. Vor jeder Auslieferung prüft deshalb ein Test die Mandantentrennung, und Sie bauen diese Beweisführung aus.

  • Server und Betrieb führen: Auslieferung, Testumgebung, Datenbankmigrationen, Backups und Überwachung. Sie halten die Umgebung schlank, nachvollziehbar und wiederherstellbar.

  • Oberfläche und Nutzerführung gestalten: Sie sorgen dafür, dass eine Geschäftsführerin oder ein Entwicklungsleiter ohne Schulung durch das Portal kommt. Ein Design-System gibt es bereits.

  • Datenschutz mitdenken: Sie setzen technische und organisatorische Maßnahmen um und entscheiden bei jedem neuen Dienst mit, ob er zu unseren Anforderungen passt.

Qualifikation

Darauf kommt es an

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen im produktiven Betrieb, in TypeScript und React, am besten mit Next.js. Eine Anwendung haben Sie schon einmal weitgehend allein getragen.

  • PostgreSQL und Zugriffskonzepte als sicheres Fundament. Row Level Security, Rollenmodelle und Migrationen sind für Sie Handwerk, und bei jeder Änderung fragen Sie, wer danach worauf zugreifen kann.

  • Sie arbeiten KI-first, beim Bauen und in der Anwendung. Coding-Agenten sind Ihr tägliches Werkzeug, Sie können ihre Ergebnisse einordnen, prüfen und verwerfen. Außerdem haben Sie schon Abläufe mit Sprachmodellen in eine Anwendung gebaut und wissen, wie man deren Qualität misst.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, da Portal, Anträge und Fachgespräche auf Deutsch stattfinden. Englisch brauchen Sie für Dokumentation und Fachliteratur.

  • Betrieb in eigener Hand: Linux, Docker, Auslieferung und Backups, am besten mit einer Wiederherstellung, die Sie schon einmal wirklich geübt haben. Erfahrung mit Supabase, gern auch im Eigenbetrieb, ist ein Plus.

  • Die Anforderungen der DSGVO an Software, die personenbezogene Daten verarbeitet.

  • Gespür für Nutzerführung. Sie müssen nicht Design studiert haben, aber Sie merken, wenn ein Formular jemanden allein lässt.

  • Lust auf ein Fachthema. Das Forschungszulagengesetz müssen Sie nicht kennen. Sie sollten es aber verstehen wollen, denn die besten Funktionen entstehen dort, wo Sie den Prozess selbst durchdrungen haben.

  • Remote heißt bei uns Vertrauen. Sie setzen Ihre Prioritäten eigenständig und sagen früh, wenn etwas hakt.

Benefits

  • 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Vor Ort sehen wir uns nur gelegentlich, bei uns in Düsseldorf.

  • Unbefristet, in Vollzeit oder vollzeitnaher Teilzeit, Start nach Vereinbarung.

  • Verantwortung für das Ganze. Architektur, Werkzeuge und Reihenfolge entscheiden Sie mit, statt Tickets abzuarbeiten.

  • Werkzeuge, mit denen Sie schnell sind. Aktuelle Modelle und Coding-Agenten gehören bei uns zur Grundausstattung.

  • Kurze Wege. Sie sprechen direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und mit allen, die mit Ihrem Werkzeug arbeiten.

  • Wirkung, die man sieht. Was Sie bauen, kommt kurz darauf in der Arbeit an echten Förderanträgen an.

  • Ein Thema mit Rückenwind. Die Forschungszulage wächst, der Beratungsbedarf im Mittelstand wächst mit.

Wenn Sie lieber ein ganzes Portal verantworten als einen Ausschnitt davon, dann passen Sie zu uns.

So geht es weiter: Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage. Im ersten Gespräch lernen Sie die Geschäftsführung kennen. Im zweiten lösen Sie eine überschaubare Übungsaufgabe, die unserem Alltag nachgebaut ist, mit den Werkzeugen Ihrer Wahl, und zeigen uns Ihren Weg zum Ergebnis. Danach entscheiden wir gemeinsam und zügig.

Arbeitgeber ist die Fundloop GmbH, Fleher Str. 32, 40223 Düsseldorf.

title: Product Lead - AI Finance App
descriptionHtml:

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Finance App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Product
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on product expert to collaborate closely with clients and engineers to identify opportunity and figure out what we need to build to accelerate growth and decarbonisation.

What you will be doing

  • Driving product–market fit including in new markets, ensuring customer needs and commercial objectives stay in sync.

  • Championing a customer-first mindset, translating feedback into impactful product solutions.

  • Overseeing end-to-end delivery - from scoping and defining success metrics to launch and iteration.

  • Designing user experiences that are clear, intuitive, and drive measurable impact

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of product management experience

  • Proven ownership of delivery: you've been responsible for something live in the real world, not only the strategy or concept around it

  • Experience building products that touch the physical world. You respect real-world complexity and design around things going wrong

  • Experience in B2B, B2B2C or data-heavy products, with comfort working across partners and end users

  • User research and discovery: you know how to speak to users and run discovery towards a clear goal

  • You identify pain points and needs, turn them into plans, and ensure delivery.

  • Comfortable with hands-on prototyping and design, at least to the level of high-fidelity concepts

Nice to have

  • Fluency in one or more European languages

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary. We operate with a deliberately flat structure. We aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bupa private healthcare from day one of employment.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

  3. Final interview (in-person)

descriptionHtml:
Über Uns

Ginmon ist einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Deutschland. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2014 in Frankfurt am Main verfolgt das Unternehmen die Mission, professionelles, wissenschaftlich fundiertes Vermögensmanagement einer breiten Zielgruppe zugänglich zu machen. Mit apeiron hat Ginmon diese Technologie und Investment Expertise zu einer eigenständigen B2B-Plattform weiterentwickelt, die sich gezielt an unabhängige Vermögensberater:innen richtet. apeiron unterstützt Berater:innen mit intelligenten Tools für Beratung, Portfoliomanagement, digitales Onboarding, Gebührenabrechnung und Wertpapierabwicklung und ermöglicht ihnen damit ein modernes, skalierbares Endkundenerlebnis.

Als Product Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung von apeiron und gestaltest somit die technologische Zukunft der unabhängigen Vermögensberatung in Deutschland aktiv mit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Markt- und Nutzerforschung durch und identifizierst neue Produkt-Features und Trends im Bereich WealthTech.

  • Du übernimmst vollständige Verantwortung für deine eigenen Themenbereiche und trägst aktiv zu Produktentscheidungen bei.


Dein Profil

title: Product Manager, Finance Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us to redefine the future of on-demand delivery. To do this, we're building a world-class Finance Engineering (FinEng) organization across all global markets we support at DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. in which each of our product managers plays a critical role in helping to define and execute our vision to move money accurately and at scale across every market we operate in and ensure finance and accounting compliance. As we grow, billions of dollars in money movements flow through our platform every year and our team makes sure every one of them is understood, trusted, and correctly reflected in the financial books.

About the Role

Product Managers on the Finance Engineering team need a systems-oriented mindset, platform thinking, and strong cross-functional collaboration. In this role, you will define the strategy and vision for systems that track billions of dollars in company-wide money movement, translate transactions into accounting entries, and accelerate the financial close. You will build scalable, audit-ready automation for complex, high-volume financial activity.

This is an opportunity to reshape modern accounting by applying AI to reconciliation, investigations, and incident detection and mitigation. Your products will form a critical part of the company's financial infrastructure and help earn the confidence of leadership, auditors, and regulators.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Drive the product definition, strategy, and long-term vision for accounting automation. You own the roadmap
  • Build systems that track billion-dollar-level money movements across the entire company and automatically convert them into accurate accounting entries
  • Reinvent and accelerate the accounting close process, reducing manual effort and shortening close timelines
  • Champion AI-driven approaches to transform close reconciliation, financial investigations, and incident detection and mitigation
  • Partner with FinEng, Accounting, and Finance leaders to translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into scalable, automated products
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, accountants, and operators
  • Communicate product plans, benefits, and results to key stakeholders including the leadership team

We're excited about you because…

  • You have a track record in product management, including driving product strategy, vision, and roadmap alignment
  • You have built complex, back-end, data-intensive, or platform products. Ideally in fintech, payments, accounting, or financial systems
  • You have a strong grasp of accounting concepts (e.g. double-entry, ledgers, reconciliations, the close process) and how financial data flows through complex system
  • You do your best work with range: global platform thinking alongside the accounting reality of a specific brand or market
  • You're an execution power-house who thrives in ambiguity and operates at the lowest level of detai
  • You are excited about applying AI/ML to real-world financial problems such as reconciliation, investigation, and incident mitigation
  • You have experience presenting business reviews to senior executives
  • You have empathy for the users you build for, including accountants, controllers, and finance operators
  • You are motivated by building financial infrastructure that works across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

title: Product Manager IA - Paris
descriptionHtml:
💡 Envie de construire des produits IA qui vont au-delà du POC ?

L'intelligence artificielle transforme les usages, mais le véritable défi reste de concevoir des solutions utiles, performantes et capables de passer à l'échelle.

Chez Hubvisory, nous accompagnons de grandes organisations dans la conception et le développement de produits digitaux à forte valeur ajoutée.

Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Product Manager spécialisé(e) en IA pour imaginer, structurer et déployer des solutions innovantes, en combinant vision produit, compréhension technologique et impact business.

🎯 Ton rôle au quotidien

Tu interviendras sur des projets stratégiques, de l'identification des opportunités jusqu'au déploiement des solutions.

Tes principaux challenges :

  • Identifier les opportunités IA : comprendre les enjeux business et utilisateurs pour faire émerger des cas d'usage pertinents.

  • Définir la stratégie produit : construire et prioriser une roadmap cohérente, en intégrant les possibilités offertes par les LLM, le RAG et les agents IA.

  • Passer de l'expérimentation à l'industrialisation : évaluer la faisabilité, anticiper les contraintes et garantir la création de valeur.

  • Mesurer la performance : définir les bons indicateurs, suivre l'adoption et optimiser les solutions en continu.

  • Embarquer les parties prenantes : porter une vision claire, faciliter les arbitrages et accompagner le changement.

Tu auras l'occasion d'évoluer dans des environnements exigeants, auprès de références telles que LVMH, Sephora, TF1 ou l'Urssaf.

Nous recherchons avant tout un(e) Product Manager capable de connecter les enjeux business aux possibilités concrètes de l'intelligence artificielle.

Ce qui fera la différence :

  • Les concepts de LLM, RAG, IA générative et systèmes agentiques te sont familiers.

  • Tu es à l'aise dans des environnements complexes, avec des interlocuteurs variés.

  • Tu communiques avec aisance en français comme en anglais.

Ton état d'esprit ? Curieux(se), analytique, autonome et toujours à l'affût des évolutions de l'écosystème IA.

✨ Ce que tu trouveras chez Hubvisory

Rejoindre Hubvisory, c'est intégrer une communauté de passionnés du Product, où l'expertise se partage et où chacun peut continuer à progresser.

Au programme :

  • 🎓 Un onboarding de 2 semaines au sein de notre Campus pour approfondir tes compétences Product.

  • 📈 Une évolution accompagnée, avec des revues salariales deux fois par an.

  • 🎁 Des avantages complémentaires : intéressement et jours de congés supplémentaires.

  • 🎉 Une vraie vie d'équipe : événements, séminaires, activités et moments de convivialité.

46 000 à 58 000 € brut annuel fixe, selon expérience, auxquels s'ajoutent une rémunération variable et un dispositif d'intéressement.
