title: Member of Technical Staff - Infrastructure Security
descriptionHtml:
About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

 

Why This Role

We develop AI models and run the infrastructure on which those models are trained, deployed, and served to customers. Securing that infrastructure comes with real challenges: researchers need flexible access to significant compute resources, production systems need strong isolation and reliability, and model assets and customer data need protection throughout their lifecycle.

Our research and production infrastructure teams design, build, and operate these systems. We're looking for an experienced, hands-on security engineer to partner with them as we grow: someone who can dig into the details, do the engineering, and work alongside those teams to improve our defensive posture.

This is an engineering role: you'll spend time reading code, understanding systems, debugging problems, and shipping changes.

 

What You’ll Work On

These are the areas this role draws from; you're not expected to cover
them all at once:

  • Infrastructure architecture and isolation. Understand how our research and production environments fit together, identify consequential attack paths, and work with infrastructure teams to improve network boundaries, workload isolation, and access controls.

  • Identity and access. Improve how people, services, and workloads authenticate and obtain access to infrastructure. Reduce unnecessary privileges, strengthen secrets management, and develop practical approaches to short-lived credentials and privileged access.

  • Cloud and compute security. Strengthen security across cloud infrastructure, compute clusters, containers, storage, and orchestration systems. Help establish reusable patterns that engineers can adopt without unnecessary friction.

  • Model and customer-data protection. Work with research and engineering teams to protect model artifacts, training and inference pipelines, and sensitive data. Understand where trust boundaries matter and develop ways to verify that they hold.

  • Security in engineering workflows. Improve the security of infrastructure-as-code, build and deployment pipelines, and software artifacts. Build tooling and guardrails that help engineering teams prevent, detect, and fix problems without making security a bottleneck.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience securing production cloud infrastructure, with a solid understanding of identity, networking, operating systems, and distributed systems.

  • Hands-on engineering ability. You can write and review code, work with infrastructure-as-code, debug unfamiliar systems, and implement the improvements you recommend.

  • Good security judgment. You can distinguish meaningful risks from theoretical ones, make sensible tradeoffs, and explain why a particular security improvement matters.

  • Experience working closely with infrastructure or platform engineers, including designing changes that are practical to deploy and operate.

  • Experience in using LLMs and agents for security work, along with a clear-eyed view of where they help, where they don't, and how they themselves can be attacked.

  • Comfort working with real autonomy, finding your way through complex systems, and turning loosely defined problems into concrete improvements.

Experience with GPU clusters, ML infrastructure, multi-tenant services, Kubernetes, and software supply-chain security would be particularly relevant, but none is a prerequisite. We're more interested in people who have solved difficult security problems in real systems than in candidates who can check every box on a technology list.

 

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in San Francisco, and you’ll join us in the office at least 2 days a week, or one full week every other week.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Base Annual Salary:

US $220,000 - $280,000 USD + Equity

 

Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is  $12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role: 

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows.

You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Our stack runs on AWS, with workloads orchestrated on Kubernetes and data anchored in Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres). You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions.

Operational ownership is part of the job. You will participate in the on-call rotation and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes.

You will also build and apply AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production.

This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance.

What you’ll do: 

  • Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure: identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity.
  • Connect business understanding to improvements across the system: learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope.
  • Engineer for scale and performance: build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload.
  • Design and build AWS infrastructure: implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow.
  • Build and operate the Kubernetes platform: improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability.
  • Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres: tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers.
  • Improve reliability through engineering: define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures.
  • Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents: use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems.
  • Implement and test disaster recovery: design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results.
  • Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation: make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. Eliminate recurring manual work through code.
  • Build observability that makes production diagnosable: improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with visibility into service health, scaling limits, and customer impact.
  • Deliver safe infrastructure migrations: design phased rollouts, compatibility checks, validation, and rollback paths for changes to shared production systems.
  • Improve cloud cost efficiency through technical changes: right-size resources, improve utilization, tune autoscaling and storage, and quantify savings while maintaining reliability and performance targets.
  • Build and evaluate AI-assisted operational tooling: apply AI to investigation, runbooks, anomaly analysis, and repetitive operations, with bounded permissions, reviewable actions, and measurable improvements in accuracy or toil.
  • Make technical decisions clear and executable: write architecture proposals, evaluate technology tradeoffs through prototypes and benchmarks, review changes affecting shared infrastructure, and document how systems operate and fail.

What We look for: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required)
  • 12+ years of experience across infrastructure, platform, site reliability, software development, or related engineering disciplines, with substantial hands-on depth designing and operating production infrastructure at scale.
  • Deep expertise with AWS: production experience across compute, IAM, multi-account architectures, and networking, including VPC design and private connectivity.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production: cluster lifecycle, scheduling, resource management, autoscaling, networking, and troubleshooting business-critical workloads. EKS experience is strongly preferred.
  • Deep expertise with relational databases at scale, specifically RDS/Aurora (MySQL and/or Postgres): query performance, indexing, connection management, replication, high availability, failover, and verified backup and recovery.
  • A track record of personally delivering infrastructure scaling improvements: identifying constraints, measuring baseline behavior, implementing changes, and demonstrating gains in capacity, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency.
  • Strong coding and automation skills, using Golang, Python, or similar languages to build production tooling and eliminate operational toil, alongside infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or equivalent.
  • Strong systems fundamentals: Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, storage, concurrency, and distributed system failure modes, with the ability to debug problems across infrastructure and application boundaries.
  • Experience operating a 24/7, high-availability platform where downtime has direct customer or revenue impact, including hands-on incident response and postmortem remediation.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and demonstrated ability to recover production systems under pressure using evidence-based triage, safe mitigation, and clear technical communication.
  • Experience implementing and testing disaster recovery against defined recovery objectives, including restoring data and validating service recovery.
  • Practical experience with observability, load testing, capacity planning, and safe CI/CD practices for shared production infrastructure.
  • Active use of AI tooling in engineering or operations, with practical judgment about its limitations and how to verify generated code, recommendations, and operational actions.
  • Ability to carry ambiguous technical problems from investigation through production delivery and collaborate across engineering disciplines to resolve system-wide constraints.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or banking, operating infrastructure with demanding reliability, security, and audit requirements.
  • Experience with multi-region architectures, chaos engineering, and failure testing, including the consistency and recovery tradeoffs of distributed data systems.
  • Proficiency with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, or comparable observability systems.
  • Experience building internal platform capabilities and self-service tooling, including deployment automation, progressive delivery, and reusable infrastructure components.
  • Experience building AI-assisted incident investigation or operational automation with restricted access, auditable execution, and clear human review points

About You: 

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.
  • You go deep: you investigate how systems behave under load and failure, follow the evidence, and fix underlying causes.
  • You build and ship: you turn architecture into working code, tested infrastructure, and safe production changes.
  • You measure results: you can explain the impact of your work in availability, latency, capacity, recovery time, cost, or hours of toil removed.
  • You value simplicity: you choose systems that are understandable, operable, and appropriate to the problem, and reduce unnecessary complexity.
  • You earn trust: you listen carefully, communicate clearly, challenge technical decisions respectfully, and follow through on commitments.
  • You stay accountable for the outcome: you verify that changes work in production and that fixes remain effective as the platform scales.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Python
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres
  • DevOps and Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

title: Senior AI Product Designer  (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What you'll own as our Senior AI Product Designer

  • You'll own end-to-end design for one of our core product areas, on a platform where AI is the foundation of the product, not a bolt-on feature. Your mission is to bring consumer-grade craft to a B2B healthcare product used by clinicians and hospital administrators under real time pressure, and to help invent the design patterns for AI-native surfaces that don't exist anywhere else yet.

  • You design the AI-native surfaces our platform is built around, including multi-modal interfaces, agent state, uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop controls, inventing the patterns as you go rather than adapting existing ones.

  • You own end-to-end design for a product area – Discharge Core, Voice Desktop, Extract & Docs, Patient Overview, or Agent – taking work from a messy problem statement through to what ships in production.

  • You contribute to our design system, building the components and AI-specific conventions that other designers and teams build on.

  • You partner closely with product and engineering, shaping technical and product direction rather than being handed a spec to execute against.

    You work with other designers across the organisation, bringing your input and influence beyond your own product area rather than staying inside a single team's boundary.

  • You hold a high craft bar in critique, lifting the standard of what the wider design team ships.

You help hold coherence across our AI Suite (Voice, Docs, Extract, Agent) and Discharge Core, so a fast-growing multi-product platform still feels like one product to the people using it.

How we design:

  • We're AI-native. We use AI tools daily in our own process, not just in what we design, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well.

  • Consumer-grade craft is the bar, even in B2B. Our users are clinicians and hospital administrators.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default. This is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and verification moments that make that real, not just a confidence score bolted on.

  • We ship in production, not just in Figma. Craft is judged by what clinicians actually use, so we stay close to what ships.

What to expect as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.


Here's how we picture you as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d):

  • You have 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years operating at Senior, Principal, or Staff altitude.

  • You have designed for AI and non-determinism before, and can talk concretely about how you've communicated agent behaviour, handled errors, and kept users in control, not just in the abstract.

  • You have owned or significantly contributed to a design system, at the level of patterns and principles rather than individual components.

  • You are block-shaped: equally strong across UX process, UI craft, product thinking, research, storytelling, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • You have taken features from 0 to 1 through an ambiguous problem statement to shipped code, and you're comfortable feeling like a PM or frontend developer on the days that calls for it.

  • You have high agency and spot gaps without being asked to look for them, including outside your own product area.

  • You hold a position under pressure but change it when new information warrants, rather than becoming precious about your own decisions.

  • You communicate confidently in English and are comfortable operating in an international environment; German is a plus but not required.

  • You bring a consumer-grade craft background with exceptional design; healthtech experience is a plus but not required.

  • If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior DevOps Engineer

Reports to: Engineering Manager

Location: UK / Europe

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we’re building this organisation from the ground up. We’re looking for people who’d rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you’ve previously managed.

About the Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Radiant, you’ll be a hands-on engineer at the heart of our engineering organisation, owning the design, delivery and reliability of critical infrastructure. You’ll automate and continuously improve our deployment pipelines, cloud and bare-metal environments, and Kubernetes-based orchestration layer, so our systems scale reliably to support high-performance AI and GPU workloads.

You’ll partner with Infrastructure, SRE and Product Engineering teams to embed a strong DevOps culture across the organisation. You’ll champion infrastructure as code, observability and automation at every layer of the stack, and help improve how we build and operate systems at scale.

Our engineering teams cover Infrastructure, Cluster, Network, Storage, Cloud, Observability, Security, and AI (Training & Inference).

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and continuously optimise CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions to support fast, reliable, and repeatable software delivery

  • Own and evolve Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform and Ansible, ensuring infrastructure is version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and consistently provisioned across dev, staging, and production

  • Scale CI to handle agent-driven change volume, including merge queues and fast, parallel test runs

  • Identify and eliminate human and agent bottlenecks across the software development lifecycle

  • Instrument DORA metrics and agent adoption: agent versus hand-written merges, defect and rework rates

  • Manage and maintain hosted application environments, ensuring high availability, scalability, and smooth deployment of services into production

  • Partner closely with Engineers to deeply understand their development workflows and release processes, identifying and removing friction points that slow delivery

  • Measure and improve the developer experience, improving productivity

  • Champion a self-service DevOps culture, enabling development teams to own their deployments and operational concerns through well-designed tooling, documentation, and guardrails

  • Help make runbooks and decision records a natural part of our definition of done

Your Profile

  • Proven experience in DevOps engineering and best practices

  • Hands-on experience running and automating infrastructure across public cloud and bare-metal environments

  • Strong experience with CI/CD workflows, observability, security and automation best practices

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and Ansible

  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes, Helm and other containerisation related tooling

  • Demonstrable scripting ability in Go, Python and Shell

  • Strong knowledge of branching, deployment strategies including the use of Git based version control

What You Bring

  • Automation instinct: If you do it twice, you automate it.

  • Engineering quality: Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and review others’ work with care.

  • Ownership: Take features from design through production, and stay accountable for how they run.

  • Pragmatism: Ship what matters, simply, and improve it from real-world feedback.

  • Collaboration: Work openly with product, infrastructure and SRE, and share what you learn.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two engineers) → Final.

If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team.

We're a group that cares about getting the story right, not just getting it out the door. We work closely with product, sales, and demand gen, and we hold ourselves to a high bar because our work directly shapes how the market understands what we build.

This role gives you real ownership. You'll shape positioning and messaging for a meaningful piece of our product portfolio, build the competitive intelligence that keeps our field teams sharp, and work directly with sales leaders who depend on your materials to close deals. It's a role with visible impact, not one where your work disappears into a shared drive.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive go-to-market strategy for your area, from positioning through launch through enablement, while partnering with product and sales to make sure the message actually lands. This role matters because clear, credible product marketing is what turns a strong platform into a business result. Camunda operates in a technical, complex space, and getting that translation right is not optional.

What You Will Do

  • Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating technical capability into a clear value proposition for both technical and business buyers.

  • Build and maintain a competitive intelligence program that sales actually uses, not just battlecards that sit in a folder.

  • Lead go-to-market execution for launches in your area, coordinating across product, sales, and demand gen so the message is consistent everywhere it shows up.

  • Arm the field with content that works in real conversations: pitch decks, demos, solution briefs, and objection handling.

  • Use market and customer research to inform product and positioning decisions, not just to validate ones already made.

  • Mentor and support other marketers on your team, sharing what you've learned without being asked.

What You Will Bring to the Role

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: UK. Fully remote, or from our London office next to East Croydon Station

Working pattern: Fully remote working is allowed, and the London office is available to you

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will build the products drivers and car park operators use every day: ANPR camera enforcement, pay-by-web, Autopay, permits, a client console and a motorist account app, across about 160 sites, and the new products we build next. We are a small engineering team, and we form teams around the work from the people we have.

We work in Kotlin on the backend (Spring Boot WebFlux, a domain-driven layering of domain, edge services and repository, Postgres, Axon event sourcing and Pub/Sub) and in TypeScript with Next.js and React on the front end, on GCP and Kubernetes. You do not need to know Kotlin to apply. Our engineers work with AI coding agents day to day, and we are looking for people who use them well and check what they produce.

Every engineer here is product-minded. You will talk to the people who use what you build, decide with product people what is worth building, and find out afterwards whether it worked.

You will report to the CTO and work with a team that reviews each other’s work.

The Mid-level

Mid-level Software Engineer. You own features end to end: you shape them with a product person, build them, test them, release them and look after them once they are live. You work inside an existing architecture with senior review. The work is mostly Kotlin backend plus Next.js and React front end.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the delivery of what you are given, from the first ticket to production, with tests, and be the person who fixes it if it breaks.

  • Talk to the people who use what you build, and use what you learn to shape and cut scope.

  • Write acceptance criteria, and check a feature after release to see whether it was used and whether it worked.

  • Work in our existing codebase and its layering, and keep it consistent for the next engineer.

  • Use AI coding agents as part of how you work, and be accountable for everything you ship, however it was written.

  • Take part in the on-call rota and look after what you ship.

  • Review other engineers’ pull requests, and welcome review of your own.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re product-minded. In the last 12 months you’ve talked to real users or customers, and what you learned changed or cut the scope of what you built. You write acceptance criteria, you check a feature after release, and you can say whether something you shipped got used.

  • You’ve shipped production code end to end in the last 12 months, in any language. You can say what you personally built, and what happened after it went live.

  • You test as you build. You can describe a bug you shipped and the test that would have caught it.

  • You use AI coding agents in real work today, and you can describe how you check what they produce, including a time one was wrong.

  • You’re willing to be on call, and you take ownership of what you ship. You don’t need to have been on call before.

  • You work well in an existing codebase with a layered or domain-driven structure that you did not design, and you read before you write.

  • You’re comfortable across the stack. You’ve changed a React or Next.js front end, or worked properly against an API contract, even if you lean backend.

  • You review others’ pull requests, finding real problems and saying so well, and you change your own design when review shows you a better way.

You do not need a degree, a particular programming language, or Kotlin. Experience of Axon, Temporal, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, parking or payments is welcome, but none of it is required.

This advert is for the Mid-level. If you have more senior experience, see our Senior Software Engineer vacancy here.

What We Offer

  • Real ownership: mid-level engineers own whole features, and senior engineers own a product area.

  • A team that works with AI coding agents every day and measures what they do for us.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • Fully remote working in the UK, with access to a fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

title: Technical Pre - Sales Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious (Senior) Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

Your mission

As a Robotic Sales Engineer (RSE), you are RobCo’s technical face to the customer and the technical lead on every deal you own, from the first customer call to a handover-ready solution. You work as a team with our Account Executives, and every technical question on the deal runs through you. You carry a quota together with your AE, and you win deals as a team.

Your job is to understand the customer’s process better than anyone else in the room, decide early what is feasible and what is not, and turn a real production problem into a clear, qualified automation case. You recommend the right automation approach and hand it over to our Solutions Development team without late surprises.

You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help bring physical AI from the lab into real production. You show customers what robots that perceive, learn and adapt can do in their plant today. You have direct access to the engineers, product managers and data behind our robots, and you help shape what we build next.

What you will do

  • Qualify – Join discovery calls and site visits with your AE. Assess use cases early for technical fit, business value and risk, and say no when a deal does not fit.

  • Run requirement workshops – Lead structured on-site workshops with production, engineering and operations teams. Capture parts, processes, cycle times, layout, interfaces, safety and acceptance criteria.

  • Check feasibility – Make the first technical call on reach, payload, cycle time, gripping and vision. Use quick layouts, simulations and tests to back it up, and pull in Product or Solutions Development where needed.

  • Drive the concept – Turn workshop results into clear requirements and recommend the right automation approach. You own the collaboration with Solutions Development and Product until a complete, buildable concept is in place.

  • Be the technical face to the customer – Explain our robots and solutions to plant managers, engineers and executives in plain language. Run demos and support business cases and RaaS pricing inputs.

  • Close the loop – Feed field insights back to Product, so what customers need shapes what we build.

What you bring

  • 3+ years where automation meets the customer: technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects

  • You want to be measured by results: you share a quota with your AE and push deals over the line

  • You have had your hands on robot cells, from grippers and vision to feeders, conveyors and safety, and you know what makes them run on the shop floor

  • You walk through a plant, watch a process for ten minutes and see where automation pays off

  • You lead conversations with confidence, whether with an operator on the line or the plant manager signing off the investment

  • You think in structure: after your workshop, the team can build on what you captured

  • You can sketch a layout or check reach in CAD or simulation (e.g. Autodesk Fusion, Visual Components)

  • You speak German and English fluently and enjoy being on the road, around 30% of the time

  • Experience in physical AI (AI-based perception, learning-based manipulation, autonomous robots) is a plus

  • Know-how in machine tending, palletizing, assembly or pick-and-place is a plus

  • Robot programming or system integrator experience is a plus

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: Research Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is a quantitative trading firm at the forefront of technological innovation. We build and deploy cutting-edge systems within one of the world’s most advanced computing environments to power our global trading operations. Our non-siloed, collaborative coding environment empowers talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. At HRT, you'll be challenged to solve the most complex problems in trading alongside many of the brightest minds in the field.

We are seeking highly motivated and skilled Research Engineers who will work very closely with our Algo Developer (Quant Research) trading teams. These roles require exceptional programming fundamentals, a strong user focus, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with constantly evolving requirements. Multitasking and context switching are inherent aspects of this role, through which you will gain insight into the ideation and execution of some of the world's most sophisticated trading strategies.  

Research Engineers at HRT work on a wide variety of projects. Examples include:

  • Designing highly customized quantitative systems that enable Algo Developers to easily express and backtest new predictive signals.
  • Building world-class research tooling to speed up Algo Developers’ research iteration.
  • Aiding the development and deployment of very large deep learning models for HRT’s live trading.
  • Improving HRT’s monetization systems which turn our predictions into profitable trades.
  • Evaluating sim vs. live differences to improve the fidelity of our simulations.
  • Building systems to monitor and manage live trading.
  • Specializing in specific time horizons, from high frequency trading to mid-to-low frequency hedge fund-style strategies.
  • Working across a very wide variety of asset classes (from equities to fixed income to options) and regions (from North America to Asia Pacific) – you’ll interact with markets across the world!

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, performant, and scalable software systems.
  • Optimize existing codebases for performance, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Debug complex issues across distributed systems in a time-sensitive environment.
  • Optimize both the mechanics and ergonomics of Algo Developer research workflows; this requires developing a deep intuition for research methodologies.
  • Balance the short term goals of individual trading teams with the longer term goals of HRT’s generalized trading platforms across trading teams. Because we don’t work in a pod environment, REs on different trading teams are expected to share technology and ideas.

Qualifications

  • Completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. If you are currently pursuing your Bachelor's degree, please apply to our Campus/New Grad opportunities.
  • Previous experience at a top-tier finance or technology company with an excellent track record of rapid advancement and superlative reviews.
  • Experience with supporting internal users is preferred; bonus if you have real hands-on experience with quant research and/or ML/Deep Learning platforms.
  • Experience with python numerical, ML and data-oriented libraries is a big plus (e.g. pandas, scikit, pytorch, etc.)
  • Candidates should be prepared for technical interviews in either Python or C++. While there is no hard language requirement for RE roles, proficiency in one of these languages will be assessed during the interview process.
  • Kindness and empathy is a real requirement. No “smart jerks” at HRT. 
  • Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design principles.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • HRT ships every day. The ability to thoughtfully, methodically, and reliably deploy new software and features is a critical skill. 
  • If you have management experience, that’s always a bonus – but even so, expect to code!

The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

For more info about interviewing at HRT, see this blog!

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

Please be advised: Use of AI tools by an applicant during interviews or assessments is strictly prohibited, unless otherwise instructed or agreed upon. We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used by an applicant during an interview or an assessment, we reserve the right to immediately end the interview or assessment, disqualify the applicant’s candidacy and/or rescind any job offers extended.

You can review our Global Applicant Privacy Notice, which explains how we process applicant information.

title: Sales Data Analyst (Part-time)
descriptionHtml:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.

At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation! We are currently looking for a part-time Sales Data Analyst to join our Sales team and transform commercial data into actionable business intelligence. In this role, you will play a key part in sales reporting, performance analysis, forecasting, and opportunity tracking, enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. Reporting directly to the Director, B2B Sales & Marketing (Americas) and collaborating closely with Account Managers, Sales Operations, Finance, and other key stakeholders, you will deliver analytical insights that drive revenue growth, improve forecast accuracy, and identify opportunities to optimize sales performance. This role is offered on a part-time basis, with an expected commitment of 20 hours per week.
What you will do
  • Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly sales reports, tracking revenue YTD, actuals versus budget and forecast, and year-over-year performance.
  • Analyze sales performance by customer, region, brand, product, and SKU to highlight growth, declines, trends, and exceptions.
  • Produce customer-level performance summaries, including top and underperforming products, sales volumes, and opportunities for follow-up.
  • Support sales forecasts by consolidating Account Manager inputs, validating assumptions, and identifying gaps or changes versus plan.
  • Maintain new business and listing opportunity trackers, including expected launch timing, SKU assortment, estimated volumes, annualized value, and dependencies.
  • Help quantify the current-year and future-year revenue potential of new listings, distribution expansion, and customer initiatives.
  • Build and update Superset dashboards, NetSuite reports, Excel models, and standardized reporting templates that reduce manual work and improve consistency.
  • Monitor order, inventory, and fulfillment data where available to flag out-of-stock risks, delayed orders, and potential revenue impact.
  • Assist in preparing customer business reviews, sales presentations, and management updates with clear data visualizations and commentary.
  • Reconcile data across NetSuite, Superset, CRM records, and other sales sources; investigate discrepancies and maintain reliable reporting definitions.
  • Collaborate with Account Managers, Sales Operations, Finance, and other relevant teams to obtain data and clarify performance drivers.
  • Use AI-enabled tools responsibly to streamline recurring analysis, automate routine reporting tasks, and improve the speed and quality of commercial insights.
  • Maintain CRM pipeline data quality and work with Account Managers to track opportunities, deal stages, next steps, forecast timing, and key dependencies.
  • Help evaluate and improve CRM reporting and AI-supported workflows for sales forecasting, opportunity tracking, and account management.

    • What you should bring
  • Proven experience in Sales Analytics, Commercial Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar analytical role; B2B or consumer goods experience is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience using NetSuite for sales, order, customer, and revenue reporting, including saved searches or equivalent reporting tools.
  • Experience using Apache Superset to navigate, build, or maintain dashboards and analyze sales performance; basic SQL skills are an asset.
  • Practical experience with CRM systems and sales pipeline management, including opportunity stages, data hygiene, forecasts, and reporting.
  • Comfortable applying AI tools to research, data analysis, reporting, and workflow automation, with sound judgment around accuracy, confidentiality, and validation.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, and structured data analysis.
  • Ability to interpret revenue, unit sales, margin, budgets, forecasts, and customer and product performance data.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to reconcile and validate information from multiple business systems.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to turn findings into concise, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable balancing recurring deadlines and ad hoc requests in a part-time schedule.

    • What we can offer you
  • A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events.
  • Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun.
  • Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration.
  • Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
  • Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
  • Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.

    • Our interview process
  • CV review
  • Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Team Members
  • Hiring Manager Interview (MS Teams)
  • Hiring Team Interview, including a case-study presentation

    • Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

    If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.

    At Lovehoney Group, we embrace innovative technologies to enhance our recruitment process. We leverage artificial intelligence during screening interviews for CV reviews and note-taking. We prioritize transparency and respect your preferences, so you'll have the option to opt out of recording and AI-driven note-taking while still receiving full and fair consideration for the role.

    We currently have a hybrid work model supporting a blend of in-office and remote work (3 days per week in-office).

    If we sparked your interest and you are open to embarking on your professional path with us, please visit our Lovehoney careers page to apply: https://jobs.eu.lever.co/lovehoneygroup

    Our privacy policy is available here: https://www.lovehoneygroup.com/privacy-policy/

At Klue, We’re Building the Future of Competitive Intelligence

👋 And our UK Team is hiring an SDR

(P.s. We call our SDRs "Account Specialists" if you're having trouble finding them on LinkedIn)

Check out what a day in the life of an SDR is like here!

We're looking for people who are:

  • Relentless, and have a history of achieving. You don’t stop when you face adversity and have a proven record of growing and developing whatever you dedicate yourself to.

  • Self driven. No one has to tell you to be hungry to achieve. We’ll help point you in the right direction but it’s on you to push to get there and that comes naturally.

  • Curious and keen to learn. You’ll keep digging until you find the answer and when you do you’ll question it in case you can improve what you dig up.

What You'll Do

    • Highly targeted outbound prospecting

    • Nurturing and converting inbound leads.

  • Lead introductory calls and master the art of discovery. You'll learn to identify prospect pain points and articulate Klue's value in real conversations, building this crucial sales skill through hands-on experience.

  • Have the autonomy to work on projects beyond your role. From evaluating leading edge sales technology, to improving existing processes, or learning how to interview other SDRs your impact goes beyond just prospecting.

Our Foundational SDR Program

This is a learning culture. Your growth matters here. Starting with our 2-week foundational SDR onboarding program where you'll build strong prospecting skills with continued training throughout your 3-month ramp. Our team will help you advance, and in time, you'll mentor newer SDRs. Our commitment is clear: prepare you to be an expert prospector and a well-rounded sales professional.

Unlock Your Potential. Take Risks. Take Action. Innovate

  • Ownership: All full-time employees have the opportunity to participate in our Employee Stock Option Plan.

title: Sales Development Representative (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Sales Development Representative (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

You are part of our revenue team and actively drive the new customer pipeline. You independently build relationships with potential clients, qualify accounts, and turn market potential into concrete sales opportunities. With a data-driven and performance-oriented approach, you directly shape the growth of RobCo in Germany and make a significant contribution to the team’s success.

Your Responsibilities

  • Contact Specialist:
    You initiate first contact with potential customers and identify the right decision-makers.

  • Sales Professional:
    You generate new sales opportunities and work strategically within a dynamic marketing landscape.

  • Relationship Manager:
    You build and maintain relationships in line with RobCo’s Operating Principles and ensure a smooth handover to the Field Sales team.

  • Team Player:
    You collaborate closely with other departments and support our campaigns to optimize the overall sales strategy.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • 1–3 years of relevant professional experience in Sales Development, Business Development, or a comparable performance-driven role. You have experience in direct customer interaction and are motivated to actively contribute to building and growing the revenue team.

  • Results-driven: You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding prospecting and outreach quotas.

  • Technology enthusiast: You have a strong interest in robotics or the manufacturing industry.

  • Customer-focused: You are a natural networker who builds trusted customer relationships and understands the importance of excellent customer engagement.

  • Strong communicator: You possess excellent communication skills in both German and English.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

 

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

What will you accomplish?

  • Generating new opportunities across EMEA, with a core focus on expanding our footprint in the DACH region using outbound tactics (email sequences, LinkedIn, cold calling, etc.)

What do we need from you?

  • High energy, curiosity, and a strong drive to learn and grow within cybersecurity sales

What would give you an edge?

  • Domain knowledge in cybersecurity, third-party risk management, or supply chain information security

  • Experience with sales engagement and CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Outreach.io

  • Familiarity with prospecting and intelligence tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or Lusha

What's in it for you?

  • Flexible Hybrid Working: Start fully remote, with an upcoming transition in the new year to a brand-new central London office hub (targeting Soho or Waterloo) on a balanced 3-day onsite hybrid model!

title: SAR Manager
descriptionHtml:
Trust unlocks our greatest potential.

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Financial Crime Intelligence & Investigations Team as a Financial Crime SAR Manager? Reporting to the Senior Manager, you’ll act as a subject matter expert for financial crime intelligence analysis across our client base. Including conducting analysis of potential suspicious activity across a range of financial crime escalations, producing reports for both internal and external audiences, and providing support across the wider team where needed.

Candidates need to have proven experience in financial crime intelligence across different payment platforms and services. You’ll also have an excellent understanding of financial crime typologies, detection methods and intelligence analysis techniques, and share this knowledge with other members of the team. You’ll be comfortable working in an energetic environment and dealing with change whilst taking pride in owning and mitigating financial crime risk for the business.

You’ll demonstrate the confidence to raise concerns, shape strategic thinking and make well-informed decisions. You’ll bring strong knowledge of payment services, together with extensive technical and regulatory expertise across financial crime and sanctions in the UK and other jurisdictions, including relevant reporting obligations. You’ll also have a proven ability to identify, assess, and mitigate financial crime risk across the business.

Your role includes:

  • Leading complex financial crime investigations and providing senior-level oversight, challenge and direction on material or high-risk cases

  • Overseeing the allocation and prioritisation of investigative activity, ensuring resources are effectively deployed and key regulatory and operational deadlines are met

  • Building and managing effective relationships with senior stakeholders across the business, providing clear advice, challenge and escalation on financial crime matters

  • Providing oversight of financial crime risks associated with existing and emerging products and services, ensuring appropriate mitigation strategies are developed and implemented

  • Driving the development of financial crime, sanctions and money laundering typology knowledge across the team and wider business

  • Overseeing complex end-to-end enquiries and ensuring appropriate, timely and risk-based outcomes

  • Directing and overseeing research and intelligence activity to support the identification, assessment and investigation of potentially suspicious activity

  • Providing oversight and approval of relevant regulatory reports and disclosures, ensuring compliance with applicable AML legislation, regulation and reporting obligations

  • Accountable for team outcomes and responsible for complex/high risk decision making

  • Applying extensive technical and regulatory expertise to identify control weaknesses, assess risk exposure and influence appropriate remediation

  • Acting as a senior subject matter expert on financial crime and maintaining awareness of emerging AML trends, typologies and industry developments to strengthen the Bank’s detection and control capabilities

  • Developing strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders to influence decision-making, support strategic objectives and deliver effective financial crime risk management

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Extensive experience leading and providing oversight of complex financial crime investigations

  • Strong knowledge and practical application of financial crime control frameworks, regulatory requirements and industry standards

  • Good knowledge of sectors such as money remittance, electronic money, and cryptocurrency firms would be beneficial

  • Understanding of UK and EU AML/CTF legislation (international AML/CTF knowledge is advantageous)

  • Meticulous organisational skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate and negotiate with key/senior stakeholders

  • Understanding of money laundering typologies across a range of products and services

  • Solutions driven, with the appetite for constant improvement

  • In-depth knowledge of AML regulations and guidelines

  • Strong ethical standards and integrity in handling sensitive information

  • A recognised AML/Sanctions/Fraud qualification is highly desirable

  • Previous experience of Delegated Nominated Officer responsibilities would be advantageous

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.  Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter.   • Experience with automation and tooling development in one or more of the following: Python, Go, Shell, HCL, Rego.

Preferred qualifications
