title: Senior Board Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Turn board design insight into reliable tests that detect manufacturing defects in Graphcore’s hardware.

As a Senior Board Test Engineer in Bristol, you’ll develop manufacturing tests for Graphcore’s advanced electronic products. You’ll focus on printed circuit board assemblies and the faults that affect their operation.

Your work will help improve defect coverage across the test and inspection tools used by contract electronics manufacturers. You’ll help the team detect and manage hardware faults arising during manufacturing and product use.

You’ll analyse PCB designs for testability and manufacturing risks, then develop boundary scan and embedded functional tests. You’ll also diagnose complex electronic faults down to component level.

The role takes your test solutions beyond development, through deployment and support in factory and field environments.

The team and culture

The Product Test and Diagnosis team detects and manages hardware defects across chips, boards and finished systems. Its work covers manufacturing sites and products in the field.

You’ll work closely with Hardware Design and Manufacturing Operations, linking design analysis with manufacturing test needs. You’ll also work with software, silicon design and external board test partners on complex hardware problems.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong electronics fundamentals and experience in manufacturing test for advanced electronic systems.
  • Understanding of PCB manufacturing, surface-mount assembly, failure mechanisms, and automated optical and X-ray inspection capabilities.
  • Experience developing JTAG 1149 boundary scan test solutions.
  • Awareness of bed-of-nails testing (ICT/MDA) and high-volume in-system or on-board programming techniques (ISP/OBP).
  • Ability to solve problems in complex electronic systems and diagnose defects down to component level.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work with internal engineering teams and external board test partners.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension

  • Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
  • Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

Access to controlled technology

Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process.

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. The engineering challenge

You will design and evolve the services that power core banking products. The systems you help build process thousands of financial transactions every day. They must be scalable, resilient and secure. When money moves, it has to work. Every time.

But this role goes beyond implementation.

You will shape technical direction. Influence cross-team initiatives. Own complex, high-impact work from concept through to production. You will help decide not just how we build, but what we build and why.

This is senior in impact, not just title.

We’re growing across several of our product-engineering tribes at Zopa, with current opportunities in Current Accounts, Lending, Credit Cards and Product Enablement.

We care deeply about great engineering, which is why our core stack is Kotlin, running on a modern platform with Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker and AWS Aurora Postgres. But great engineers aren’t defined by a single language which is why we are agnostic with our hiring.

We want the right people, not the 'right' language, so if you come from a C#/.NET background, bring solid fundamentals, and have an appetite for learning something new, we’ll invest in you, help you grow your skills and confidently step into our Kotlin ecosystem.

  • Making architectural decisions that balance immediate delivery with long-term sustainability

  • Bringing structure and clarity to ambiguous problems

  • Influencing prioritisation and trade-offs across teams

  • Mentoring engineers and strengthening overall team capability

  • Driving continuous improvement in how we build and operate systems


    • Your toolkit:
  • You'll work with C#, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS Aurora Postgres, and other modern technologies. If you haven't worked with all of these, we value skilled engineers with a willingness to learn.

  • A track record of delivering high-impact, complex systems in production environments

  • Strong testing discipline, with a commitment to strictly following Test-Driven Development (TDD)

  • The ability to navigate ambiguity and turn complexity into clear, actionable plans

  • Ownership beyond your own output

    • We’ll support your transition and cross-training into a JVM/Kotlin environment. What matters most to us is how you think, how you approach problem-solving, and the scale and impact of what you’ve built.


    Our engineering culture:
  • Customer impact over unnecessary complexity
  • Team success over individual heroics
  • Operational ownership, not just feature delivery
  • Continuous improvement through honest feedback

    • Added bonus:
  • Experience with fintech or banking is a plus, but we value problem-solvers from all backgrounds

    • At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years’ experience of architecting, engineering, or supporting public cloud solutions on AWS or GCP.
  • Sound knowledge of AWS or GCP best practice, security considerations, and architectural design patterns.
  • Experience of implementing and supporting public-cloud based workloads and services.
  • Hold multiple current AWS or Google Cloud Certifications (or be able to demonstrate equivalent level of knowledge).
  • Experience of building solutions using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud formation) 
  • Experience of config management systems (e.g., Ansible).
  • Excellent Linux O/S knowledge and experience (RHCE or equivalent level of knowledge).
  • Scripting ability in Python, Perl, or Bash.
  • Experience of using Git for version control.

  • Experience of working with, designing, deploying, or supporting containerized environments (ECS/EKS/Kubernetes/Docker) is useful, but not essential.

title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo.

In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich.

Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Experimentation
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay makes millions of dynamic, interconnected decisions across its network every day, and each one shapes the experience of the thousands of couriers who work with us. Knowing what any one of those decisions actually did is hard: couriers interfere with each other, effects vary from person to person, and the outcomes that matter compound over time.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. You'll lead causal inference at Relay from the start.

Causal Inference Highlights

  • A live, two-sided marketplace to experiment in, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

  • Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-term outcomes are the norm here, not the exception.

  • Four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

  • Your insights and models feed straight into Relay's network-wide optimisation.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Data Scientist at Relay, you'll:

  • Set the standard for causal inference at Relay.

  • Measure how our decisions affect each courier, today and over time.

  • Shape how Relay experiments across a live, two-sided marketplace.

  • Adapt advanced techniques across causal inference, statistics and machine learning to Relay's problems, and see them through to production.

  • Partner with Operational Research to embed your insights and models into Relay's network-wide optimisation, and help build our research culture and voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Bring deep expertise in causal inference, experimentation and machine learning, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

  • Come from statistics, an experimental science such as biology or psychology, or quantitative research.

  • Have applied advanced techniques to real marketplaces or products, and owned the outcome.

  • Think in mechanisms, and let evidence guide decisions.

  • Are energised by open, interconnected problems, and know how to find the signal.

  • Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Data Scientist/ML Ops Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities

With a mission to empower 15.6 million house owners across Germany and the broader DACH region, we at Aroundhome are building a platform where every strategic decision is powered by data. We’re a team of around 250 people, and to take the next step, we’re looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Data Scientist (all genders) to bring machine learning into the heart of our product.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will build Aroundhome’s first machine learning model in production: the logic that decides which partners each homeowner is matched with. You will start from the problems homeowners and partners actually have, and own the solution end to end, in a small new team with a product manager, an engineer and the team lead.

Responsibilities:

  • Start from the Customer: Understand what homeowners and partners need from a match, and turn that into the outcomes and guardrails your models optimize for, not just model metrics.
  • Own Our Matching Models: Build and run the models behind our partner matching, end to end: data, features, training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring.
  • Make Every Match Count: Improve our matching logic with deployed models that make the most efficient use of partner capacity, raise match rates, and account for regional supply and demand.
  • Prove Impact: Measure every improvement against our current logic in controlled experiments designed for a two-sided marketplace, before it scales.
  • Build the Data Foundation: Create the datasets and pipelines your models need, together with our engineer and the Data Engineering team. In the first months, this is a big part of the role.
  • Shape Our ML Stack: Decide with the team how and where models run, and set the practices for machine learning at Aroundhome.
  • Translate Models into Decisions: Explain trade-offs between customer experience, partner fulfillment and revenue to product managers, partner category managers, key account managers and senior leadership.

Skills

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics).
  • Proven experience (5+ years) in applied data science, including at least one ads, ranking, pricing or marketplace model you took to production.
  • Production-grade Python and advanced SQL, plus hands-on experience with modern data tooling (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Spark).
  • Experience deploying and monitoring models on a cloud ML platform (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow).
  • Solid foundation in experiment design and causal inference, ideally in a marketplace where test and control groups affect each other.
  • Hands-on experience with classical machine learning (e.g., gradient-boosted trees), probability calibration and offline vs online evaluation.
  • A product mindset: you define success in homeowner and partner outcomes, challenge assumptions with evidence, and add complexity only where it earns its place.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain models and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A plus: experience with recommender systems or search ranking.

What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: Decide freely whether you want to work from our office in Berlin, from home throughout Germany, or fully remote from Portugal. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer monthly Tech Talks, an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner “Fürstenberg Institute” is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness for environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month at our Potsdamer Platz office, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

title: Senior Databasebeheerder (deeltijd 16 uur)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een ervaren databasespecialist die zijn technische expertise wil inzetten voor complexe vraagstukken en de verdere ontwikkeling van een modern dataplatform? Wil je bijdragen aan veilige, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige databasediensten binnen een maatschappelijke organisatie, maar zoek je bewust een functie voor 16 uur per week? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Als Senior Database Specialist versterk je ons team met specialistische kennis van Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL. Je richt je vooral op complexe technische vraagstukken, verbeteringen en vernieuwing. De dagelijkse operatie ligt bij het team; jij helpt juist daar waar extra expertise, verdieping of richting nodig is.

Onze databasediensten vormen een belangrijk onderdeel van de technische infrastructuur van het CBS. Beschikbaarheid, performance, veiligheid en continuïteit zijn daarbij essentieel. Tegelijkertijd ontwikkelen we onze dienstverlening verder door meer te automatiseren, nieuwe databaseservices te onderzoeken en onze infrastructuur verder te moderniseren.

Met jouw ervaring help je het team bij vraagstukken die verder gaan dan het dagelijkse beheer. Je analyseert complexe problemen, adviseert over technische keuzes en helpt structurele verbeteringen te realiseren. Daarbij werk je zowel met onze bestaande MSSQL- en PostgreSQL-omgevingen als aan de ontwikkeling van toekomstige databasediensten.

Omdat je 16 uur per week werkt, ligt de nadruk op werkzaamheden waarvoor jouw senior expertise de meeste waarde toevoegt:

  • analyseren en oplossen van complexe vraagstukken rondom MSSQL en PostgreSQL, waaronder performance, troubleshooting en database-optimalisatie;

  • adviseren over databasearchitectuur, high availability, disaster recovery, lifecycle management en de verwerking van grote hoeveelheden data;

  • initiëren en uitvoeren van structurele technische verbeteringen en bijdragen aan upgrades, migraties en automatisering van databasewerkzaamheden;

  • bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe databasediensten, waaronder Database as a Service en toekomstige technologieën zoals graphdatabases;

  • meedenken over de verdere modernisering van het platform, waaronder containerisatie, Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code en CI/CD;

  • verbeteren van monitoring, logging, capaciteitsbeheer, back-up- en restorevoorzieningen, encryptie, autorisaties en informatiebeveiliging en jouw kennis delen met collega’s en andere technische specialisten.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je komt te werken in Team Data & Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). De afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 30 IT-professionals die werkzaam zijn vanuit Heerlen en Den Haag. Het Team Data & Webdiensten bestaat uit ongeveer 15 collega’s.

Binnen het team werken we Agile in combinatie met ITIL. We gebruiken Azure DevOps om het werk inzichtelijk te maken en werken met stories en epics. Ook nemen we deel aan vaste momenten zoals dagstarts, planningen, reviews en retrospectives.

Met 16 uur per week maak je volwaardig onderdeel uit van het team, maar verwachten we niet dat je iedere operationele taak oppakt. In overleg bepalen we waar jouw expertise het meeste verschil kan maken. Je werkt daardoor nauw samen met de collega’s die dagelijks verantwoordelijk zijn voor de databasediensten en ondersteunt hen bij complexere technische vraagstukken en ontwikkelingen.
We werken met collega’s op verschillende locaties en vanuit verschillende specialismen. Kennisdeling, samenwerking en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk.

Dit ben jij

Je bent een ervaren databasespecialist die snel tot de kern van een technisch vraagstuk komt. Je hoeft niet voortdurend bij de dagelijkse operatie betrokken te zijn om te begrijpen wat er speelt en bent in staat om binnen je beschikbare tijd duidelijke prioriteiten te stellen.

Je combineert diepgaande databasekennis met een bredere blik op infrastructuur, automatisering en security. Je denkt niet alleen in tijdelijke oplossingen, maar zoekt naar structurele verbeteringen die ook op langere termijn waarde toevoegen.

Daarnaast kun je jouw technische afwegingen helder uitleggen. Je werkt gemakkelijk samen met andere technische disciplines, deelt je kennis en kunt collega’s adviseren zonder het werk van hen over te nemen.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • hbo-werk- en denkniveau en meerdere jaren relevante ervaring met het ontwerpen, beheren en optimaliseren van databaseomgevingen;

  • aantoonbare en diepgaande ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL, waaronder performance tuning, troubleshooting, back-up/restore en high availability;

  • ervaring met Windows- en Linux-serveromgevingen en automatisering met bijvoorbeeld PowerShell, Bash en/of Python;

  • kennis van databasebeveiliging, waaronder encryptie, autorisaties, informatiebeveiliging en compliance;

  • kennis van Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD en DevOps-werkwijzen en bij voorkeur ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Ansible;

  • kennis van ITIL-processen, sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve houding gericht op kennisdeling en continue verbetering.

Certificeringen op het gebied van Microsoft SQL Server en/of PostgreSQL zijn een pré.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 4132,- en maximaal € 6275,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. In totaal is dit 16,5% bovenop je salaris. Dit noemen wij het Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Je bepaalt zelf hoe, wanneer en op welke manier je dit budget wilt inzetten.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP Pensioenfonds.

  • Een laptop (Microsoft of Apple) en mobiele telefoon (Android of iOS).

  • Twee tot drie dagen thuiswerken, de rest ben je aanwezig in ons onlangs gerenoveerde gebouw. In je team maak je daar verder afspraken over.

Kom werken aan de feiten

We sluiten de vacature bij voldoende kandidaten.

title: Senior Designer RTW
descriptionHtml:
Born in 1971, the roots of Mulberry are in Somerset, England. For more than fifty years, Mulberry has been a British lifestyle brand, internationally acclaimed for quality and design capturing the Mulberry Spirit.
Sustainability has been part of the Mulberry ethos since the brand's inception, in recognition of our purpose-driven approach, in 2024 we proudly achieved B Corp Certification.
Today, we are a global brand, but our values remain the same; we are committed to improving our impact on people and the planet. To do this our people are honest, dynamic, and community spirited.
If these are values you share, we would love you to join our team.
The Role: To design the Women’s Ready-to-Wear (RTW) collections, working under the direction of the Design Director and contributing to the development of creative, commercially relevant and distinctive collections that reflect the Mulberry aesthetic. The Senior RTW Designer will take ownership of design projects from initial research and concept development through to sampling, fittings and PPS.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Research

  • Carry out research in line with the creative direction established by the Design Director and Creative Director, proactively identifying opportunities to develop and evolve the collection.
  • Demonstrate resourcefulness across a variety of research techniques, including library, online, archive and market research.
  • Identify inspiring references for silhouette, proportion, fabric, colour, print, texture, garment construction and finishing.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the luxury fashion landscape, identifying opportunities to introduce fresh perspectives whilst remaining true to the Mulberry brand.
  • Share research, knowledge and inspiration with the wider design team, supporting a collaborative and informed approach to design development.

Design

  • Design and develop the Women’s RTW collections, working under the direction of the Design Director to interpret the seasonal creative direction and translate it into a cohesive, distinctive and commercially relevant product offering.
  • Take ownership of design projects from initial concept through to final product, ensuring consistency of vision and quality throughout the development process.
  • Demonstrate strong creative judgement and the ability to develop original design ideas that balance innovation, wearability and commercial relevance.
  • Experiment with silhouette, proportion, fabrication, garment construction and detailing to create distinctive and varied collections.
  • Demonstrate confidence in developing ideas three-dimensionally through draping, toile development, garment manipulation and collaboration with pattern cutters and technical teams.
  • Apply an in-depth understanding of garment construction, fit, fabric behaviour and finishing to inform and strengthen design decisions.
  • Ensure individual designs proposals work cohesively within the wider collection, contributing to a balanced and considered product offering.
  • Present design concepts and proposals clearly and confidently, articulating the rationale behind creative decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure all designs are communicated effectively through accurate technical drawings, CADs, specifications and construction details, for the atelier and suppliers.
  • Manage workload and prioritise projects effectively, ensuring the critical path is adhered to, and all key deadlines are met.
  • Work collaboratively with the wider design, technical and production teams to ensure design intent is maintained throughout the product development process.
  • Maintain accurate records of design development, sample comments and amendments throughout the season.
  • Support the Junior RTW Designer in prioritising workload, improving technical accuracy and developing confidence and independence in their role.

Prototypes and Fittings

  • Take responsibility for ensuring prototypes and samples are developed and delivered in line with the critical path, working closely with product development
  • Lead or contribute to fit meetings and sample reviews, assessing garment fit, proportion, construction, fabric performance and overall appearance.
  • Provide clear, considered and technically accurate feedback to product development / suppliers, ensuring amendments are communicated efficiently and effectively.
  • Work collaboratively with pattern cutters, garment technicians and suppliers to resolve complex fit and construction issues. Demonstrate strong technical judgement when assessing samples, balancing creative intent with garment functionality and wearability.
  • Refine and improve designs throughout the sampling process, ensuring the final product reflects the original creative vision and meets the required quality standards.

Specifications and Production Handover

  • Work closely with the production development and technical teams to ensure product specifications are accurate, commercially viable and suitable for production handover.
  • Produce and oversee accurate technical sketches and CADs, ensuring all amendments following fittings and sample reviews are incorporated.
  • Ensure garment measurements, construction details, fabrications, trims and finishing specifications are clearly and accurately documented.

Culture:

  • Embrace and demonstrate the Mulberry values and behaviours: honesty, dynamism, and a community-oriented spirit.
  • Support Mulberry to deliver an inclusive culture, through behaving in a way that is open-minded and respectful towards others, and understanding that your views, opinions, and experiences may not always be shared by your colleagues.
  • Act as an ambassador for Mulberry and communicate positively about the brand.

Sustainability:

  • As a certified B Corp, we are committed to using business as a force for good. You’ll be encouraged to incorporate environmentally and socially responsible practices into your work, supporting our Made to Last strategy across Climate, Circularity, and Community.
  • Help foster a culture where diversity is celebrated and every individual feels valued, respected, and included. Champion equity, empathy, and understanding in all interactions - internally and externally.

Skills & Knowledge:

  • Appropriate degree in Fashion Design or a related discipline, supported by a strong portfolio.
  • Proven experience designing and developing a RTW collection from initial concept through to production at a similar level.
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, pattern cutting principles, fit and technical specifications.
  • In-depth knowledge of fabrics, trims and garment finishes, with a strong appreciation of quality, craftsmanship and luxury product development.
  • Demonstrable ability to take creative ownership of projects, exercise independent design judgement and translate seasonal direction into commercially relevant product.
  • Experience supporting, mentoring or guiding junior members of a design team.
  • Confident communicator, able to present and articulate ideas clearly, both verbally and visually.
  • Collaborative and approachable, with the ability to build positive working relationships across the business and within the RTW team.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working within a fast-paced, evolving design environment.
  • Self-motivated, proactive and resourceful, with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Highly creative, with a strong individual approach to design and a clear understanding of the Mulberry aesthetic.

Computer Skills

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Cloud and other appropriate CAD programmes.
  • Computer literate in Excel and Outlook.
  • Strong online research skills, including the ability to identify relevant design references, emerging trends and market opportunities.

All hiring decisions are made only on the basis of qualifications, skills or experience and as they relate to the particular role. title: Senior Detection & Response Engineer, Cyber Defense
descriptionHtml:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

We are hiring Detection & Response Engineers to decide what we detect, command the response when something is real, and automate everything in between, across enterprise, cloud, production, data centre, and operational technology environments.

You will work in a three-person regional rotation. Roughly one week in three, you hold the operational slot: taking escalations, deciding fast, and acting. The other two weeks are engineering. You find where our detection coverage is thin and work with our AI agents to close it, build automation that removes human time from the response path, and make sure we are ready for the next incident. When a serious incident lands, you command it.

If you have spent years closing the same ticket every Tuesday—and knowing exactly how to fix it for good, but never having the mandate—this is the job where that is the mandate.

What you'll be doing

Detection engineering

  • Map our detection coverage against attacker tradecraft and the real estate, and find where we are blind.
  • Turn coverage gaps, incidents, threat research, and recurring escalations into clear detection ideas, and work with our AI agents to build them.
  • Assess and tune the detection ideas and rule logic our agents propose, which run as shadow rules before they go live. Judge what each one catches, what it misses, and what its noise will cost.
  • Make the human call on promotion. You will rarely write a query from scratch, but nothing goes live without your judgement, and you are accountable for whether it is right.
  • Retire or retune live detections that are noisy, stale, or no longer relevant.
  • Identify telemetry gaps and make the business case for closing them.

Automation

  • Remove recurring toil from the response path: enrichment, triage, containment actions, case handling, and reporting.
  • Improve the agents that hold the first tier, so they resolve more on their own and escalate with better context. Every gain here cuts the human time per alert and lets us cover more attack surface.
  • Ship new capabilities in our internal security platform, such as response actions, integrations, and agent tooling, so every engineer and agent on the team gets faster, and prove each one works in production.

Incident command

  • Command security incidents: set objectives, coordinate responders across engineering, infrastructure, and service owners, and keep leadership informed.
  • Make containment calls under time pressure, knowing what you can do immediately, what requires authority, and what could disrupt production if handled incorrectly.
  • Run post-incident reviews that end in engineering work, not just a document.

Incident preparedness

  • Design and run tabletop exercises and recovery tests.
  • Keep playbooks and runbooks honest, and turn the steps that do not need a human into automation.
  • Make sure the evidence, access, knowledge, and authority we need in an incident are in place before we need them.

Your operational week

  • Take escalations from the agents and the managed provider, scope them against real asset and business context, decide, and act.
  • Execute approved containment, including isolating devices, revoking sessions, restricting access, blocking activity, and preserving evidence.
  • Ensure every escalation exits with a solve where one is warranted. Where the solve is a detection or automation, you build it with the agents. Where it is a control change, specify it clearly enough that the owning team can act without a second conversation.
  • Close every case with a security disposition, an owner, the evidence, actions taken, and any required follow-up.
  • Hold the managed provider to our standard for evidence, analysis, routing, and closure quality.

First 90 days

  • Learn the incident command, escalation, evidence, and handover model, and take a rotation slot.
  • Independently own escalations across common classes, with defensible dispositions and evidence that stands up.
  • Ship your first solve: a detection, automation, or control change that permanently retires a recurring alert class.
  • Map coverage for one area of the estate, name its top gaps, and work with the agents to close at least one.
  • Assess, tune, and promote your first agent-proposed detections to live.
  • Add your first feature to the internal security platform.
  • Shadow the incident commander on a real incident or exercise.
  • Name one telemetry gap with a business case behind it. Extra credit if it is in operational technology or building management systems, both of which we currently cannot see.

About You

  • 5+ years in detection engineering, incident response, security operations, threat hunting, security engineering, or related roles.
  • Detection judgement. You can read a rule and say what it catches, what it misses, and how noisy it will be in production. You think in coverage, not in individual alerts.
  • Fluency in modern attacker tradecraft, including credential theft, session abuse, phishing, malware execution, persistence, privilege escalation, lateral movement, command and control, and exfiltration, and in how each shows up in telemetry.
  • Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux internals, including where attackers persist on each and what each one logs.
  • Incident command experience. You have led, or been central to, a significant incident: running the bridge, setting priorities, and keeping leadership informed without losing the technical thread.
  • Experience building in, and securing, public cloud environments like AWS and GCP
  • You automate what you repeat, using query languages, scripting, APIs, or workflow automation. When you hit the same problem a third time, your instinct is to build—not add another step to a runbook.
  • Hands-on investigation experience across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, network, or production workloads.
  • Sound judgement on containment under time pressure.
  • Willingness to challenge automated conclusions. You will work alongside AI agents every day, and their analysis and detection logic are inputs, not authorities. We expect you to validate them and notice when they are confidently wrong.
  • You write investigations another engineer can follow, escalations a leader can act on in thirty seconds, and case notes that still make sense to someone reading them two years later in an audit.
  • Calm and methodical when facts are incomplete or contradict each other.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, and service owners who do not report to you.

Strong pluses

  • Operational technology, industrial control systems, building management systems, or critical facilities experience.
  • Cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, data centres, HPC, or other availability-sensitive environments.
  • Detection-as-code, detection testing, adversary emulation, or purple teaming.
  • Building, tuning, or evaluating AI agents or LLM-based security tooling.
  • Response experience involving ransomware, identity compromise, destructive attacks, cloud intrusion, insider threats, or supply-chain incidents.
  • Experience holding a managed monitoring or response provider to a standard while keeping decisions in-house.
  • Experience working as part of a Follow-the-sun rotation.

This role may not be a fit if you:

  • Want a queue to work through all day. You hold it one week in three, and the job is making it smaller.
  • Measure success in tickets closed.
  • Close cases without a security disposition or evidence.
  • Accept a vendor alert or an agent’s conclusion without validating it.
  • Want to spend most of your time hand-writing detection queries. Here the agents draft the logic and you own whether it is right.
  • Would rather not be the person in charge when an incident is live.

What we can offer you

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

  • Highly competitive UK compensation package (base + bonus + equity), with performance reviews every 12 months. 🚀
  • Join one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure companies — your chance to directly shape how global AI capacity is planned and deployed. ✨
  • Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by leading critical cross-functional initiatives and shaping capital strategy — always with our full support.
  • Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶🏽 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

Equal Opportunities Statement

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

This role sits within Platform Group area of Metrea. The Platform Group rovides the Information Technology and Information Systems ecosystem that Metrea is utilising for the day-to-day operations, communication, collaboration and information sharing across its Platform business block.

Position Summary

In this role, you will lead the design and operation of secure, reliable Azure platforms that enable Metrea's UK teams to build, deploy, and support mission-focused services with confidence. You will shape how we use Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub, automation, and DevSecOps practices to improve delivery speed, platform resilience, and developer experience. 

You will be successful if you can combine hands-on engineering depth with technical leadership: solving complex platform challenges, mentoring others, and making pragmatic decisions for sensitive defence environments. 

What You'll Do

What You Bring

  • Deep experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub, including CI/CD pipelines, release controls and deployment automation.
  • Proven infrastructure-as-code experience using Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates or comparable technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and AKS, including resilient and automated deployment patterns.
  • Experience implementing DevSecOps controls across infrastructure, pipelines and the software supply chain.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted or agentic development workflows, with exposure to model APIs, LLM deployments or MCP.
  • Strong troubleshooting capability across cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, observability and software delivery.
  • Ability to influence technical direction, mentor engineers and work effectively across software, platform, security and support teams.

Desirable Experience

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

Our Firmware

Synthesia is growing fast, and lifecycle is how we turn that growth into lasting customer relationships, guiding every user from first signup to real value. Every month we send 150+ emails to 1+ million contacts, and as we launch new products and enter new markets, that scale and its impact on revenue will keep rising.

As Senior Lifecycle Manager, you’ll build one of the most exciting lifecycle programmes in Europe. You’ll own the product-led growth motion after signup: the journeys that turn new users into activated, paying and expanding customers. You’ll build automations triggered by what users do in the product and set the standard for how every customer-facing email Synthesia sends works together as one experience. You’ll partner with Product, Product Marketing and Data teams to build a lifecycle engine that grows with the company.

What You'll Do

  • Customer journeys: Design, build and optimise lifecycle journeys that support customers throughout their experience with Synthesia, from activation, adoption and engagement through to expansion, retention and winback.

  • Lifecycle automation: Own the end-to-end implementation of lifecycle programmes, from audience segmentation and behavioural triggers to workflow logic, suppression rules, QA and performance monitoring.

  • Experimentation: Develop and execute structured experiments to continuously improve lifecycle performance. Test messaging, timing, segmentation and journey design, analyse results and turn learnings into actionable improvements.

  • Data-driven personalisation: Leverage product usage, customer attributes and engagement signals to deliver increasingly relevant lifecycle experiences.

  • Lifecycle quality and deliverability: Own campaign QA and testing processes, support email deliverability and sender reputation and help establish best practices for segmentation, frequency management and customer experience.

  • AI-powered lifecycle: Explore and apply AI to make lifecycle marketing more effective and efficient. From content creation and dynamic personalisation to workflow automation, identify opportunities to improve both the customer experience and how we work.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • You deliver impact: You understand how lifecycle marketing contributes to activation, adoption, retention and revenue, and you can demonstrate measurable results from programmes you’ve owned

  • You’re analytical and curious: You use data to understand performance, challenge assumptions and continuously improve what you build

  • You think in customer journeys: You look beyond individual emails to understand the customer experience, identify friction and create relevant, connected communications

  • You’re technically excellent: You’re confident building sophisticated automation, managing complex segmentation and working with customer and product data. You care about the details that make programmes effective and reliable

  • You take ownership: You’re comfortable independently leading initiatives from concept through execution, proactively solving problems and making informed decisions

  • You collaborate naturally: You know how to work across functions, build strong relationships and move complex projects forward without direct authority

  • You care about quality: From deliverability and data accuracy to messaging and customer experience, you hold your work to a high standard

  • You’re excited about AI: You actively explore how emerging technologies can improve personalisation, experimentation and the way lifecycle marketing operates

We’d be particularly excited if

  • 6+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM or email marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or product-led companies

  • Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot, including complex workflows, list building, segmentation and campaign execution

  • Proven experience building and optimising always-on automated programmes, including onboarding, nurture and re-engagement, alongside one-off campaigns

  • Experience owning lifecycle initiatives end to end, from briefing and journey design to implementation, QA, reporting and optimisation

  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using product, CRM and engagement data to build audiences, evaluate performance and run structured experiments

  • Practical experience using AI to improve lifecycle execution, operational efficiency or customer personalisation

  • Working knowledge of email deliverability, including SPF, DKIM and DMARC, and privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA/CPRA

  • Proven ability to manage complex cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders across different teams

Nice to have

  • Experience with customer data platforms

  • Experience with Salesforce, particularly connecting CRM and account data to lifecycle programmes

  • Experience with in-product messaging and multichannel lifecycle journeys

  • SQL skills for self-serve behavioural analysis and insights

Compensation

We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role. The range for this position is £70,000 - £90,000 GBP, and we are open to discussing where you land within it, or beyond it, for exceptional experience.

title: Senior Partnerships Manager, UK
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is seeking a Senior Partnerships Manager to source, negotiate, and scale partnerships that fuel Square seller acquisition, retention, and business growth across the United Kingdom. Partners include referral networks, distributors, service providers, technology platforms, and strategic ecosystems where there is mutual benefit through lead generation, co-sell, co-marketing, and product enablement.

This is a highly visible, hands-on role at the intersection of business development, growth, product, and go-to-market strategy. You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of strategic partnerships — from sourcing and deal structuring through to activation and ongoing optimisation — with a focus on creating partnerships that deliver incredible user experiences for Square sellers. You will work in tight collaboration with Product Marketing to shape partner narratives, positioning, and GTM motions, and partner cross-functionally to drive measurable growth outcomes for the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Sourcing & Deal Execution: Identify, evaluate, and secure high-impact partners; lead negotiations and close large-scale partnership deals and product integrations that advance Square's capabilities and growth.
  • Product Partnership Development: Collaborate closely with Product and Product Marketing to design partnership experiences that delight sellers — ensuring integrations are seamless, valuable, and well-positioned in market.
  • Growth Accountability: Deliver measurable results in lead generation, seller acquisition, and pipeline contribution through your portfolio of strategic partnerships.
  • Activation & Scaling: Launch partnerships with clear GTM plans, co-marketing
    initiatives, and integrated roadmaps; work hand-in-hand with Product Marketing to bring partnerships to life for sellers.
  • Executive Relationship Management: Build and sustain senior-level relationships with partners, ensuring long-term value creation and mutual growth.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Operations, Marketing, Sales, and Legal to ensure smooth execution and maximum impact. Bring an ownership mentality to how the team operates — actively contributing to team processes, rituals, and ways of working that make us better together.
  • Measurement & Optimisation: Define and track KPIs for partnership success, adjusting strategy and tactics as needed to drive continuous growth.

You Have

  • 8+ years in business development, strategic partnerships, and/or product partnerships, with demonstrated progression in scope and impact
  • Hands-on experience sourcing, negotiating, and closing large-scale partnerships and product integrations
  • Strong collaboration skills with Product Marketing; experience shaping partner positioning, co-marketing, and GTM narratives
  • Demonstrated ability to connect partnership strategy directly to measurable seller acquisition and revenue outcomes
  • Experience working cross-functionally with a broad range of teams, with an ownership mentality
  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills, with experience engaging at the executive level

title: Senior People Advisor
descriptionHtml:
About us

We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents. We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day. Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing. Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things. Want to join our pack? Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

Role and purpose mandate

ManyPets is continuing to evolve as it scales, with increasing organisational complexity and a need for strong People partnership that enables leaders to build high-performing, engaged and effective teams.

The Senior People Advisor plays a critical role in aligning people priorities with business goals, partnering with senior leaders to shape organisational capability, improve performance, strengthen manager capability and support sustainable growth.

This role combines advisory partnership with practical delivery across organisational effectiveness, employee relations, workforce planning, leadership capability, engagement, wellbeing and data-led decision making.

You will partner closely with designated senior leaders and management teams to deliver effective people plans and solutions, ensuring they land well, are embedded within the teams you support, and contribute directly to business performance, employee experience and our values-led culture.

A day in the life

  • Accountable for providing employee relations advise to designated business areas, supporting leaders with organisational design, workforce planning, performance, engagement and complex people matters.
  • Provide hands-on support, coaching leaders through ambiguity and ensuring People activity is commercially grounded, legally sound and aligned to company priorities.
  • Support People Advisors, ensuring consistent, high-quality advice and operational delivery across the employee lifecycle.

Your responsibilities

People Partnership

  • Partner with senior leaders to translate business priorities into clear, practical and measurable people plans.
  • Provide trusted advice on organisational change, leadership effectiveness, team health, engagement, performance and culture.
  • Use people data, engagement insight and employee relations trends to identify risks, opportunities and areas for action.
  • Coach leaders to make balanced, inclusive and commercially grounded people decisions.
  • Ensure a values-led People experience is felt by teams and delivered in line with business priorities.

Change Management & Engagement

  • Diagnose and lead the People elements of change projects that improve business performance and align with strategic goals.
  • Partner with leaders and managers to ensure change is understood, communicated effectively and embedded well.
  • Support change initiatives including organisational design, redeployment, ways-of-working changes and team restructures, ensuring risks are identified and mitigated.
  • Work with senior leaders on timely communication and engagement plans for upcoming change.
  • Help managers and teams understand engagement results, identify themes and agree practical actions to improve future engagement.

Employee Relations, Risk & Performance

  • Lead on complex employee relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, legally sound and values-led outcomes.
  • Advise on performance, conduct, absence, grievance, disciplinary and change-related matters.
  • Identify people risk and escalate appropriately, balancing employee experience, policy, legal requirements and business need.
  • Build manager capability to handle people matters confidently, consistently and with awareness of the impact on individuals, teams and the business.
  • Maintain a proactive focus on wellbeing risks, including mental health, and ensure inclusion and wellbeing principles are considered across the employee journey.
  • Support positive employee relations, helping to maintain a healthy working environment, morale and regrettable turnover.

Data, Reward & Governance

  • Draw insight from people metrics to inform and advise stakeholders.
  • Use data-driven insight to continuously improve people strategies, processes and interventions.
  • Provide insight and support on reward processes, including benchmarking where required.
  • Ensure people data, reward activity and related processes are accurate, well managed and compliant.
  • Maintain awareness of GDPR, data protection requirements and relevant internal policies and procedures.
  • Support a regulated business environment by balancing innovation, fairness, employee experience and appropriate governance.

People Advisor Support & Operational Excellence

  • Support People Advisors, providing direction, coaching and development.
  • Oversee the quality and consistency of advice provided to managers and employees.
  • Prioritise and allocate casework, ensuring effective workload management and timely resolution.
  • Identify opportunities to improve people processes, guidance, templates and manager self-service.
  • Ensure People activity is delivered consistently, accurately and in line with policy, employment law and company values.

Measures of success

  • Business leaders receive proactive, commercially grounded and trusted people partnership.
  • People plans support organisational priorities, performance and capability needs.
  • Change activity lands well, is clearly communicated and is embedded effectively.
  • Employee relations matters are managed fairly, consistently and with appropriate risk mitigation.
  • Manager capability improves, particularly in performance, engagement, change and employee relations.
  • People risks and wellbeing themes are identified early and addressed pragmatically.
  • People Advisors are well supported, effective and delivering high-quality advice.
  • People data and insight are used to inform better decisions and improve outcomes.

Why this role matters

  • Strengthens the connection between business strategy and people priorities, helping leaders build effective teams and make better people decisions.
  • Improves organisational effectiveness, manager capability and employee experience through consistent, high-quality People partnership.

About you

  • Proven experience as a People Advisor, ideally in a fast-paced, scaling, operational or customer-service-led environment.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders and managers through periods of change, transformation or organisational complexity.
  • Strong employee relations expertise and a deep understanding of UK employment law and best practice.
  • Commercially minded, delivery-focused and able to balance business priorities with fairness, empathy and sound judgement.
  • Confident using people data and insight to diagnose issues, influence decisions and improve outcomes.
  • Comfortable working with reporting, Excel and larger data sets.
  • Able to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and coach leaders effectively.
  • Experience managing, coaching or developing People Advisors or HR colleagues.
  • Strong attention to detail, high standards of accuracy and a commitment to quality.
  • Curious, pragmatic and able to translate complex people matters into clear, practical advice.
  • CIPD qualified or able to demonstrate equivalent experience.
  • Experience in a regulated financial services environment is essential, with a good understanding of SM&CR or similar regulatory expectations.
Salary range:£60,000—£70,000 GBP

Ways of working

On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset. You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day. We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively. We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

Inclusion at ManyPets

We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won't discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback. If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy.

Working Model: Hybrid

Internal Job title: Senior Analyst/P3

About the opportunity:

You will be a web analytics specialist who connects website performance with other channels, such as media, for an F100 automotive company across Europe. The purpose of this team is to influence marketing change in local markets and central teams through deep insights and actionable recommendations. You go deep into site journeys, features and changes to find what improves conversion, and support media decisions by running MMM scenarios and linking media to what happens on the site. Working with a cross-functional team of analysts, you turn this into recommendations that drive better web performance, across Europe and in individual markets.


What you'll do:

  • Dig into journeys and features: find where and why visitors drop off, by market and device.
  • Measure change: read A/B test results and evaluate site changes before and after launch.
  • Work with raw data: use SQL on clickstream, media and business-outcome data to answer questions standard reports can't.
  • Connect media to the site: analyse how paid media traffic behaves on the site and converts.
  • Support media decisions: run MMM scenarios for budget questions and connect the results to web performance, showing how changes in media spend and mix affect site traffic, key actions and leads.
  • Keep the data reliable: spot tracking issues and help define tracking for new site features.
  • Support the story: prepare analysis for insight readouts, and join client calls to present findings and answer technical questions.

Key tools:

Critical: Adobe Analytics (or GA4), SQL

Nice to have: Contentsquare, Adobe Target, Python, MMM scenario planner

What we're looking for:

  • Proven Hands-on web or digital analytics.

Must have:

  • Advanced web analytics: builds segments, flow and fallout analyses and calculated metrics. Understands the tracking setup well enough to diagnose data issues.
  • SQL and clickstream data: joins and cleans large web, media and business-outcome datasets, including visit-level clickstream data.
  • Deep dives that feed the readout: runs detailed journey and feature analyses, reads A/B test results, and evaluates site changes before and after launch. Supplies the evidence behind recommendations.
  • Media and site connection: analyses how paid media traffic behaves on the site and converts, and runs MMM scenarios to support budget and media planning.
  • Client support: joins client and stakeholder calls to present their analysis and answer technical questions. Can lead a call when needed.

Nice to have: 

  • A/B testing and experimentation.
  • Automotive experience.
  • Statistical analysis skills.

You’ll also have access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and support for your longer-term career development.

title: (Senior) Performance Marketing Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing holiday rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.

Your future team

You will be part of the Paid Search team, the growth engine of Holidu's Performance Marketing: we run Google Ads and Microsoft Ads across all Holidu domains and brands in Europe, on both sides of the marketplace - Guest (B2C, bookings) and Host (B2B, lead generation). We are a small, international and highly analytical team: value-based bidding at scale, our own bidding infrastructure, and data-driven in every decision. We work AI-first, and we are early: as marketers, we build our own analyses, automations and internal apps with LLM tooling (mainly Claude), together with our MarTech team. The team is led by Andreas, who has two decades of experience in digital marketing, and you will work closely with Rasmus, one of Holidu's Co-Founders.

What you will do

This role suits a proactive builder: strong numerical mindset, comfortable creating structure where none exists yet, at home in both strategy and hands-on execution.

  • Own large-scale Search Engine Advertising across multiple European markets (Google Ads and Microsoft Ads), from account structure to value-based bidding that grows efficiently

  • Challenge how we do paid search today: question our bidding logic, structures and processes, and bring perspectives we have not considered. With us, arguments and data weigh more than job titles

  • Co-build internal marketing apps with Claude Code and GitHub, as a marketer, not an engineer. We are first movers here: you will learn a skill almost nobody in the market has yet, and you will shape our tooling together with our MarTech team

  • Own your numbers end-to-end: find the improvement potential others walk past, run high-impact A/B tests across large budgets, decide with data, and turn results into playbooks instead of one-off learnings

  • Pilot what is next in paid search: AI Max, the first generation of LLM advertising (OpenAI/ChatGPT Ads), and AI-powered workflows from anomaly detection to statistical analysis

What you bring

  • A sharp, quantitative mindset and strong analytical thinking: you make decisions with data, spot what others miss, and can argue your case clearly

  • Ownership of business results: you think in outcomes, not processes, and build solutions rather than wait for instructions

  • Hands-on experience in paid search (Google Ads; Microsoft Ads as a plus): trajectory and depth of thinking matter more to us than years

  • Genuine curiosity about AI in marketing: you’ve already used AI tools to change how you work, not just to draft texts, and want to go deeper. No engineering background needed, curiosity is the requirement

  • Fluent English (our working language); any additional language is a plus

What we offer

  • Impact: Make a difference for hundreds of thousands of monthly users.

  • Growth: Take responsibility from day one and develop through regular feedback, workshops, and knowledge exchanges.

  • Personal Development: Use your learning budget and 2 extra study days for conferences, books, courses, and more.

Astera Labs is building purpose-built silicon for rack-scale AI infrastructure. As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be a senior technical leader driving ASIC design for next-generation Ethernet and Scale-Up (ESUN) connectivity products.
