title: Senior Product Analyst, Driver Supply
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens.

Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design.

Marketplace Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and shifts, and recommend on pay. Our scientists' models and experiments feed your calls, and the squad lead acts on them.

  • Drivers choose when to work. What makes a shift worth booking early, and how do you prove what works when a clean experiment isn't possible?

  • Every booked shift is paid, used or not, and every unserved route means late parcels. Where should each area sit between the two, and what would let the network get there on its own?

  • Local shops hold our parcels while running their own businesses. Where does the network need more of them, what should a shop be paid, and how would you see a closed shop coming?

  • A whole area, not a slice: no playbook, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Product Analyst, Driver Supply at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Marketplace problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Marketplace decides: which signals count, and what good looks like for booking, matching and pay.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, Marketplace's booking and pay decisions run on a system you designed.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned the decisions a matching, pricing or incentive model fed, in a two-sided marketplace or gig platform, rather than building the model itself.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Can trace why drivers or couriers stop booking or cancel, and can read the experiments behind a pricing or incentive change, including when a clean test isn't possible.

  • Have been through real change, such as a pivot, fast growth or a new market, and rebuilt something because of it.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and happy to build their own analysis apps, monitors and alerts.

  • Would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

You're comfortable across the full design lifecycle, but you're exceptional at the parts that make it land: sharp problem framing, design that ships, and AI-accelerated craft.

Consulting with Delivery in mind: Challenging the ask and ideating intervention that matters, and seeing them through.

  • Turn ambiguous client asks into well-framed problems, prioritised opportunities and practical delivery plans.
  • Challenge assumptions, agreed scope and propose solutions constructively, using evidence and arguments to help clients choose the new scope 
  • Pitch, consult and negotiate design decisions for faster iterations and decisioning. 
  • Stay with the problem, be the custodian for the north-star  throughout delivery.
  • Constantly reframe design decisions as new constraints and evidence emerge.

Design that ships: Owning the work from framed problems to live product.

  • Own design across the lifecycle: discovery, concept, design, build, launch and iteration.
  • Create artefacts precise enough to build from, including flows, wireframes, prototypes.
  • Design for production reality: complex workflows, edge cases, data and system constraints.
  • Work inside the engineering cadence with technologists, data specialists and product owners, balancing user value, business impact, technical feasibility and delivery pace.
  • Measure what changed after launch and iterate using product analytics, user conversations and iterate.

AI-accelerated craft: Using AI to design better, and designing better AI native products

  • Use AI across research, synthesis, ideation and prototyping to compress design cycles.
  • Apply judgment to AI output: know when it's good enough, and when it isn't.
  • Spot where AI and automation genuinely move user and business outcomes, and where they don't.
  • Design AI-enabled experiences that handle model behaviour, uncertainty, failure states beyond screens from user experience perspective.

The Experience

You'll also move comfortably across your wider design practice and bring its collective strength as the work needs them:

  • Experience in B2B - Enterprise Platforms, SaaS products, Data products or AI-native products.
  • Apply service-design and systems thinking across complex processes, teams and technology.

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Travel is essential, whether it's visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career-defining trip. Yet over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades. At Duffel, we're rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we're simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel.

The Role

As Senior Product Designer, you’ll help solve a uniquely rewarding challenge: making travel disruptions easier for everyone involved. When plans change unexpectedly, travellers need fast, clear answers, while the businesses that sold them the trip need to stay in control. You’ll design our AI support product end-to-end, shaping the experience for both the travel businesses using Duffel (B2B) and the travellers they serve (B2C).

Working closely with product, engineering, and operations, you’ll champion design across Duffel, helping define what great looks like and elevating the craft of our products as a whole. To thrive in this role, you’ll bring experience designing complex products from start to finish and partnering closely with cross-functional teams to bring those ideas to life.

What you'll be doing

  • Own end-to-end design for our AI support product, from discovery and flows to prototypes and shipped software, in a product where airline rules, payments and customer expectations all collide.

  • Run discovery with customers and the travellers they serve, and turn needs from multiple stakeholders into clear, prioritised requirements.

  • Be the voice of design at Duffel: set and uphold the quality bar across craft, accessibility and consistency, and raise it in every review.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with Product Managers and engineers to take designs through to delivery, then learn from real usage and feedback quickly.

  • Explain the why behind every design decision, welcome challenge from anyone, and change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Design how AI and people work together: what the AI should do, when it hands over to a human, and how users understand, trust and correct it.

  • Bring ideas from other products and industries to Duffel, and share them so the whole team's design thinking improves.

What we're looking for

What you'll be working on

title: Senior Product Engineer (m/w/d) mit Claude Code
descriptionHtml:
Als Product Engineer verantwortest Du bei uns ein Produkt als Ganzes. Du sprichst mit Kunden und Team, findest heraus, welches Problem wirklich gelöst werden muss, und entscheidest, was gebaut wird und was wegfällt. Dann setzt Du es mit Claude um, bringst es live und schaust, ob es im Alltag der Nutzer funktioniert. Was Du dort lernst, wird die nächste Version.

Wer wir sind

Lightweb Media ist eine AI-first Software- und KI-Entwicklungsfirma mit Büros in Dresden und Hamburg. Bei uns läuft die gesamte Firma über Claude: Entwicklung, Betrieb, Projektmanagement und Kommunikation. Dafür haben wir eigene Werkzeuge gebaut: ein Company Brain, in dem unser Wissen und unsere Abläufe liegen, ein eigenes Secret Management und ein eigenes KI-Projektmanagement-Tool. Daneben entwickeln wir eigene Produkte und B2B-Plattformen für Kunden, die im Betrieb laufen müssen.

Das machst Du

  • Du setzt Projekte von der Idee bis zum Deployment um und betreust sie danach weiter: Anforderungen klären, Lösung entwerfen, bauen, ausliefern, beobachten, verbessern.

  • Du orchestrierst Claude und Subagenten über mehrere Repositories parallel, mit Plan, Review-Schritten und Freigaben vor Push und Deploy.

  • Ob etwas funktioniert, prüfst Du an der echten Datenbank und im laufenden Betrieb.

  • Releases bringst Du selbst live, schaust danach auf Health-Checks, Logs und Fehlertracking und behebst, was auffällt.

  • Du verantwortest Infrastruktur und Deployments: Server, Container, CI/CD, Monitoring und Sicherheitsupdates.

  • Am Company Brain baust Du mit: Skills, Hooks, Routinen und die Regeln, nach denen unsere Agenten arbeiten. Was sich wiederholt, machst Du zu einer Routine, die von selbst läuft.

  • Nach jedem Release schreibst Du die Nachricht an Kunden und kommunizierst im Team.

Das erwarten wir außerdem

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung

  • Mindestens sechs Monate Arbeit mit Claude

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastruktur und Deployments: Linux-Server, Docker, CI/CD und Releases, die Du selbst live gebracht hast

  • Erfahrung mit Agenten-Orchestrierung: mehrere Agenten oder Subagenten parallel steuern, mit Plänen, Prüfschritten und Freigaben

  • Der Abschnitt „At a Glance“ aus Deinem /insights-Bericht

  • Du hast Software gebaut und selbst betrieben und kennst die Probleme, die erst nach dem Livegang auftauchen

  • Backend und Datenbank sind Dein Terrain: Bei langsamen Abfragen misst Du erst und urteilst dann

  • Große Aufträge gibst Du an Agenten ab und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende der ganze Umfang fertig ist

  • Du hast eigene Skills, Hooks oder MCP-Server gebaut

  • Fließendes Deutsch, weil wir mit unseren Kunden und intern Deutsch sprechen

  • Der At-a-Glance-Teil Deines /insights-Berichts aus Claude Code

*Ein Lebenslauf zeigt, was Du gemacht hast. Der Abschnitt „At a Glance“ zeigt, wie Du mit Claude arbeitest: wie Du Aufgaben zuschneidest, was Du abgibst, wo Du nachprüfst und wo es hakt. Ein makelloser Bericht ist nicht das Ziel. Uns interessiert, wie Du mit den Stellen umgehst, an denen es nicht rund läuft.

Das hilft (kein Muss)

  • Eigene Apps oder Produkte, die Du uns zeigen kannst, als Link, Repository oder Demo

  • PHP, TypeScript, Python oder Rust in Live-Systemen

  • PostgreSQL oder MariaDB, GitLab CI, Coolify

  • Ein Blick für Sicherheit und Datenschutz in KI-Workflows

Das bieten wir

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

  • Hybrid & Gleitzeit, mit Büros in Dresden und Hamburg

  • 30 Urlaubstage

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Eigener Laptop/ Ausstattung

  • Jede Woche eine kurze Weiterbildung

  • Eine Firma, die komplett mit Claude arbeitet, und eigene Werkzeuge, die Du mitgestaltest

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Entwicklungsteam

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Products & Agentic Hospitality (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

We're looking for a senior Product Manager to ownin our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants.

This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams.

What you'll be up to

  • Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities. Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams.
  • Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas.
  • Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight.
  • Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI.
  • Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback.
  • Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost.
  • Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope, with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis.
  • Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture.
  • Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones.
  • Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform.
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch.
  • Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced.
  • Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market.
  • Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents.
  • Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design.
  • Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly.
  • Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution.
  • Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence.
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity.

Strongly preferred

  • Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots.

Nice to have

  • Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience.
  • Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products.
  • Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption.
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes.

Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you.

Who you are

  • You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments.
  • You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn't fully defined.
  • You think commercially. You ask what customers will buy and why, not just what Engineering can build.
  • You're customer obsessed. You understand real operational pain and test your assumptions with customers.
  • You're technically curious. You know enough about AI and agentic systems to hold meaningful discussions with engineers and make informed product decisions.
  • You measure what matters. You judge success by customer outcomes, adoption and commercial impact, not features shipped.

What we offer

Culture and growth

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency.
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup.
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschland Ticket.
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

Joining Apaleo

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

title: Senior Product Manager (Towed Array Solutions)
descriptionHtml:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

As Senior Product Manager Towed Array Solutions you join our towed array product group as its second Product Manager, as we expand the team to keep pace with our current growth. You will initially focus on the Submarine and Special Warfare Support Vessel (SSV) domain, working closely with the Product Manager UxV, and build a deep understanding of the towed array systems and solutions we supply to our defense partners and clients, and of the anti-submarine warfare (ASW) and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) missions they support.

You are responsible, from a product point of view, for bringing towed array solutions for your domain to market end to end from the in-water array to dry-end interrogator hardware, edge processing and integration on the host platform. You own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for your domain within the shared towed array roadmap and shape the end-to-end solution together with the Product Manager UxV Solutions and the Senior Product Manager Software Solutions, who owns the software and platform capabilities that support it. You apply and further strengthen our product discovery and delivery ways of working for your domain.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with the Product Managers for UxV, Software, OptiBarrier and Deployment Solutions, Product Marketing, System Architecture, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Customer Projects and Application Engineering teams.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have defined a clear, evidence-based SSV strategy and roadmap aligned with the overall towed array roadmap, assumed full Product ownership of SSV-related programs, and aligned hardware, software and commercial teams on the most important capabilities. Your work will expand our capacity to serve customers and programs in parallel, reduce uncertainty and strengthen investment decisions, helping Optics11 bring scalable, commercially strong solutions to customers operating in demanding, high-stakes defense environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the SSV domain strategy by defining the direction for towed array solutions in your domain, aligned with the overall towed array product group strategy, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balancing near-term opportunities with long-term company goals.

  • Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of operational use cases, mission profiles and buying contexts, validating direction with navies, primes, partners and system integrators, and synthesizing feedback from trials and deployed systems.

  • Own the SSV roadmap and end-to-end solution definition within the shared towed array roadmap by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and aligning software and platform requirements with the Senior Product Manager Software.

  • Provide product design authority by ensuring hardware concepts, architecture choices and development decisions remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle, together with System Architecture team.

  • Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures, commercial objectives and pricing for your domain, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and working with Product Marketing on market insights, positioning, value propositions and launch readiness.

  • Bring solutions to market end to end by driving productization, defining qualification and certification requirements at product and solution level (with Systems Engineering and System Architects defining them at engineering level), integration on host platforms and market introduction, including service and through-life support concepts together with Customer Projects and Application Engineering.

  • Coordinate the product core team by working with Systems Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership and Technical Project Managers on executable increments, and Project Management on customer integrations and delivery; align priorities, platform choices and shared components with the Product Manager UxV; and align Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes to ensure we deliver on our roadmap commitments.


Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in engineering (e.g. electrical, mechanical, physics or acoustics), product development or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in hardware product management, with a proven track record of bringing hardware-based systems or end-to-end solutions to market in defense or another industrial high-tech / high-compliance environment.

  • Strong understanding of complex systems combining sensors, electronics and software, and of how hardware, edge processing and software platforms come together in one solution.

  • Experience with the full hardware lifecycle: from requirements and development through qualification, production and market introduction to through-life support and ILS.

  • In-depth knowledge of product management and strategy methodologies, with demonstrable experience in defining product strategy and creating complete business cases.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level.

  • Critical thinking, adaptability and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user and customer pain points.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, capable of conveying product decisions and roadmaps to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel, including to customers and sea trials; driver’s license B (or international equivalent).

  • Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry.

Nice to Have :

  • Experience with sonar, towed arrays or underwater acoustics, ideally in ASW or ISR applications, is a big plus.

  • Experience with naval surface vessel programs, ideally submarine or special warfare support missions.

  • Experience with defense procurement, naval platform integration and export-controlled products.

  • Experience with fiber optic sensing technology.

  • Proficiency in tooling such as Jira / Jira Product Discovery, Confluence, BigPicture, JAMA Connect, Siemens Polarion, Miro and PowerBI.

  • Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus.

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

 

About the Product Team

You’ll be Rivia's first product hire, reporting to the CTO. Today, everything Product is owned by the Rivia founders and carried out Engineering. Your job is to take it over, build the function, and make shipping high quality products repeatable. As Rivia scales, there is a clear path to leading a PM team.

 

The Role

As Senior Product Manager at Rivia, you own the path from idea to adopted feature. Driving alignment across Engineering, Client Solutions and founders to build products that have relevant impact, from customer discovery, mockups, specs, weekly refinement, launches, and measurement of KPIs.

You’ll own several products across Rivia’s platform. This requires holistic understanding of market and customer needs for complex prioritisation decisions. To do that you’ll need to be deep in the details: talking to customers, experts, writing specs, monitoring usage, keeping delivery moving. You also build the product management function itself, with light processes (PRDs, documentation, releases, prioritization) that a future product team builds on, and you own product coherence: the principles that keep features consistent as the platform grows.

 

What Excites You

  • Shipping products that help bring new therapies to market. Our customers entrust us with their patients, we take that very seriously.

  • Working directly with customers, including clinical research and biotech teams running global clinical trials, to understand problems and turn them into delightful solutions.

  • Defining product management foundation, from first principles, as the first product hire.

  • Joining a team that already works AI-native: agentic features run in production on live trials, customers connect their own agents through the Rivia MCP, and much of the roadmap ahead is AI products. You work the same way, from AI-built mockups to agent-driven analysis.

 

Responsibilities

  • Product Execution: Own the full product lifecycle for your scope: discovery, spec, delivery, and post-launch measurement.

  • Drive Cross-Team Coordination: Align Engineering, Design,w and Clinical stakeholders to hit delivery deadlines. Work closely with GTM to synchronize assets and commercial readiness with each release.

  • Channel Customers need: Run structured feedback loops with customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring their needs are prioritised and our products are usable, reliable and high quality.

  • Oversee a Multi-Product Portfolio: Weigh competing priorities across the product line, deliberately direct your own attention and your teams' bandwidth, and make sure customers experience the products as one coherent whole.

  • Own Product performance: Set KPIs and targets before building, measure feature health after launch, and make kill, iterate, or double-down calls on the data.

  • AI-Powered Product Development: Use AI agents in your daily work, including AI-generated mockups to accelerate discovery, and identify where AI unlocks new value for clinical teams.

  • Product Function Building: Set up light processes (PRDs, documentation, release process, prioritization) that the team actually follows.

 

What Excites Us

  • 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS with technical products

  • You have been the first or sole PM at a B2B startup and built the product function around an engineer-led team

  • Has taken at least one product from idea to production with demonstrable adoption

  • Hands-on product analytics: built measurement from zero with Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

  • Has designed and run product processes (refinement, discovery, launches) that engineering teams actually kept

  • AI-native way of working: uses AI agents in daily product work, with concrete examples

  • Comfortable being the only product person: self-directed, builds the function while running it

  • Clinical trials, drug development, or health data experience is a strong plus. Exceptional PMs without it are welcome.

Bonus

  • Former lead or head of product who wants to build hands-on again

  • Experience shipping for expert or scientific users

 

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

  • In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

  • Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead.

  • Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

  • Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

  • Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

title: Senior Projectmanager
descriptionHtml:
Senior Projectmanager

Almere| 32–40 uur per week

Jouw impact

Als Projectmanager ben jij de verbindende factor tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je leidt complexe projecten van A tot Z en zorgt ervoor dat ideeën daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd. Denk aan nieuwe proposities, implementaties, systeemkoppelingen en organisatie brede verbetertrajecten.

Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en IT en hebt een directe invloed op hoe zorgorganisaties efficiënter en slimmer kunnen werken. Concrete plannen met zichtbare resultaten waar de organisatie én klanten echt iets aan hebben.

Let op: een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, is een harde vereiste voor deze functie. Je communiceert dagelijks in het Nederlands met collega’s, stakeholders en klanten en moet complexe projectinformatie helder kunnen overbrengen.

Zo ziet jouw dag eruit

Je start je dag met een kop koffie en een kort praatje met je collega-projectmanagers. Even bijpraten, lachen en je mail doornemen. Daarna duik je al snel de inhoud in: een overleg met de stuurgroep van een nieuw CRM-project staat op de planning. Je presenteert waar het project staat, zorgt dat iedereen gefocust blijft op de doelen, je vraagt aandacht voor de risico’s en mitigerende maatregelen en geeft een doorkijk naar wat er komen gaat. Terug aan je bureau werk je een aantal acties uit en stem je via mail en korte calls af met stakeholders. Niet veel later zit je aan tafel met de directie om een nieuw initiatief te bespreken – strategisch, uitdagend en precies waar jij energie van krijgt. Na een verzorgde lunch maak je een wandeling, speel je een potje tafeltennis of stap je in de racesimulator met collega’s. Daarna is het tijd om weer te schakelen: samen met je projectteam werk je aan een koppeling tussen het softwarepraktijkpakket van Vertimart, wat draait bij de tandartsen en Infomedics ten behoeve van het declaratieproces. Je houdt overzicht, helpt knelpunten oplossen en zorgt dat het team vooruit blijft gaan. Dan kijk je wat er de volgende week op het programma staat en of alles is voorbereid.

Aan het einde van de dag werk je nog wat mails weg, check je je planning voor morgen en sluit je af. Klaar voor een volgende dag vol dynamiek, samenwerking en resultaat.

Wat zijn je belangrijkste taken/ verantwoordelijkheden?

• Leiden van projecten van initiatie tot oplevering en nazorg

• Aansturen van multidisciplinaire projectteams

• Stakeholdermanagement op operationeel en strategisch niveau

• Bewaken van scope, planning, budget en kwaliteit

• Signaleren van risico’s en tijdig bijsturen

• Vertalen van businessbehoeften naar concrete oplossingen

• Actief bijdragen aan het verder professionaliseren van projectmanagement binnen de organisatie

• Contact onderhouden met de portfoliomanager en de projectmanagers voor lopende en nieuwe initiatieven

Wat bieden wij jou?

• Een dynamische werkomgeving met korte communicatielijnen en een informele cultuur;

• Een rol met zichtbare impact binnen een groeiende organisatie;

• Projecten die ertoe doen binnen de zorgsector;

• Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verbetering;

• Samenwerking met betrokken en gedreven collega’s;

• Een werkomgeving waar hard werken en plezier hand in hand gaan;

• Een salaris tussen €6000,- en €7000,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van ervaring en achtergrond. Dit is geen absolute range, wel een goede indicatie;

• Bij goede bedrijfsresultaten een jaarlijkse bonus ter waarde van een maandsalaris;

• Reiskostenvergoeding (€ 0,23 per km) of een NS Business Card met volledige OV-vergoeding;

• Thuiswerkvergoeding;

• Een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage werknemersbijdrage;

• Minimaal 26 vakantiedagen op basis van een 40-urige werkweek, met de mogelijkheid om feestdagen flexibel in te zetten;

• Diverse secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals korting op sportabonnementen via Bedrijfsfitness NL, een fietsleaseplan, workation-mogelijkheden, sabbaticalopties en mantelzorgverlof;

• De kans om onder werktijd vrijwilligerswerk te doen voor een goed doel;

• Een inspirerende werkomgeving, een gezellig team en een dagelijkse verzorgde lunch.

Wie ben jij, en wat breng je mee?

• Aantoonbare ervaring met (ICT-)projectmanagement in dynamische organisaties

• Kennis van en ervaring met verschillende projectmanagement methodes zoals Prince2, Prince2 Agile, AgilePM, PMBOK, IPMA, etc.

• Minimaal 7 jaar relevante werkervaring als (ICT-)Projectmanager, waarvan ten minste 5 jaar in projectmanagement in de zakelijke of financiële dienstverlening.

• Ervaring met het uitdragen en professionaliseren van projectmanagement is een pré

• Aantoonbaar trackrecord met verschillende ICT- en Businessprojecten

• Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal op minimaal C1-niveau, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Dit is een harde eis voor deze functie.

Wie zijn wij?

MSPS Groep B.V. staat voor Medical Software & Processing Services. De groep bestaat uit verschillende bedrijven die zich samen inzetten om de zorg efficiënter en menselijker te maken. We zijn gespecialiseerd in diensten zoals factoring en clearing van zorgdeclaraties (o.a. Infomedics en Clearing House Apothekers die gezamenlijk namens de zorgaanbieders ieder jaar zo’n €6,5 miljard incasseren bij verzekeraars en zorgconsumenten) en praktijksoftware voor de mondzorg (Vertimart en GSN). Dagelijks profiteren duizenden zorgverleners in mondzorg, paramedie, farmacie, specialistische zorg, GGZ en hulpmiddelen van de inzet en oplossingsgerichtheid van onze ruim 400 MSPS-collega’s, waardoor zij meer tijd hebben voor hun patiënten.

We bieden een financieel sterke en stabiele werkomgeving, met volop kansen voor onze medewerkers om door te groeien. Je werkt in een open en vertrouwde omgeving waar samenwerking en ontwikkeling centraal staan.

Sollicitatieprocedure

Je spreekt eerst telefonisch met de IT Recruiter en daarna met de Afdelingsmanager Architectuur en Project- en Portfoliomanagement en een Product Owner of Projectmanager. In de tweede ronde ontmoet je een directe collega en een interne klant. Afhankelijk van de rol en senioriteit kan een aanvullende opdracht of assessment onderdeel uitmaken van het proces. Een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) is vereist voor deze functie.

Reageren

Ben je enthousiast geworden? Stuur dan jouw CV en motivatie naar https://www.infomedics.nl/vacatures of neem contact op met Chenara Vischer via

Aan bureaus & recruiters: we got this. Profielen en cv’s die tóch ongevraagd worden toegezonden, zullen behandeld worden als directe sollicitaties van de kandidaat.

title: Senior Robotic Learning Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
The AI Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Senior Robotic Learning Engineer (m/f/d), who will architect the full pipeline that turns raw robot and human data into deployed foundation models, from collection through post-training to on-robot deployment.

Your Responsibilities

  • System Architecture: Own how collection, generation, augmentation, annotation, valuation, and evaluation fit together as one coherent data-to-model pipeline, and prioritize engineering investment where it most improves model performance.
  • Model Evaluation & Deployment: Integrate post-training and evaluation frameworks, in simulation and on real hardware, and own the path to reliable, automatic deployment on robotic platforms.
  • Data Valuation & Curation: Develop methods and metrics to assess data quality and value — diversity, coverage, redundancy, task relevance — and use them to guide what gets collected, kept, or discarded.
  • Data Generation: Build synthetic and simulation-based data generation pipelines, including real-to-sim-to-real transfer, procedural task and scene generation, and generative models, to scale training data beyond physical collection alone.
  • Data Collection: Design scalable systems for collecting both robot-generated data (teleoperation, autonomous rollouts, scripted policies) and human data (egocentric video, demonstrations) to train imitation learning and VLA models.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with research scientists, robotics engineers, and infrastructure teams to translate model and research needs into production data and evaluation systems.

Essential Skills

  • Background: Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of formal training and professional experience.
  • Professional Experience: 5+ years in robotics, autonomous driving, machine learning, or data engineering, with demonstrated ownership of systems spanning multiple pipeline stages, not a single component.
  • Robot Learning: Hands-on experience with imitation learning, Vision-Language-Action models, robot foundation models, reinforcement learning, or other learning-based approaches to robotics.
  • Programming: Software engineering proficiency in Python sufficient to build production-grade, reliable systems rather than research prototypes; familiarity with C++ is a plus.
  • Systems-Level Thinking: Ability to reason about how a decision at one pipeline stage — what data is collected — affects outcomes at another, such as model performance or evaluation results, and to design across those boundaries.

Beneficial Skills

  • Simulation: Experience with simulation platforms such as Isaac Sim or MuJoCo for synthetic data generation and sim-to-real transfer.
  • Data Valuation Techniques: Familiarity with active learning, coreset selection, influence functions, or other methods for quantifying training data value.
  • Human Data Collection: Experience with egocentric data collection, AR/VR devices, hand tracking, or teleoperation frameworks for embodied AI.
  • Data Systems: Experience designing and operating large-scale data pipelines — collection, storage, processing, labeling — for machine learning training.
  • Deployment & MLOps: Experience with model serving, edge or real-time inference, or cloud-based deployment infrastructure.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

title: Senior Sales Manager - National (M/W/D)
descriptionHtml:
Nationale Verantwortung für Wachstum im industriellen Umfeld

Viele Vertriebspositionen versprechen Verantwortung.

Diese Rolle entscheidet darüber, wie schnell ein Marktführer im Bereich industrieller Dienstleistungen in den kommenden Jahren wächst.

Gesucht wird keine Person, die bestehende Kunden verwaltet.

Gesucht wird eine Persönlichkeit, die neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten erkennt, industrielle Entscheider überzeugt und nachhaltiges Wachstum erzeugt.

Über unseren Auftraggeber

Unser Auftraggeber ist ein etablierter deutscher Industriedienstleister mit bundesweiter Präsenz und mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden. Das Unternehmen betreut anspruchsvolle Industriekunden mit technischen, infrastrukturellen und produktionsnahen Dienstleistungen.

Im Mittelpunkt steht die Unterstützung industrieller Standorte im laufenden Betrieb. Dazu gehören Leistungen aus dem technischen und infrastrukturellen Facility Management ebenso wie produktionsnahe Industriedienstleistungen, etwa Instandhaltung, Elektrotechnik, industrielle Reinigung, Produktionsunterstützung, Werkslogistik und standortbezogene Servicepakete.

Die Position ist national ausgerichtet und eng mit der weiteren Wachstumsstrategie verbunden. Gesucht wird keine klassische Außendienstrolle, sondern eine vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit, die neue Industriekunden systematisch erschließt, interne Fachbereiche zusammenführt und Mandate mit wirtschaftlicher Substanz entwickelt.

Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Neue Industriekunden bundesweit systematisch gewinnen
  • Buying Center erkennen, entwickeln und steuern
  • Ausschreibungen und Marktchancen frühzeitig identifizieren
  • Integrierte Servicekonzepte für Industrie entwickeln
  • Facility Management und Industriedienstleistungen verbinden
  • Angebotsprozesse bis zur Entscheidung koordinieren
  • Verhandlungen souverän vorbereiten und führen
  • Wachstum im Industriesegment aktiv mitgestalten

Warum diese Rolle besonders ist

Diese Position gehört zu den strategisch wichtigsten Vertriebsfunktionen innerhalb der Unternehmensgruppe.

Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für die Entwicklung neuer Kundenbeziehungen auf nationaler Ebene und bewegen sich regelmäßig auf Entscheiderniveau bei:

✓ Ihr Erfolg wird nicht an der Anzahl von Besuchen gemessen.

✓ Ihr Erfolg wird daran gemessen, ob neue Geschäftsfelder erschlossen, bedeutende Kunden gewonnen und nachhaltige Umsatzpotenziale entwickelt werden.

Sie gestalten aktiv die zukünftige Marktposition des Unternehmens.

Qualifikation

Wer hier erfolgreich wird

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Neukundengewinnung
  • Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb komplexer Dienstleistungen
  • Verständnis für Industrie, Technik oder Facility Services
  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit Entscheidern
  • Erfahrung mit längeren Vertriebszyklen
  • Kaufmännisches Verständnis für Angebote und Kalkulation
  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands
  • Verbindliches Auftreten und klare Kommunikation
  • Deutsch: Verhandlungssicher
  • Englisch: mindestens B1

Besonders passend ist ein Hintergrund aus Industriedienstleistungen, technischem Facility Management, Instandhaltung, Produktionsservice, Elektrotechnik, Werkslogistik, industrieller Reinigung, Anlagenservice oder angrenzenden technischen Dienstleistungsfeldern.

Benefits

Was diese Position bietet

Sichtbarkeit
Ihre Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf die Entwicklung eines bedeutenden Geschäftsbereichs.

Unternehmerischer Handlungsspielraum
Sie erhalten Freiräume, um Märkte zu entwickeln und eigene Ideen umzusetzen.

Komplexe Vertriebsaufgaben
Sie verkaufen keine Standardprodukte, sondern Lösungen mit hoher Relevanz für industrielle Kunden.

Perspektive
Die Position eröffnet langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb einer großen Unternehmensgruppe.

Stabilität
Sie arbeiten für ein wirtschaftlich starkes Unternehmen mit langfristiger Marktpräsenz und hoher Kundenbindung.

Vergütung
Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket trägt der Bedeutung dieser Schlüsselposition Rechnung.

Für wen diese Rolle nicht geeignet ist

⚠ Für Personen, die überwiegend Bestandskunden betreuen möchten.

title: Senior Security Engineer (Application Security)
descriptionHtml:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

About the role

As Lead Security Engineer, you'll own application security across our platform, embedding secure practices into how we design, build, and ship software, and setting the direction for a growing security function.

What you'll do

  • Own the application security program end to end: threat modelling, secure design reviews, code review, and vulnerability management.

  • Build security into the SDLC with SAST, DAST, dependency/SCA, and secrets scanning integrated into CI/CD without slowing teams down.

  • Partner with engineering on authentication, authorization, multi-tenancy isolation, and data protection across our APIs and SDKs.

  • Lead penetration testing, bug bounty triage, and incident response for application-layer issues.

  • Support customer security reviews and compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR) with practical technical controls.

  • Mentor engineers and raise the security bar across the organisation.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years in software or security engineering, with significant hands-on AppSec experience.

  • Strong coding ability (Python and/or TypeScript ideal) and the credibility to review and fix code, not just flag issues.

  • Deep knowledge of web and API security (OWASP Top 10, OAuth/OIDC, authz models, SSRF, injection, deserialisation).

  • Experience securing cloud-native SaaS (GCP or AWS, Kubernetes, containers).

  • Track record of building security tooling and processes in a fast-moving product company.

  • Clear communicator who can influence engineering teams and speak to enterprise customers.

Nice to have

  • Experience with ML/AI systems security (data pipelines, model supply chain, LLM-specific risks such as prompt injection).

  • Background in regulated industries such as healthcare.

  • Previous experience as an early or first dedicated security hire.

 

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Daily company lunches

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

Operating principles

High agency

You see something broken, you fix it or find the person who can. We celebrate the people who solve 90% of a problem before anyone asks.

Build with care & urgency

We bear-hug the customer. Former founders and people from fast-moving, high-stakes environments thrive here.

Self-aware & hungry

We stay warm, self-aware, and genuinely hungry. We elevate our peers, and ego doesn't last long.

Invent in real time

We move toward the ambiguity. We’re pragmatic, resourceful, energized by the fact that there's no playbook.

 

If you're looking to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who push you to be better, we'd love to meet you.

title: Senior Security Engineer - Enterprise Security
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Senior Security Engineer – Enterprise Security shares ownership of the day-to-day operation of the Samsara security environment. You will keep our network access, device trust, and visibility systems running, tuned, and resilient at enterprise scale in partnership with a global team. Utilizing modern principles, you'll maintain and evolve a modern zero trust program, spend time both on policy design and real-time triage for escalations.

You take security seriously and believe the best solutions are low-friction and built in partnership with others. You are comfortable owning and maintaining production systems for long term success - troubleshooting systemic issues, tuning policies based on real incidents, and continuously improving what is already built. You bring an automation mindset to repetitive work, whether using Python, SOAR platforms, or AI-assisted tools. You enjoy supporting teammates and helping other engineers build their security knowledge.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

About this team:

Enterprise Security is a global team spanning the US, EMEA, and India. We work in close partnership with our coworkers as collaborators rather than gatekeepers. Leadership is hands-on and technical, and our culture encourages everyone to contribute across the full stack.

Executive leadership actively champions security as a competitive advantage that builds customer trust and helps win enterprise partnerships. You will see a direct line between the zero trust systems you operate and the security that protects our physical operations partners worldwide. Our on-call rotation for the highest severity incidents is spread evenly across the team for one week out of every ten.

In this role, you will:

  • Co-own the day-to-day operation, triage, and tuning of the Samsara endpoint security environment by responding to escalations, investigating anomalies, and resolving issues
  • Continuously improve existing endpoint visibility tools and workflows in partnership with our Security Operations team, and based on real usage patterns and incident learnings
  • Write clear, concise documentation and runbooks for enterprise security workflows
  • Collaborate with partners across Engineering, IT, and Security to ensure proper implementation of security tools and policies
  • Assist the Security Operations team during security investigations, acting as a technical subject matter expert within your domain
  • Partner with engineering teams to triage and support remediation of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations
  • Mentor engineers on the Security team to grow their domain knowledge, tool-specific skills, and communication abilities
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team)

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in an Enterprise Security role with demonstrated impact
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining endpoint security and visibility tools at enterprise scale (e.g. Crowdstrike, osquery, or similar)
  • Exposure to at least one additional enterprise security tool stack beyond endpoint security, such as Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), zero trust systems, email security, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), or Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • An automation mindset with experience scripting and debugging code with Python (with or without AIassistance) and using SOAR platforms
  • Strong familiarity with common security challenges and the ability to independently evaluate their severity and business impact
  • Track record of delivering impactful work across multiple quarters and collaborating effectively across teams

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Significant breadth across the endpoint security ecosystem, including designing layered controls with EDR tools, passive telemetry, integration with threat intelligence feeds, and operation in cloud and containerized environments.
  • History of building out security programs using modern SaaS security platforms such as Crowdstrike, Mimecast Incydr, and Splunk
  • Experience with infrastructure as code deployments using Terraform
  • Experience with AI-driven automations

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior SEO Manager Content & AEO (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du möchtest mitentscheiden, wie AutoScout24 in der nächsten Generation von Search gefunden wird? Als Senior SEO Manager Content & AEO übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer organischen Sichtbarkeit – von klassischer Suche über AI Overviews bis hin zu Large Language Models.

Dabei bist du nicht nur beratend tätig: Du identifizierst Potenziale, setzt Prioritäten und treibst SEO- und Content-Initiativen eigenständig von der Analyse bis zur Umsetzung und Erfolgsmessung. Du verbindest fundierte SEO-Expertise mit Daten, Content und einem tiefen Verständnis für Nutzerintention und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Product, UX, Tech und Marketing unsere Organic-Search-Strategie weiter.

Als Teil unseres globalen Content Marketing Teams verantwortest du den deutschen Markt und arbeitest an einer großen digitalen Marketplace-Plattform mit unterschiedlichen Nutzergruppen, Suchintentionen und Customer Journeys.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Übernimm Ownership für unsere SEO-, Content- und AEO-Strategie im deutschen Markt und identifiziere eigenständig die größten Potenziale für organische Sichtbarkeit, Nutzerrelevanz und Business Impact.
  • Analysiere Search-, Content- und Performance-Daten, erkenne Themen-, Keyword-, Intent- und Content-Gaps und übersetze deine Erkenntnisse in eine klar priorisierte Roadmap mit messbaren Zielen.
  • Entwickle unsere Search-Strategie über klassische SEO hinaus weiter und teste systematisch, wie AutoScout24 in AI Overviews, generativen Suchergebnissen und Large Language Models relevant und sichtbar bleibt.
  • Entwickle und optimiere skalierbare Content- und Landingpage-Konzepte entlang unterschiedlicher Nutzerintentionen und Customer Journeys – von Information und Research bis hin zu transaktionalen Marketplace-Erlebnissen.
  • Arbeite eng mit Product, UX, SEO-Tech und Marketing zusammen, um auch strukturelle und technische SEO-Potenziale zu identifizieren, zu priorisieren und gemeinsam umzusetzen.
  • Verantworte Initiativen End-to-End: von Research und Business Case über Priorisierung, Briefing und Umsetzung bis zur Messung des tatsächlichen Impacts – und passe deine Strategie datenbasiert an.
  • Steuere bei Bedarf Agenturen, Freelancer und weitere Content-Partner und stelle dabei Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und klare Prioritäten sicher.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mehrjährige, fundierte SEO-Erfahrung mit und hast bereits eigenständig größere SEO-, Organic-Growth- oder Search-Initiativen entwickelt und umgesetzt – idealerweise für größere Websites, Plattformen, Marketplaces oder andere komplexe digitale Produkte.
  • Du kannst konkrete Beispiele nennen, bei denen deine Entscheidungen zu messbaren Verbesserungen bei organischer Sichtbarkeit, Traffic, Conversion, Leads oder anderen Business-KPIs geführt haben.
  • Du verfügst über ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Search Intent, Content SEO, Informationsarchitektur, interner Verlinkung und technischen SEO-Grundlagen und kannst beurteilen, welche Hebel den größten Impact versprechen.
  • Du arbeitest stark daten- und hypothesengetrieben und bist sicher im Umgang mit Tools wie Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Sistrix, Ahrefs, Semrush oder vergleichbaren SEO- und Analytics-Tools.
  • AI Search, AEO und GEO sind für dich mehr als Buzzwords: Du beschäftigst dich aktiv damit, wie sich Search verändert, experimentierst mit neuen Ansätzen und kannst klassische SEO-Prinzipien auf neue Search Experiences übertragen. Wir erwarten dabei nicht, dass du bereits jahrelange AEO-Erfahrung mitbringst.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Data Platform, C++)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

#LI-MM1

We’re looking for a Software Engineer with strong C++ expertise to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products.

Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform.

Built on top of the open-source YTsaurus ecosystem, we run and extend our own Nebius distribution and develop significant in-house functionality (core and platform-level). We can design, implement, and roll out features end-to-end on our clusters without waiting for upstream approvals and contribute upstream when it makes sense.

At scale today, this includes~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute.

What’s inside the platform

You’ll work on a system that includes (and ties together):

  • Distributed Storage (Cypress): transactional semantics, tiered storage, erasure coding, replication, and strong reliability expectations.
  • Compute & ETL: a cluster-wide job scheduler (tens of thousands of cores), MapReduce, YQL for SQL-like data processing, and SPYT (Spark over YTsaurus) for modern data engineering.
  • Interactive analytics (CHYT): ClickHouse® instances spun up directly on compute nodes for fast SQL over data in-place.
  • Dynamic Tables: low-latency NoSQL KV with distributed ACID transactions for OLTP-style workloads and feature stores.
  • Orchestracto: workflow orchestration deeply integrated with the platform (Airflow-like, but platform-native).

What you’ll do

We’re looking for engineers who combine strong systems skills with product sense: understanding who uses the platform, why certain capabilities matter, and making pragmatic trade-offs to maximize impact. On our team, engineering work is expected to be connected to real users and outcomes — you’ll regularly align with internal stakeholders, clarify requirements, and help drive prioritization.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and implement new functionality in YTsaurus core (C++) with production reliability in mind.
  • Build and evolve platform-level capabilities: platform architecture and operating model—multi-cluster growth, shared primitives, and a consistent experience that scales with new teams and use cases.
  • Improve end-to-end platform experience for internal (and external-facing) users: APIs, guardrails, debugging workflows, and automation.
  • Own production quality: incident response / on-call rotation, root cause analysis, and turning learnings into durable fixes.

Example projects

  • Roll out sharded YTsaurus masters (incl. Kubernetes operator support) and build automatic balancing of metadata across master cells (consensus groups) to remove control-plane bottlenecks and unlock 10–100x cluster growth.
  • Make CHYT interactive SQL faster and more predictable at high load via performance work like data-skipping / min-max-style indexes and improved execution introspection.
  • Turn Orchestracto into a platform product by defining the building blocks, developer experience, and governance for how teams create and share workflows.
  • Scale and harden Parquet-on-S3 for native YTsaurus workloads by tackling replication/movement, consistent lifecycle semantics, and master-server metadata optimizations for performance and reliability.
  • Design and ship complete, trustworthy audit trails for data changes (who/what/when) across heterogeneous storage and compute paths.

Tech stack

  • Core: modern C++ (C++20, async + multithreaded primitives)
  • Services & tooling: Go and Python (microservices, utilities, integration tests)

What we expect

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Strong C++ skills (you’ll write core code).
  • Working knowledge of Python and/or Go (you don’t have to be expert, but should be comfortable navigating them).
  • Experience developing and/or operating high-load, distributed services.
  • Production mindset: ability to use SSH, read logs/metrics/traces, and debug distributed systems behavior.
  • Solid CS fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, concurrency basics.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Big Data systems (YTsaurus/Hadoop/Spark/ClickHouse/Kafka-like ecosystems).
  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, schedulers, resource isolation, quotas, and reliability engineering.
  • Strong performance engineering skills (profiling, lock contention, latency/throughput tradeoffs).

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
