title: Senior Software Engineer — ML Inference & Numerics
descriptionHtml:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

Help make the latest AI models run well on our silicon. You’ll work from model code to measured hardware performance: bring up new architectures, track down accuracy failures, and improve latency, throughput, and memory use.

The bigger challenge is making that work repeatable. You’ll build an agentic harness that can explore implementations, run experiments, check results, and guide the next change. Every investigation should leave behind better software, better tests, and a shorter path for the next model.

We’re looking for an excellent software engineer who understands LLM inference deeply and knows how to put coding agents to work. You’ll own substantial parts of our SDK and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your particular focus will be numerical optimization: finding where precision matters, where computation can be cheaper, and how to preserve model quality.

What you’ll do

  • Build the agentic workflows. Give agents the tools to inspect models, change implementations and numerical settings, run emulation and hardware experiments, and diagnose failures. Build the feedback and evaluation that make the results trustworthy.
  • Bring up new models quickly; make them go brrrr. Work with engineers across the stack to take unfamiliar architectures from reference code to validated, performant execution on our accelerator. Turn what you learn into reusable model support and SDK improvements.
  • Optimize numerics. Explore precision, accumulation, and quantization choices across the model. Understand how they interact with kernels, KV caches, memory, and distributed execution, then measure the gains in latency, throughput, and memory use against model quality on silicon.
  • Make numerical quality measurable. Build conversion and emulation software that lets you test numerical choices quickly. Compare activations and outputs against reference models, trace accuracy regressions to their source, and validate changes with end-to-end model evaluations.
  • Ship software that lasts. Own design, implementation, testing, and delivery. Build clear APIs that are easy to use for agents. Make difficult bugs reproducible and keep them from returning. Know when to build fast, and when to build thoroughly.
  • Shape the next chip. Work with hardware architects to test how numerical formats and arithmetic choices affect real models. Turn those findings into better hardware and algorithm designs.

What we need from you

  • You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model’s implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention, KV caches, MoE, batching, and parallelism. You understand how these translate into compute, memory, and communication on an accelerator.
  • You build excellent software. You’ve owned substantial systems and delivered complex features from design through production. You’re strong in Python, thoughtful about interfaces, and rigorous about abstractions and testing.
  • You are fluent with agentic tooling. You’d rather build the agent that runs the optimization than doing it by hand; and running numerous agents in parallel excites you. You know what is required for agents to work effectively in a large software organization, and you have the judgement when an agentic loop still needs a human.
  • You take ownership and bring others along. You form clear hypotheses, test them, and drive problems to resolution across software boundaries. You communicate clearly through specs, design docs, and reviews that people and agents can act on. You explain complex trade-offs, give direct feedback, and make the people around you better.

If you tick a few of these boxes, we’d love to hear from you.

We’d be thrilled if you had

  • Expertise in improving inference systems like debugging and optimizing the runtime of complex models and reasoning about accuracy-performance trade-offs.
  • Experience with ML compilers, accelerator SDKs, or model compression libraries, particularly for non-NVIDIA accelerators such as TPU, Trainium/Inferentia, Tenstorrent, Groq, or Cerebras.
  • Experience with model quantization, sparsity, codebooks, low-rank factorization or other compression techniques.
  • Contributions to distributed inference or serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.

Why join us

Your code will help determine how quickly we support new models, how efficiently they run, and what we build into our next chip. You’ll own meaningful software, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon.

If you want to build the tools, solve the hard failures, and help set the engineering direction of a new inference platform, we’d like to hear from you.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

descriptionHtml:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry.
Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components.
Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Team/Project

We are looking for a senior Systems Engineer to join our Program & Systems Engineering department and contribute to the development of our photonic quantum computing systems, including strategic programs such as QBI Phase B and PROQCIMA+.

As our first dedicated Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the technical consistency of our complex systems, bringing together photonics, electronics, mechanics, cryogenics and software. You will own the system technical baseline, working with domain experts who contribute to subsystem expertise and detailed technical inputs.

Working closely with multidisciplinary R&D teams and reporting to the CTO, you will operate as a peer of the Program Manager, with a dotted-line relationship for program priorities. You will own the definition and implementation of systems engineering practices, from requirements definition and system architecture to integration, verification and validation. You will provide technical recommendations and escalate unresolved trade-offs to the CTO, while Program and Project Managers own priorities, budgets and delivery planning.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • System architecture & requirements: Define and maintain system-level requirements, translate them into subsystem specifications, and ensure consistency and traceability throughout development. Own the system architecture and controlled technical baseline, consolidating contributions from domain experts and requirements from customer projects in coordination with the relevant Project Manager.
  • Interface management: Coordinate technical interfaces between subsystems, identify dependencies, and ensure compatibility across engineering disciplines. Establish Interface Control Documents (ICDs), with a named technical owner on each side of each interface.
  • Verification & validation: Define system-level V&V strategies, acceptance criteria to ensure system performance and compliance with requirements. Own the V&V plan and organize requirements and architecture, design, and integration-readiness reviews, with clear readiness criteria and traceability between requirements and verification evidence.
  • Technical coordination & risk management: Assess design trade-offs and support engineering teams in resolving complex integration challenges. Take ownership of technical risks in the shared risk register and propose mitigation actions. Work with Program and Project Managers to assess cost and schedule implications, escalating unresolved disagreements to the CTO.
  • Change control: Assess the technical impact of proposed changes to requirements, architecture, interfaces and supplier specifications or parts. Support the change-control process chaired by the Program Manager, with cost and schedule assessments provided by the Project Manager, and maintain the approved technical baseline.
  • Roadmap contributions: Provide technical inputs to the integrated multi-year roadmap, including technical dependencies, constraints affecting the critical path and readiness criteria for technical gates. Support Program and Project Managers in aligning technical milestones with resources and budgets.
  • Systems engineering processes: Establish and continuously improve pragmatic engineering methodologies, documentation and tools adapted to a fast-growing R&D environment. Define roles, responsibilities and processes before selecting tools. Prioritize requirements and traceability, interface control, change control, technical reviews and V&V; pilot lightweight processes on one project, obtain CTO approval and support wider adoption.
  • Engineering tools: Own requirements and traceability tools, define needs and lead evaluations and pilots for CTO approval. Build on the existing environment and introduce dedicated requirements management or model-based systems engineering (MBSE) tools only when justified by system complexity or practical limitations.

Requirements

  • Engineering degree or equivalent qualification in systems engineering, physics, electronics, photonics, mechatronics or related fields.
  • Solid experience (+8 years) in systems engineering, system architecture, or multidisciplinary system integration, ideally involving complex hardware and software systems. Experience taking technical responsibility for large, complex systems and establishing a controlled requirements and architecture baseline is particularly relevant.
  • Strong understanding of requirements engineering, interface management, technical risk assessment and verification & validation methodologies, including requirements traceability, ICDs and technical change-impact assessment.
  • Ability to integrate domain experts’ contributions into a coherent system architecture and work effectively alongside Program and Project Managers.
  • Ability to structure systems engineering practices while remaining pragmatic and hands-on in an evolving R&D environment.
  • Experience introducing systems engineering processes or tools in a growing organization. Ability to define process needs first and scale tools accordingly; familiarity with requirements management and MBSE approaches is an advantage.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to challenge technical decisions. Ability to explain technical trade-offs, make clear recommendations, and escalate unresolved issues constructively.

We’re looking for a SeniorTalent Partner to own the full hiring lifecycle across sales, marketing, and corporate functions, at every level and across the UK, Philippines, and UAE. You’ll report to the VP People, and this role is critical to our ability to build a world-class organisation.

This is your chance to build the commercial and operational teams that will take GetGround to new markets and new customers. We’re backed by QED, one of the world’s most prestigious VC funds, with an experienced leadership team that puts real weight on culture and is relentless about hiring, engaging, and retaining world-class talent.

Why this role matters

Every person we hire shapes the future of property investment. The people who sell, market, and run GetGround are the ones who turn our technology into growth. As our Senior Talent Partner, you’ll build the team that builds the business, and you’ll do it with the same innovative, AI-forward mindset that defines our approach to PropTech.

If you’re ready to take full ownership of hiring, experiment fearlessly, and attract exceptional talent to an ambitious mission, let’s talk.

What You’ll Own

  • Taking our hiring velocity, execution, and impact to the next level

  • End-to-end recruitment across sales, marketing, and corporate functions (finance, legal, operations, people and more), from entry-level to executive search

  • Running multiple searches at once across the UK, Philippines, and UAE, adapting your approach to each market’s talent landscape, norms, and hiring practices

  • Building and nurturing talent pipelines for immediate and future hiring needs

  • Partnering with hiring managers to define roles, ideal profiles, and assessment approaches

  • Sourcing creatively across channels and experimenting with AI-powered recruitment tools

  • Delivering a candidate experience that reflects our ambition and values

  • Tracking, analysing, and improving hiring metrics and processes

  • Scaling our talent acquisition strategy as we grow rapidly

Who You Are

You’ll own the hiring strategy for GetGround, and this is your chance to define what excellence in hiring looks like. You are:

A resilient problem-solver. Hiring rarely goes to plan. When pipelines dry up, roles evolve mid-search, or offers fall through, you stay calm and find a way forward.

Creative in your approach. You don’t rely solely on job boards and LinkedIn. You experiment with unconventional sourcing, craft messaging that stands out, and find talent in places others overlook. You know the best candidates often aren’t actively looking, and that a strong talent brand is critical to hiring well.

A market-savvy commercial hirer. You understand what great sales and marketing talent looks like, how to assess it, and what motivates it. You’re equally comfortable hiring an SDR, a Head of Marketing, or a Finance Director, and you adapt your approach to each.

Comfortable across borders. You can run searches across multiple regions and time zones, and you’re curious about how hiring differs between London, Manila, and Dubai.

AI-curious and ready to experiment. You’re genuinely excited about how AI is changing recruitment and eager to test new tools, workflows, and approaches. We’re building an AI-first company, and you’ll help explore what that means for how we hire.

Relentlessly results-driven. You set clear goals and hold yourself accountable. Time to hire, pipeline conversion, and offer acceptance rates all matter to you, and you keep refining your approach to improve them.

Exceptionally organised. You juggle multiple searches across functions and geographies without missing a beat. Your processes are tight, your communication is proactive, and hiring managers trust you completely.

Strategic in your thinking. You anticipate hiring needs rather than just reacting to them. You partner with leadership to understand business goals and build talent strategies that keep us ahead of our growth curve.

Scrappy and action-oriented. You know when to build the perfect system and when to move fast with what works. You’re hands-on and pragmatic, and no task is beneath you when it gets the right people in the door.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Ashby, our ATS

  • Experience hiring in the Philippines and/or the UAE

  • Background in fintech, PropTech, or high-growth startups

  • Experience building employer branding initiatives

This role isn’t for you if

  • You want fully remote work. We’re hybrid, with 3 days in the office, and we believe passionately in the advantages of in-person collaboration and innovation.

  • You’re looking for a slow-paced corporate environment. We move fast, own outcomes, and live by our values: no BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsession, and healthy ego.

What we are building: The first end-to-end real estate investment offering - making the dream of owning real estate more accessible to everyone globally.

Diversity & inclusion at GetGround: We encourage applications from all sections of society and we believe in the criticality of an inclusive culture. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other basis as protected by law.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

How do you deliver an AI platform capability that spans multiple engineering teams and an enterprise customer’s go-live date - without compromising quality, reliability or security?

This is the challenge you’ll solve as a Senior Technical Program Manager at Parloa. We’re looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead one of Parloa’s most strategic cross-organizational programs from definition through launch.

Parloa is building an enterprise AI platform powering Fortune 2000 companies with conversational AI. Our Agent Management Platform (AMP) is trusted by global organizations including Booking.com, Allianz and American Express. As we scale rapidly, we’re building an engineering organization optimized for speed, quality and innovation.

This role is about delivering outcomes, not coordinating activity.

You will be accountable for one of the company’s highest-impact programs, bringing together multiple engineering teams and cross-functional partners to deliver a critical business outcome. You will own the integrated execution plan, dependency management, launch readiness, executive communication and decision-making mechanisms that determine whether the program succeeds.

When the program is at risk, you’re expected to know first, understand why, and arrive with well-reasoned options - not just status updates.

This is not a delivery coordination or Scrum facilitation role. Product defines what we build. Engineering owns how we build it. You ensure we successfully deliver across organizational boundaries.

Enterprise customers expect reliability, security and operational excellence - not just feature delivery. You will establish a clear readiness bar for your program, ensure delivery trade-offs are explicit and well understood, and help leaders make informed decisions before deadlines force implicit ones.

Although you won’t write production code, this is a highly technical role. You should be comfortable discussing architecture, rollout strategies, system dependencies, and reliability risks with senior engineers, and be able to challenge assumptions when delivery plans don’t align with technical complexity.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity and has successfully delivered complex technical programs across teams they did not directly manage. You are an exceptional written communicator who can simplify ambiguity for executives while earning credibility with engineers. Experience building AI products is valuable, but curiosity, learning velocity and sound engineering judgment matter more than prior domain expertise.

Areas of ownership:

  • Serve as the accountable leader for one strategic cross-organizational program, or two closely related programs, with clear business impact.

  • Build and maintain the integrated execution plan, including milestones, critical path, dependencies and cross-team commitments.

  • Drive end-to-end risk management by identifying leading indicators, removing blockers, tracking mitigations and escalating only when executive decisions are required.

  • Define and continuously raise the quality bar for your program by establishing objective launch criteria across functionality, reliability, security and operational readiness.

  • Lead release readiness across Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, Legal and Commercial teams, ensuring launches are based on measurable readiness rather than feature completion alone.

  • Make delivery trade-offs explicit. Where timelines require compromises, ensure decisions are documented, owned by the appropriate stakeholders and supported by clear mitigation plans.

  • Drive executive decision-making through concise written narratives, data and clear recommendations, replacing fragmented status reporting with a trusted source of truth.

  • Define and monitor delivery metrics that enable objective decisions around scope, schedule, quality and execution risk.

  • Build lightweight mechanisms that improve planning, dependency management and execution across teams, leaving the organization stronger after the program completes.

  • Influence technical and organizational decisions without direct authority, aligning engineering, product and business stakeholders around shared outcomes.

Who you are:

  • 7+ years of Technical Program Management experience, or equivalent experience leading large-scale technical programs with software engineering teams.

  • Proven experience delivering complex cross-functional programs from definition through launch across organizations you did not directly manage.

  • Experience leading release readiness for production systems, including defining objective launch criteria and driving launch decisions.

  • Strong track record of identifying delivery risk early, driving mitigation plans and making effective escalation decisions.

  • Sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with senior engineers on architecture, rollout strategies, system dependencies and engineering trade-offs.

  • Experience defining program metrics and using data to guide execution and executive decision-making.

  • Exceptional written communication skills. You can distill a complex technical situation into a clear one-page narrative for senior leadership.

Nice to have:

  • Experience delivering AI, machine learning or LLM-powered products at scale, ideally in a high-growth engineering organization.

  • Experience building program management mechanisms that became durable organizational practices.

How you work:

  • You make sound decisions in ambiguous situations, balancing imperfect information with the need to keep the organization moving.

  • You learn quickly. You have successfully developed deep expertise in unfamiliar technical domains and enjoy mastering new technologies.

  • You move quickly without lowering standards, making pragmatic decisions while ensuring quality, reliability and security remain deliberate choices rather than accidental outcomes.

  • You challenge assumptions with evidence, communicate difficult messages constructively and fully support decisions once they are made.

  • You introduce only the amount of process necessary. Your mechanisms reduce organizational friction rather than create it.

Our recruiting process:

Recruiter Call → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview → Writing Assignment + Leadership Round → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. Please click here to learn more. If you receive an offer of employment from Parloa, you will need to go through the E-Verify process of digital verification of your employment authorization documents as provided on the Form I-9. Participation in E-Verify does not limit your right to work and verification will only be completed after you become an employee with Parloa.

* We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, national origin, disability status, socioeconomic background and other characteristics.

title: Senior UAV Systems Engineer (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

We are a high-pace, hands-on engineering team that values physical hardware progress over bureaucratic paperwork. We build, break, iterate, and fly real aircraft.

YOUR MISSION

This is a hands-on, design-focused engineering role for a next-generation Unmanned Aerial System (UAS). Yes, there will be requirements, architectures, interfaces, V&V, and safety work but more importantly, we need a technical authority who will sit with the aircraft, master the physical and electrical systems, solve complex engineering problems in real time, and get hardware safely into the air.

As a Senior UAV Systems Engineer, you will own the technical design, electrical architecture, and subsystem integration of the platform. You will bridge the gap between high-level concepts and working, flight-ready hardware.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Lead the hands-on design, integration, and physical assembly of critical UAS avionics, power distribution, flight control, and propulsion systems.
  • Conceptualise overall platform architecture, conducting trade studies and balancing real-world mass, power, thermal, and RF link budgets.
  • Sit directly with the aircraft to debug, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware and software integration issues across electrical, mechanical, and avionics boundaries.
  • Define practical Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and enforce interface control processes to ensure seamless hardware integration.
  • Drive Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation setups and bench testing to validate hardware behavior prior to flight operations.
  • Support pragmatic system safety assessments (FMEA/DFMEA) and airworthiness reviews grounded in real failure modes and flight test data.
  • Act as the lead technical interface for internal teams and suppliers to integrate mission payloads, edge-computing hardware, and custom electronics.
  • Lead field-integration tasks and rapid-response technical troubleshooting during live flight-test campaigns to maintain operational velocity.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Degree (or equivalent) in Aerospace, Systems, Electrical, Robotic, or a closely related Engineering discipline.
  • Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and testing UAVs, autonomous aircraft, or high-performance vehicle systems.
  • Deep practical background with avionics, flight control software ecosystems, batteries, power electronics, propulsion integration, RF/EMC, EO/IR sensors, and GNSS/INS controllers.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, wire, troubleshoot, and refine physical system architectures alongside cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Pragmatic understanding of requirements, safety, interface management, and V&V processes without losing sight of hardware delivery.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a bias for action in fast-paced, agile environments.
  • Willingness to travel across Europe for integration and test campaigns.
  • Security-cleared or eligible to obtain UK defence clearance.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Direct experience with rapid prototyping, bench-testing setups, and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments.
  • Experience integrating tactical payloads, electronic warfare (EW) components, or high-power electric propulsion hardware.
  • Prior experience in start-up or scale-up environments where direct hardware interaction and pragmatic decision-making are daily standards.

ARMED FORCES COMMITMENT:

We are proud to hold the Bronze Award from the Defence Employer Recognition Scheme (ERS), reflecting our meaningful commitment and ongoing support for UK defence personnel. At our core, we believe in championing those who serve, those who have served, and their families. As part of this scheme, we are dedicated to providing an inclusive, supportive environment where members of the Armed Forces community can thrive and bring their invaluable skills to our team.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior UX / Digital Product Designer (Mensch)
descriptionHtml:
Wir suchen in Berlin eine:n Senior UX / Digital Product Designer (Mensch) mit hoher Reisebereitschaft, der:die den gesamten Prozess digitaler Produktentwicklung souverän beherrscht und Projekte in dynamischen Kontexten und Projektumfeldern eigenverantwortlich führen kann und sowohl strategisch als auch operativ auf Senior-Niveau agiert.

Taikonauten entwickelt digitale Produkte, Services und Plattformen für Organisationen aus Branchen wie Finance, FinTech, Mobility sowie Industrial & Manufacturing. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, ihre digitalen Angebote im Kontext von digitaler Transformation, Produktinnovation und Acceleration strategisch und nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Dabei arbeiten wir explorativ, konzeptionell tief und mit hohem gestalterischem Anspruch – immer mit starkem Fokus auf Nutzerzentrierung.

Unser Anspruch ist es, Produkte von der ersten Problemdefinition bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung im Markt zu begleiten. Neben fachlicher Expertise ist uns vor allem der menschliche Match wichtig. Wenn du Begeisterung für digitale Produktentwicklung mitbringst und aktiv an anspruchsvollen Projekten mitwirken möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Deine Mission

Du führst digitale Produktentwicklungen mit konzeptioneller Klarheit, methodischer Sicherheit und gestalterischer Exzellenz. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe und zunächst unklare Problemstellungen, triffst fundierte Designentscheidungen und argumentierst diese gegenüber Kund:innen und internen Teams. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung – nicht nur für Screens, sondern für Produktqualität, Nutzerzentrierung und Projektdynamik. Du verbindest Business-Ziele mit echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und führst Projekte von der Discovery-Phase bis zur Validierung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kund:innen, Entwickler:innen und interdisziplinären Teams zusammen und setzt Qualitätsmaßstäbe in UX, Visual Design und konzeptioneller Klarheit.

Aufgaben

  • Verantwortung für den gesamten UX- und Product-Design-Prozess (Discovery bis Delivery)

  • Strukturierung unscharfer Problemstellungen (Problem Framing, Scope, Hypothesen)

  • Einbringung deiner fachlichen Perspektive und deines Beratungsstils in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen

  • Entwicklung tragfähiger UX-Konzepte für komplexe digitale Produkte

  • Erstellung von Informationsarchitekturen, User Journeys und End-to-End-Flows

  • Übersetzung von Anforderungen in testbare UX-Spezifikationen

  • Planung und Durchführung qualitativer Research-Formate (Interviews, Tests, Workshops)

  • Strukturierte Synthese von Insights und Ableitung belastbarer Empfehlungen

  • Konzeption und Ausarbeitung visuell hochwertiger UI-Designs und Design-Systeme

  • Moderation von Workshops zur Projektinitialisierung, Zielbilddefinition und Priorisierung

  • Argumentative Vertretung von UX- und Designentscheidungen gegenüber Stakeholdern

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Development-Teams während der Umsetzung

  • Eigenständige Strukturierung komplexer Projektphasen

Qualifikation

Erfahrung & Kompetenz

  • Langjährige Erfahrung im UX / Product Design (5+ Jahre)

  • Mehrjährige Agenturerfahrung mit parallelen Projekten und wechselnden Kunden

  • Fundierte Expertise in fachlich-strategischer UX-Konzeption

  • Nachweisbare End-to-End-Erfahrung in digitaler Produktentwicklung

  • Fundierte Expertise in User Research und quantitativer/qualitativer Analyse

  • Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Hypothesen abzuleiten und zu validieren

  • Sehr hoher Anspruch an visuelle Qualität (Layout, Typografie, Design-Systeme)

  • Strategisches Verständnis von Digital Strategy und Service Design

  • Souveräne Moderation auf Deutsch (mindestens B2, idealerweise C1)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma

Arbeitsweise & Haltung

  • Systemisches Denken und strukturierte Problemanalyse

  • Fähigkeit, Unsicherheit produktiv zu strukturieren

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Selbstorganisation

  • Belastbarkeit in dynamischen Projektumfeldern

  • Fähigkeit, Prioritäten eigenständig zu setzen

  • Anspruch, Designqualität aktiv zu vertreten und zu verteidigen

  • Offenheit und Interesse an KI-Tools sowie KI-gestützten Prozessen und Workflows

  • Bereitschaft, Verantwortung über die reine Designrolle hinaus zu übernehmen

  • Reisebereitschaft über mehrere Tage mit Übernachtungen, auch spontan

Gern gesehen, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit komplexen B2B- oder Enterprise-Plattformen

  • Data Analyse-Erfahrung (Analytics, Conversion-Optimierung)

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Frameworks (Scrum, SAFe o.ä.)

  • Grundverständnis technischer Architektur (APIs, Frontend-Strukturen)

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder der Skalierung von Design-Systemen

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-Tools, sowie Arbeit mit KI-gestützten Prozessen und Workflows

  • Internationale Projekterfahrung

Benefits

Was wir für dich haben

  • Passionierte Kolleg:innen in einer offenen Unternehmenskultur mit flacher Hierarchie

  • Berufliche und persönliche Weiterbildung, gefördert und gefordert

  • Raum für Eigenverantwortung und eigene Ideen

  • Flexible und familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten

  • Ein leidenschaftliches Team, das die soziale und umweltbewusste Zukunft aktiv mitgestaltet

  • Bürotage von Dienstag bis Donnerstag

Wie es weitergeht

Du hast Lust, große Schiffe für die digitale Zukunft fit zu machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf dein Portfolio und Lebenslauf oder dem Link zu deiner Website und deine Wünsche für deine berufliche Zukunft zusammen mit uns und einem Hallo.

Bitte verrate uns in deinem Anschreiben, wann du zur Verfügung stehen würdest, zu wievielen Wochenstunden und was dein gehaltswunsch ist.

Wenn wir neugierig auf mehr werden

Dann freuen wir uns auf viele Fragen von dir und ein gutes Kennenlernen.
Denn bei einem ersten positiven Eindruck sprichst du kurz mit Nancy. Im zweiten Gespräch lernst du die Teamleitung kennen. Das dritte Gespräch findet dann mit der Geschäftsführung statt.
Uns ist bewusst, dass das ein langer Weg sein kann, uns ist aber auch wichtig, dass es am Ende ein volles Ja von dir wird, nachdem du die Chance hattest, alle Ebenen deines zukünftigen Wirkens bei den Taikonauten kennenzulernen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Value Engineer - AI & Process Optimization (Copenhagen)
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

This role is based on-site/hybrid in Copenhagen, Denmark. We welcome applicants open to relocate and eligible to work in Denmark. 

The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation within the Retail sector by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their [Core Functional Area] ecosystems.

The work you’ll do:

  • Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.
  • Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.
  • Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.
  • Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.
  • Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

The qualifications you need:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.
  • AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.
  • Builder Mentality: Comfortable setting your own direction within an account team. Driven to live for customer value, proactively hunting and ideating for highest-impact solutions.
  • Process Improvement & Value Realization: Proven expertise in executing process improvements. 
  • Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating multi-region or business unit transformation programs. Expert at mobilizing VP/Director-level sponsorship. Flawless English communication with commanding executive presence.
  • Domain & Industry: Deep understanding of the Finance/Supply Chain domains and Retail trends. You stay continuously updated on business-critical use cases.
  • Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics,  comparable technical degree or a Business/Economics degree paired with a technical minor

#LI-NS1

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. title: SEO & AI Search Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Über uns



Wir begeistern und inspirieren Millionen von Menschen! Als innovativer Hybrid aus Social Media Publisher und Social Media Agentur vereint das VS Mediahouse einzigartige Expertise in den Bereichen Content-Kreation, Markenaufbau und Performance-Marketing. Mit einem Team von über 50 Experten in Social Media, Design und Videoproduktion betreiben wir die beliebtesten Social-Media-Marken Deutschlands auf Facebook, Instagram und TikTok. Zu unseren Erfolgsmarken zählen unter anderem VS, Lieblingskollegen und Lieblingsmensch®. Unser tiefes Verständnis für die Dynamik von Social Media und unser Publishing-Know-how ermöglichen es uns, Marken wie Samsung, Schwartau, Bayer und Lexware im Bereich Social Media nachhaltig erfolgreich zu machen. Wir schaffen Verbindungen, erzählen Geschichten und setzen Trends – für echte Wirkung und messbaren Erfolg.

Deine Mission



Du hast bereits erste Jahre im SEO hinter dir und kennst die Grundlagen aus der Praxis, nicht nur aus Tutorials. Gleichzeitig hast du gemerkt: Suche verändert sich gerade grundlegend. Immer mehr Menschen fragen ChatGPT, Gemini oder bekommen ihre Antwort direkt in den AI Overviews. Genau diesen Wandel willst du mitgestalten und dich darin weiterentwickeln.

Als SEO & AI Search Manager arbeitest du operativ an der SEO- und AI-Search-Strategie für einige unserer wichtigsten Kunden. Du setzt Maßnahmen eigenständig um, bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Dabei stehst du nicht allein da: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Paid Ads Team zusammen und hast jederzeit jemanden für Sparring und Feedback.

KI spielt dabei eine doppelte Rolle. Zum einen ist sie Zielsystem: Du hilfst Kunden, auch in KI-gestützten Suchsystemen sichtbar zu werden. Zum anderen ist sie Arbeitsweise: Du nutzt KI selbst für Recherche, Analysen, Briefings und Reporting. Ein fertiges Technik-Portfolio brauchst du dafür nicht, wichtiger sind Neugier und Lust, dich reinzuhängen. Bei uns wirst du zum KI-Poweruser deines Fachbereichs.

Was erwartet dich

  • AI Search & Sichtbarkeit: Du hilfst dabei, dass Inhalte in Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini und Perplexity auffindbar und zitierfähig werden. Du strukturierst Inhalte für generative Systeme, zum Beispiel mit klar beantwortbaren Absätzen, Q&A-Strukturen und sauberem Schema-Markup.
  • Sichtbarkeit messbar machen: Du baust Prompt-Sammlungen und Testsets auf und beobachtest, wann und wie Marken und Inhalte in KI-Antworten auftauchen – idealerweise mit Tools wie Peec, Otterly oder Profound.
  • Operative SEO-Arbeit: Du führst technische Audits durch, erstellst Keyword- und Content-Analysen, schreibst Content-Briefings und begleitest deren Umsetzung.
  • Kundenprojekte mitgestalten: Du arbeitest an der SEO- und GEO-Roadmap für einen unserer wichtigsten Kunden mit und übernimmst eigene Themenpakete, von der Analyse bis zur Erfolgskontrolle.
  • Kundenkontakt: Du stimmst dich mit den Ansprechpersonen auf Kundenseite ab, bereitest Reportings vor und präsentierst Ergebnisse. Mit der Zeit übernimmst du dabei mehr und mehr den Lead.

    Dein Alltag: KI als deine tägliche Arbeitsweise



Hier geht es nicht um die Arbeit für Kunden, sondern um deinen eigenen Alltag: Viele wiederkehrende Aufgaben erledigst du bei uns spürbar schneller, weil du KI dafür einsetzt – kein Kür-Thema, sondern Standard. Zum Beispiel:

  • Keyword-Clustering und Content-Gap-Analysen per KI vorbereiten, statt sie komplett von Hand zu erstellen.
  • Erste Content-Briefings und Gliederungsentwürfe mit KI entwerfen.
  • Crawl- und Search-Console-Daten von KI vorauswerten, bevor du selbst tief einsteigst.
  • Wiederkehrende Reports automatisieren, statt sie jede Woche neu zusammenzuklicken.
  • Die Qualitätskontrolle bleibt trotzdem bei dir: KI-Ergebnisse werden von dir eingeordnet und geprüft, nicht blind übernommen.

Was solltest du mitbringen



Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist uns ein solides SEO oder GEO-Fundament und echte Lust, dazuzulernen. Bei KI brauchst du kein Fachwissen, aber komplett bei null solltest du auch nicht stehen.

  • Erfahrung: Etwa 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im SEO und oder GEO, aus einer Agentur, einem Unternehmen oder einem Publisher. Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns nicht entscheidend, wichtiger sind Praxis und Neugier.
  • SEO-Grundlagen: Gute Kenntnisse in Technical SEO, Content SEO sowie Onpage- und Offpage-Optimierung.
  • Tools: Erste Erfahrung mit technischen Audits (Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, strukturierte Daten). Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Search Console und GA4 sowie mindestens einem Tool wie Sistrix, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog oder Sitebulb.
  • Interesse an KI-Suche: GEO, AEO oder AI Visibility sind dir ein Begriff, und du willst dich darin vertiefen. Du hast schon eigene Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Perplexity gesammelt, und sei es nur privat.
  • Denken in Wirkung: Du denkst nicht nur in Rankings, sondern auch in Traffic, Conversions und Kundennutzen.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert und selbstständig und fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist.
  • Sprache: Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

Warum VS Mediahouse



Wir sind auf der Suche nach motivierten Mitarbeitenden, die etwas bewegen möchten, Mut für neue Ideen haben und das Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten wollen. Wir legen großen Wert auf einen respektvollen Umgang auf Augenhöhe. Neben unserem modernen Büro im Herzen von Freiburg erwarten dich ausgezeichnete Arbeitsbedingungen in einem hoch dynamischen und wachstumsstarken Umfeld. Freue dich auf vielseitige Aufgaben mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie einer modernen, sachorientierten Entscheidungskultur ohne unnötige Hierarchien. Wir bieten dir fachliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch Freiraum für Innovationen, kurze Entscheidungswege und individuelles Management-Coaching.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Wähle zwischen einem kostenfreien Jobticket (Deutschlandticket) oder nutze unser attraktives JobRad-Angebot.
  • Um dich fit und gesund zu halten, subventionieren wir deine Epassi-Mitgliedschaft.
  • Du findest bei uns modernste Ausstattung mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen sowie Macbook & iPhone (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und natürlich ist das Arbeiten aus dem Homeoffice auch für uns kein Fremdwort.
  • Für Zwischendurch bedienst du dich an unserem regionalen Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Getränke und vieles mehr.
  • Neben deinem persönlichen Corporate Benefits Zugang erhältst du 50% Rabatt auf unsere Produkte in unserem Shop.
  • Erweitere deine Rente durch die Teilnahme an der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.
  • Abgerundet wird deine Zeit bei uns natürlich auch mit verschiedenen Team-Events und Feiern.

Klingt nach dir?



Wir suchen niemanden, der schon alles weiß. Wir suchen jemanden, der SEO solide beherrscht und Lust hat, KI-gestützte Suche von Grund auf mitzugestalten. Bei uns lernst du schnell, arbeitest an großen Marken und wächst mit deinen Aufgaben.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beschreibe uns stattdessen kurz ein bis zwei SEO-Projekte, an denen du mitgearbeitet hast (Ausgangslage, dein Part, Ergebnis), und beantworte:

1. Wie nutzt du KI heute schon, beruflich oder privat?

2. Was würdest du als Erstes ausprobieren, um KI in einem SEO-Prozess einzusetzen?

3. Woran erkennst du, ob eine SEO-Maßnahme erfolgreich war?

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?



Dann freuen wir uns auf deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung, inklusive der Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

Wenn du mehr über unsere Arbeitskultur und das Arbeitsumfeld erfahren möchtest, laden wir dich ein, die Bewertungen unserer Mitarbeiter auf Kununu zu lesen. Dort findest du ehrliche Meinungen und Feedback von aktuellen und ehemaligen Mitarbeitern.

title: Shared Services Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Shared Services Manager to join our People Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

About Us

M-KOPA now serves 10 million customers and has extended $2 billion+ in credit across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. 86% of customers report an improved quality of life, 55% access formal financial services for the first time, and 70% use our products to earn income. It takes 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents to make that happen.

The Role

Reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services, you lead day-to-day service delivery: queue health, SLAs, escalations, quality and business continuity, with functional leadership and coaching for colleagues. You also own UK HR operations, from onboarding and right-to-work to payroll and benefits cover, offboarding and contractors. You partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT and external partners including the Home Office, our payroll provider, Papaya, brokers, insurers and NEST. Success means healthy queues, SLAs met and 100% audit-ready right-to-work records.

This is a remote role, you would be working with a diverse group of other employees working remotely from locations such as UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services.

Why this timing matters

We are not hiring at random. Reaching 10 by 10 means building the people infrastructure behind our growth. A UK team that delivers onboarding, immigration, payroll and benefits to audit-ready standards is part of that foundation, and you would help set it.

What makes this different

Your current role: one process, one market. This role: leading HR Shared Services across global and market client groups, while owning UK HR operations and compliance. Every case you close helps someone who is helping deliver financial inclusion.

What You'll Do

  • Lead HR Shared Services delivery in Freshservice, managing case allocation, prioritisation, SLAs, ageing items and escalations, and coordinating capacity during peaks and absences.

  • Own UK right-to-work checks and immigration records through the Home Office portal, including annual audits, pre-expiry follow-up, Certificates of Sponsorship and sponsor reporting.

  • Run UK onboarding from accepted offer to first-day readiness, creating accurate HiBob profiles with Talent Acquisition, IT and hiring managers.

  • Manage employee lifecycle transactions, contracts, probation, letters and audit-ready HR records, reconciling data across HiBob, Freshservice and payroll files.

  • Act as UK backup for payroll, Group Benefits, NEST pensions, Global Mobility and employee relations, supporting inputs, provider deadlines and compliant case documentation.

  • Coordinate offboarding for UK employees, EOR workers and contractors, and maintain the UK Contractor List as the source of truth.

  • Produce regular reports, close audit findings, maintain SOPs and the knowledge base, and improve processes while protecting data under UK GDPR.

What You'll Need

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Relations or a related field. CIPD qualification or progress toward it is desirable.

  • Proven experience managing end-to-end HR Shared Services across multiple processes, stakeholders and client groups, including queues, SLAs, escalations, controls and continuous improvement.

  • Practical UK experience in right-to-work checks, immigration records, sponsorship administration and Home Office processes.

  • Experience coordinating UK payroll inputs, benefits, pensions, contracts, onboarding, lifecycle changes and offboarding with external providers.

  • Experience with HRIS and service-management platforms. HiBob and Freshservice are preferred.

  • Strong attention to detail, stakeholder management, sound judgement and high standards of confidentiality. Experience working across countries or markets is strongly preferred.

The reality check

This role is demanding. You will run a global service queue and a UK compliance portfolio at the same time, with competing priorities, high-volume requests and confidential cases arriving together. Right-to-work and sponsorship deadlines don’t move, and as payroll backup your accuracy shows up in someone’s payslip. When colleagues are away, you are the cover for payroll, benefits, mobility and employee relations. If you are already the person who tracks every expiry date and closes every loop, you’re probably ready for exactly this.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

  • Mindset & Approach: Ambitious, adaptable, coachable, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced environment. Combines an entrepreneurial, competitive drive to succeed with a strong team-first mindset.
  • Mission Alignment: Passionate about health and wellbeing, with a genuine desire to help organizations create healthier, more balanced work environments.

title: Software Engineer, Connected Vehicle Platform
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

The Berlin team is looking for a Software Engineer - Connected Vehicle Platform, to design, build, and operate software connecting vehicle systems with infotainment, cloud, and mobile ecosystems. You will bridge low-level communication paths and high-level vehicle interfaces, developing reusable platform capabilities while supporting brand-specific configurations.

This role combines software development, systems integration, troubleshooting, and developer enablement. You will help turn vehicle signals and hardware capabilities into dependable services, libraries, gateway behaviors, and APIs that partner engineers can discover, integrate, test, and use successfully. The role is well suited to a developer who enjoys working across system boundaries and taking software from design through production support.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain communication services, client libraries, gateway and routing components, and deployment configurations; implement message publication and subscription, request/reply interactions, service discovery, signal routing, gateway translation, and reliable failure handling.

  • Contribute to software components written in C++, Rust, Go, Kotlin, or other languages used across vehicle and cloud platform layers; evolve interface contracts, schemas, configuration models, and generated APIs while preserving compatibility for existing consumers.

  • Decide whether functionality belongs in a reusable platform abstraction, gateway mapping, vehicle service, application, or vehicle- or brand-specific integration; deploy and validate services across vehicle-oriented compute platforms, virtualized embedded environments, simulators, software-in-the-loop systems, benches, and prototype vehicles.

  • Investigate issues across vehicle interfaces, gateways, message-passing services, vehicle-model APIs, and consuming applications using logs, traces, packet captures, diagnostics, and test tools; improve reliability, performance, observability, security, deployment automation, and test coverage.

  • Support partner developers through integration guidance, examples, troubleshooting, documentation, and technical issue triage; collaborate with hardware, firmware, embedded, cloud, infotainment, security, validation, product, and external partner teams.

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, incident follow-up, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience) plus 3+ years developing software in distributed systems, embedded platforms, or middleware; strong C++, Rust, Go, or Kotlin skills across a multi-language platform.

  • Experience with messaging, gRPC, event-driven architectures, distributed systems, and designing or using Protobuf contracts (or equivalent), APIs, and schemas.

  • Familiarity with CAN/DBC, vehicle gateways, signal integration, and connected devices; physical-input or HMI gateway experience is a plus.

  • Ability to deploy and debug on embedded/virtual platforms (Android Automotive, Linux, test benches, simulators) with experience in CI/CD, Docker, or Bazel.

  • Knowledge of mutual TLS, auth, telemetry (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry), and end-to-end troubleshooting using logs, traces, and packet captures.

  • Strong communication skills to support developer adoption via SDKs and docs; experience with platform abstractions, automotive partners, Clean Architecture, and TDD/DDD.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (https://rivianvw.tech/#careers). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. Candidate Data Privacy

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Chambéry)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu intègres Pennylane et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

title: Sponsorship Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind GORNATION, eine Sportmarke aus Münster, gegründet 2015 mit der Mission, Calisthenics weltweit zu stärken. Ein wichtiger Teil dieser Reichweite sind unsere Affiliates: Athleten und Creator, die Calisthenics leben und GORNATION in die Szene tragen.

Wir suchen einen Sponsorship Manager, der diese Partnerschaften betreut und ausbaut. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Affiliates, sorgst für schnelle Antworten und verlässliche Kommunikation und hältst im Sponsorship-Team den Laden am Laufen.

Start: 01.01.2027

  • Feedback & Verträge: Du führst Feedbackgespräche und Vertragsverhandlungen, die für GORNATION und den jeweiligen Affiliate passen

  • Tracking: Du trackst Content und die Einhaltung der Vertragsbedingungen

  • Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sponsorship-Team und punktuell mit dem Event- und Social-Media-Team zusammen

Qualifikation

  • Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst persönlich, empathisch und lösungsorientiert, auch bei kurzfristigen Änderungen

Benefits
